game.name: 3 Ninjas Kick Back
game.desc: You first saw Rocky, Colt and Tum Tum on the silver screen when their martial arts skills and extreme feats saved Grandpa Mori's honor and defeated an evil arms dealer. Now it's up to you! In this action-packed adventure, you become any of the 3 Ninjas. And that's when the fun begins. Wild animals and even wilder ninjas attack! A trio of spaced-out heavy metal rockers join forces with the evil Koga in an all-out effort to get you dirty. But if you rescue Grandpa Mori and his ceremonial dagger, you'll have the last laugh... and unlock a secret room filled with more gold than Fort Knox!

game.name: 90 Minutes : European Prime Goal
game.desc: The player is one of the fourteen European football teams. The Super Nintendo game offers several modes: cup, league or training. You can create your own player and add him to the European team of your choice. It is also possible to share the fun with a friend in multiplayer mode.

game.name: A.S.P. : Air Strike Patrol
game.desc: Zarak has invaded Sweit!. As an Air Force commander, you must manage all your resources to defeat him. Using high-tech military intelligence, locate your targets, arm your aircraft and destroy chemical weapons plants, radars, enemy vehicles and more. So get in the cockpit and fly towards the challenge of your life.

game.name: Aaahh!!! Real Monsters
game.desc: In this game, based on the popular Nickelodeon comics, you control three monsters: Ickis, Oblina and Krumm. The Gromble, a monster school principal, needs you to take the final test, the mid-monster exam, to prove that you are a real monster. You should pick up trash, throw it at people and scare them!

game.name: ABC Monday Night Football
game.desc: ABC Sports and Data East team up to take you to the gridiron! Put on your helmet, put those black things under your eyes and get ready for football, Frank Gifford style. It has AFB speech synthesis technology.

game.name: ACME Animation Factory
game.desc: In ACME Animation Factory, the player is given a series of tools to create their own cartoons, using the most famous Looney Tunes characters, including graphics, animation and music. When the cartoon was created, it can be saved and then played again.

game.name: ActRaiser 2
game.desc: After hearing their plight, the Master descends to the world below to fight monsters and rid the land of evil. Like the original, each area contains two "acts"; The first act of an area consists of monsters spawned by a lesser demon named after an unfavorable condition, while the second act consists of monsters spawned from the primary evil, named after one of the seven deadly sins, with greater challenge and danger.

game.name: ActRaiser
game.desc:
Restore peace and order to your people's world! A long time ago, you and your people built a peaceful land. Since then, your world has been dominated and inhabited by the evil Tanzra and his guardians. Your once peaceful land has become a breeding ground for monsters. Wounded, you have retreated to your Sky Palace and fallen into a deep sleep.
Now, many years have passed and you have recovered from your injuries and your dream. You must punish Tanzra and restore the world to your people or lose their faith forever.
Mode of actionnnBreathe life into the statue modeled after your likeness to cleanse the land and defeat conquered monsters.
Simulation Mode Help your people develop a new land from what has been purified and build cities with your powers.

game.name: Addams Family Values
game.desc: Baby Pubert, the newest addition to the Addams family, has been kidnapped by Debbie Jellinski, her former babysitter. As Uncle Fester, it's your job to rescue little Pubert. You must search the surrounding areas (forests, swamps, gardens, and so on) of the Addams Mansion, avoiding traps, solving puzzles, and killing monsters. You will face such infernal creatures as vultures, gargoyles, bats, ghosts and demons.

game.name: Adventures of Yogi Bear
game.desc: When Yogi Bear discovers a plan to turn Jellystone Park into a chemical plant, he embarks on a mission to stop it. Play as Yogi in this side-scrolling action-adventure that is suitable for all ages. Make your way through the park's five areas collecting "Pic-i-nic" baskets by bouncing on top of them. In many cases, you bounce from one basket to the next and rise into the air where no "average bear" could reach. There are a variety of enemies such as weasels and skunks. There are also some action parts where you ride a mine cart or go "beaver surfing."

game.name: Aero Fighters
game.desc: Aero Fighters is an action game where we control an aircraft. You can choose between four countries: the United States, Japan, the United Kingdom and Sweden, each with its own aircraft model, with different weapons. Normal and special missiles are developed throughout the game to deal with increasing numbers of enemies.

game.name: Aero the Acro-Bat 2
game.desc: In the sequel to Aero the Acro-Bat you have to defeat the evil industrialist Edgar Ektor once again. He is constantly coming up with bad ideas, so you, as Aero, have to find him and destroy him before he carries out his diabolical "Plan B." As in the last installment, you must jump, escape from lethal obstacles and progress over time. This game features more moves for Aero, more mechanics to use, and more items to collect.

game.name: Aero the Acro-Bat
game.desc: You play as hitter Aero, who has to stop the mad scientist Edgar Ektor, who is trying to rid the world of fun and amusement. So you jump through the circus-style levels, using different types of machines like catapults, cannons, bubble machines, platforms, etc., collecting various power-ups like cheese, soda, keys, watches, etc. and avoiding deadly obstacles.

game.name: Aerobiz Supersonic
game.desc:
You have just been chosen as the CEO of a new airline company that must compete against 3 other airlines for global dominance. Set up new routes, buy companies, and manage all your resources, including planes, cash flow, and company representatives.
The basic premise of the game is the same as the original Aerobiz, but this time you have more planes to choose from, more city airports spanning over 7 different world regions and 4 different time period scenarios complete with historically accurate political relationships and events.
Do you have what it takes to make your company fly high? Or will it crash and burn?

game.name: Aerobiz
game.desc: You are the CEO of an airline company. Its goal is to become the most successful airline in the world by connecting all 22 cities with air routes, maintaining a profit and meeting the required quota of passengers. If you cannot make a profit for one year or meet the victory conditions in 32 years, you will lose. Some strategic decisions you need to make include negotiating for open-air routes, buying or selling airplanes, investing in branches and hotels, advertising your airline, and setting budgets. You should also pay attention to statistics, such as quarterly and annual sales reports, as well as city data. World events also affect your airline, from natural disasters to wars and even the Olympic games, all of which will affect the number of passengers you will receive. All aircraft in the game are based on real-life aircraft, such as the Boeing 747 and Concorde.

game.name: Air Cavalry
game.desc: A standard helicopter war game, with the Air Cavalry division. The game is played in a third-person view using mode 7 graphics, with the cockpit in split screen. There are three campaign areas to fly: the Middle East, Indonesia and Central America. There are also 2-player split-screen versus and co-op modes.

game.path: ./Al Unser Jr.'s Road to the Top (USA).zip
game.name: Al Unser Jr.'s Road to the Top
game.desc: If the player does well, then their final challenge is to face Al Unser, Jr. at the final event in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. This race uses the Molson Indy Vancouver as a final test of the player's hard-earned skills. Of course, the player can also practice all stages of the game except the final stage. Go-kart racing involves regional action in the United States of America, while snowmobiling presents a challenge to the game's simulated winter months. Racing IROC stock cars is seen as gaining experience for the Indy League's fastest and lightest open-wheel vehicles.
game.image: ./media/images/Al Unser Jr.'s Road to the Top (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Al Unser Jr.'s Road to the Top (USA).png

game.name: Alien 3
game.desc:
Alien³ is a video game based on the sequel to the film of the same name. The film's plot begins immediately after the end of Aliens. Ellen Ripley, the main character of the Alien series, is in cryo-sleep aboard the Sulaco spaceship.
Unfortunately, an alien or two have hidden on the Sulaco and wreaked havoc inside the ship. Therefore, he lands on the penal colony planet Fiorina 161. Ripley and the unarmed prisoners have to find a way to survive the alien terrorizing the colony until help arrives.

game.name: Alien Versus Predator
game.desc: You are a Predator warrior in the 25th century: an impressive monster with an ugly face, brute strength and cool weapons. Trained to fight with everything Predator technology has to offer: destroy or be destroyed! You've come to New Shanghai, a city on the planet Vega 4, to hunt humans, but instead, you find Aliens: powerful double-jawed beasts bent on annihilating life. You are outnumbered, but no less cunning: the hunt is on. Alien drones, warriors, heartbreakers and face lovers stand in your way. Use your lasers, blades and special weapons of destruction to earn honor for your deeds. Destroy the Guardian Aliens to advance to the next level, then follow your primal instinct to reach the final prey... Alien Queen!

game.name: American Gladiators
game.desc:
American Gladiators is licensed from the popular television series of the same name. It features a series of events that test players' strength, speed and skill against a trained team of ten "gladiators", five men and five women. The female characters are Ice, Gold, Lace, Blaze and Zap, most of whom you know from their bodybuilding achievements. The main male characters are Turbo, Nitro (hosted several US television commercials), Gemini, Thunder and Laser (Mr. Montana in 1986).
In total, there are seven events, all seen from third-person views. The last one is the Eliminator assault course, where you compete directly against an opponent.

game.name: An American Tail : Fievel Goes West
game.desc: Based on the movie of the same name, Fievel Goes West is a platform game featuring the young mouse Fievel Mousekewitz. After emigrating overseas to the United States in the 19th century (?), the Mousekewitz family has moved to the open frontier of the Wild West. Dreaming of being a cowboy, Fievel soon makes friends and plays in the dusty streets imagining himself as a great gunslinger. But all is not well, as the villain Cat R. Waul and his gang of cats (as well as other creatures) have plans to turn this place into an all-you-can-eat mouse buffet. It's up to Fievel to get in the way of Cat's plans with the help of canine sheriff, Wylie Burp, and his non-mouse cat sidekick, Tiger.

game.name: Andre Agassi Tennis
game.desc:
A game endorsed by the American player who shocked the tennis world in the early '90s with his "Image is Everything" look, sporting long hair, earrings and colorful shirts, Andre Agassi Tennis includes eight players (male and female and only as expected Agassi is a real player) ranked according to speed of movement and accuracy and strength on serve, backhand and forehand.
The game features all the usual moves: punches, shots, volleys and all sorts of backhand and forehand plays, but unlike other games, precise positioning and timing are crucial to avoid hitting the ball out of the court, swinging your racket in the air or more embarrassingly, letting the ball hit you in the head.

game.name: Animaniacs
game.desc: Animaniacs is a video game that is based on the successful animated series of the same name. Unlike normal platform games, the player generally runs away from enemies rather than fighting them. Characters include Yakko, Wakko and Dot, Pinky and the Brain, most of the supporting cast, as well as Ralph, the Warner Brothers studio guard. Animaniacs became two games that were unrelated to each other in terms of gameplay, despite both being made by Konami.

game.name: Apocalypse II
game.desc:
If you have blinding blindness and nerves of steel, Revelation II may be your ultimate test.
Challenge yourself with this Arcade Shooter from Europe. The graphics look sharp and add to the Sci-Fi feel and theme. The game uses Mode 7 to scale enemies pushing the Super Nintendo's hardware limitations.

game.name: Arcade's Greatest Hits : The Atari Collection 1
game.desc: Arcade's Greatest Hits: The Atari 1 Collection is a game packed with six Atari games from the 70s. These games include: Asteroids, a game where you shoot giant asteroids in space, Battlezone, a game where you are a tank that shoots at other polygonal looking objects, Centipede, a game where you shoot Centipede-like creatures, Missile Command, a game where you defend cities from missiles, Super Breakout, a game in the one where you are a small platform and bouncing a small ball off the blocks and breaking said blocks, and Tempest, a game where you are in a tube like place, playing as a spaceship, Shooting enemies

game.name: Arcana
game.desc:
In this game you play as a boy named Rooks. He is the only one who can save the world from the evil Galneon. With the power of cards, your adventure begins.
All the people you fight with and against are shown on the cards. They may or may not have an elemental attribute. Rooks can summon an elemental to help him. You can only summon one type at a time, and you must find them before you can summon them.

game.name: Archer MacLean's Super Dropzone
game.desc: Turn on and tune in to Drop Zone! Buckle up and get ready for a unique experience: the coolest and most successful shooting game from legendary programmer Archer McLean, updated and improved to take the 90s and beyond. It's a battle of the planets, with a huge number of levels filled with endless waves of enemies and terrifying end-of-level guardians. Super Drop Zone, the most fun game in the entire galaxy, will leave you for dead.

game.name: Arcus Spirits
game.desc: The sorceress Castomira set out to destroy the world, and has managed to defeat all but one of the warriors who have tried to stop her. That lone soul was Princess Leaty, who had a fierce and destructive magical duel with Castomira that lasted several days, ending in victory for Leaty, who locked Castomira in the Dark World using a sword that came to be known as The Power of Leaty. Centuries later, Castomira's followers have stolen the sword and plan to rescue Castomira for final destruction.

game.name: Ardy Lightfoot
game.desc: The story of the game is that the sacred rainbow has been shattered into seven pieces and it is up to Ardy to get them again. Whoever collects all seven pieces will receive a wish. An evil king named Visconti has already obtained one piece and is searching for the others. To this end, he sends various creatures and minions such as Beecroft, Catry and others. These creatures form Ardy's opponents during the game. Ardy is assisted by friends along the way such as the old man (name unknown), Nina, and a mysterious adventurer named Don Jacoby.

game.name: Arkanoid : Doh It Again
game.desc: Like the Breakout game, the player controls the "Vaus", a space container that acts as the game's "oar", preventing a ball from falling off the playing field, attempting to bounce off a number of bricks. The ball hitting a brick makes the brick disappear. When all the bricks are gone, the player moves to the next level, where another brick pattern appears. There are a number of variations (bricks that must be hit multiple times, enemy ships in flight, etc.) and power-up capsules to upgrade the Vaus (expand the Vaus, multiply the number of balls, equip a laser cannon, break directly to the next level, etc.), but the gameplay remains the same.

game.name: Art of Fighting
game.desc: The gameplay differs from most fighting games. In this game, you have a Spirit meter. A Spirit meter is in the game and will decrease as you perform special moves. It can be recharged, but doing so leaves you open to attack. When your health is almost gone, you can perform a secret combo that will unleash a deadly attack on your opponent, as long as you have a full Spirit meter.

game.name: Astérix & Obélix
game.desc: Caesar has erected a new barricade around the village of the indomitable Gauls, to keep them trapped inside. Join Asterix and Obelix and travel through the Roman Empire. Here you will enter a bullfight, participate in a rugby match and even participate in the Olympic Games. Bring a souvenir from each country you visit, to show Caesar that the Gauls are the strongest heroes.

game.name: Astérix
game.desc:
The year is 50 BC. Gaul is completely occupied by the Romans. Well, almost entirely... A small Gaulish village continues to defy the occupying forces, the villagers protected by a magic potion that makes them invincible. But now Obelix has disappeared! The Romans have confirmed his capture and taken him to an unknown destination.
Asterix is ​​a platform game based on the comics of the same name, where the short, mustachioed Gaul has to progress through levels located throughout Europe, fighting Romans and various aggressive animals along the way, to rescue his friend Obelix before Caesar throws him to the lions....

game.name: Axelay
game.desc: Mysterious aliens have invaded the planet Corliss and are slowly depleting the planet's natural resources. Take control of the Axelay prototype ship and use its varied arsenal to fight the fiercest enemies. The game is distinguished from many shoot em ups of the time by some original features, first of all by proposing an alternation between vertical and horizontal scrolling every two levels, with the graphics being sublime for the time (especially the "false 3D" rendering). Another peculiarity is the weapon system. There are no power-ups here, but rather new weapons available at the end of each level. The arsenal is varied and you will have to choose 3 weapons at the beginning of each level, whose power will increase as you progress. Additionally, life management is twofold: if a projectile hit amputates one of your weapons, any collision with an enemy or a wall immediately becomes fatal.

game.name: B.O.B.
game.desc:
B. O. B. has gone out for a ride in his father's flying car, but not before being warned that, if he damages it, he will not drive again for the rest of his life. Everything was going well, until in a moment of distraction due to a sign that said "the end is near", he crashes the car into an asteroid!
Trapped on a strange planet, B. O. B. must make his way through different locations, get a new car, and return home at 11 o'clock.

game.name: Ballz 3D
game.desc: Ballz is a fighting game, but what makes it unique is the fact that the characters are made of balls. The game features a detailed 3D engine with a fixed camera. The game is played like Beat'Em Up. This game is compatible with 2 players, 3 difficulties and up to 21 games.

game.name: Barbie : Super Model
game.desc: In the game, you play as Barbie who is trying to make a name for herself as a model in Hollywood. Working as hard as possible to achieve her achievement, she will need your help to overcome all the obstacles that stand in her way. You must help her turn heads on the streets of Hollywood, put makeup on her and do her hair, go to the wardrobe, keep her in shape through exercise, and most importantly... you must train her for the runway, and then help her when the big day arrives. Do it properly, and Barbie could be Hollywood's next star.

game.name: Barbie Vacation Adventure
game.desc: Barbie: Vacation Adventure is an adventure video game that takes Barbie on educational excursions across the United States of America.

game.name: Barkley : Shut Up and Jam!
game.desc: The renowned Charles Barkley challenges you: shut up and play. This is how you will get into the action of street basketball where it is played 2 on 2. 1 to 4 players can play on 7 different tracks and a spectacular street setting.

game.name: Bass Masters Classic : Pro Edition
game.desc: Bass Masters Classic Pro Edition Snes is an improved version of the BASS Masters Classic, the Pro edition adds several new features for fishing.

game.name: Bass Masters Classic
game.desc: Bass Masters Classic is a fishing game. Choose your character, sail a boat to catch the biggest fish and win the tournament. Buy the right gear and drive your boat to the right spot, cast your hook and wait for the fish to bite!

game.name: Bassin's Black Bass
game.desc: Bassin's Black Bass is a fishing game in which players aspire to become a professional fisherman. It is part of Starfish's Black Bass fishing game series and their second title on the SNES. Originally titled Super Black Bass 2, the game was renamed for release in the United States and approved by professional fishing champion Hank Parker. The goal of the game is for the player to become a professional fisherman and can travel alone or together with Hank.

game.name: Batman : Revenge of the Joker
game.desc:
Precious metals have been disappearing from Gotham's mines; The list includes a metal with a highly toxic compound, used to make explosives for missiles. The Gotham police have exhausted their resources searching for answers, and in desperation, they turn to Batman for help. He knows that these events can only be the result of the machinations of a twisted criminal mind... the Joker has returned!
Batman must follow the clues that lead to the location of the Joker's secret hideout before it is too late.
But it won't be easy.
The Dark Knight must use his new arsenal of weapons to defeat the Joker's evil minions, and rely on his acrobatic strength to overcome the obstacles that will block his path.
Gotham is trusting you to stop the Return of the Joker!

game.name: Batman Forever
game.desc:
Get ready for endless action with BATMAN FOREVER! Batman and Robin explode into Gotham City in a duo-player fighting game! Armed with over 125 incredible attacks, fierce combat moves, and an arsenal of gadgets, the dynamic duo is ready to battle the evil minds of Two-Face and The Riddler!
Without a question... it's BATMAN FOREVER!

game.name: Batman Returns
game.desc: The silence of the night in Gotham is interrupted by the heartbreaking cries of a newborn baby, but what at first should be a source of happiness turns into a nightmare when the creature's parents discover the terrible deformities with which their son was born. In a horrific act of cruelty and desperation, the parents leave the baby in a crib floating down Gotham's river, where it is carried by the current to the former Arctic World of the city's abandoned zoo. There, some gigantic emperor penguins take care of the suffering creature as if it were one of their offspring... 33 years later, just on Christmas Eve, cases of the appearance of a strange dark penguin-shaped figure begin to be reported throughout Gotham. Many believe that it is just an urban legend, but behind it actually hides a sinister plan of revenge against the entire city...

game.name: Battle Blaze
game.desc:
In the land of Virg, it is customary to choose the King in the Tournament of Champions. Aspiring to rule the human world, a jealous demon from the Underworld sends five ghosts to each challenger, so that the last survivor can kill the king. However, one of the contenders, Durill, manages to defeat the ghost that tries to control him, but dies from exhaustion. His son Kerrel takes Durill's place in the Tournament to avenge his father and kill the demon.
Battle Blaze is a one-on-one fighting game viewed from a side-scrolling perspective. Jumping and attacking is all that is needed to control all six characters. Each character uses a different weapon and has some unique special attacks.

game.name: Battle Cars
game.desc: The beginning of the 22nd century saw a truly new world order. Survivors of the devastation lived in city states. Battle Cars...technology...aggression...Battle Cars. As popular as musicians in future cultures, Battle Car drivers are heroes. Their only rule is to win.

game.name: Battle Clash
game.desc: Three years have passed since Anubis suffered defeat at the hands of Mike Anderson. A new era of prosperity has begun to emerge and, with it, the rebirth of some of the earth's great cities. But as quickly as he disappeared after his defeat, Anubis has reappeared to resume his tyranny. Once again the player must join Mike and attempt to crush the iron ruler of Anubis before he can once again lead the land back into the darkest of ages. Afterwards, Anubis reveals that he is only a small part of a much larger threat. A race of aliens called the Eltorians have come to conquer Earth and the Solar System must be defended from their advancing forces. Near the end of the plot a huge spaceship called "Eltoria" emerges when Mike must go to battle with Anubis.

game.name: Battle Grand Prix
game.desc: Players can choose from 40 fictional drivers and 24 teams to play as. The game is always displayed in split screen mode, even when the player is playing alone, in this case the opponent directly behind or in front of the player is displayed in the other window. The car's settings can be adjusted in the garage. Pit stops can be used to repair the car during a race. Breaking the car can also force the player to retire early from the race.

game.name: Battletoads & Double Dragon
game.desc: Dark Queen, main enemy of the Battletoads, made an alliance pact with Shadow Boss, the main enemy of the Double Dragon. In this way, they intended to conquer the earth together and later the universe. To avoid this great threat, the Battletoads and the Double Dragons also made an alliance, to fight together against their enemies.

game.name: Battletoads in Battlemaniacs
game.desc: The story begins when the Toads go to visit the Gyachung fortress in the northern part of Tibet, where the Psicone Corporation is developing a curious virtual reality system. Suddenly, a pig lackey who works for Dark Queen kidnaps the daughter of the president of said corporation, and Zitz. That's when Rash and Pimple decide to enter the game and rescue the kidnapped people and stop, once again, the Dark Queen's plans to conquer the world.

game.name: Bazooka Blitzkrieg
game.desc:
The advanced security systems that protected Earth have failed, so you have become the last hope. Arm yourself with the superscope and save the planet.
Bazooka Blitzkrieg is a first-person shooter that uses the Super Scope light gun. Players start the game in Blitzkreig or Boot Camp mode (Training for each of the levels).

game.name: Beauty and the Beast
game.desc: Beauty and the Beast begins with a parallel narrative to the 1991 animated film: an enchantress transforms an evil prince into a beast until such time as he can learn to love. One day, a woman named Belle comes to his castle. The Beast must chase her through his own deadly castle for her safety. This is a side scrolling action platformer game. The Beast is quite slow, but with a powerful claw attack and a jumping attack. He can also climb certain types of walls and can grab the edges of platforms. He also has a special roar that allows him to stun certain enemies. This becomes necessary in some sections to freeze bats so the Beast can use them as stepping stones to higher platforms.

game.name: Beavis and Butt-Head
game.desc: Beavis and Butthead find out about a new GWAR concert and decide to go without paying anything, crossing the streets, the institute, the hospital and the turbo mall 2000. At the end of each level, they will have to fight with different characters.

game.name: Bebe's Kids
game.desc:
The year was 1989, and in the United States, the prolific comedian Robin Harris premiered his most recent comedy routine: Bébé's Kids. In it he recounted a fictitious trip with his girlfriend, his friend Bébé, and her children; The children, very spoiled, made him suffer a series of misadventures, which constituted the central point of the Show.
Harris died the following year, due to certain health complications. In 1992, it was decided to adapt this comic routine into an animated film; and two years later, someone thought that Bébé's children would be good material for a game.

game.name: Beethoven : The Ultimate Canine Caper!
game.desc: After becoming a father and having puppies, Beethoven is learning that fatherhood is not as easy as it seems. When his four puppies go missing, it's up to you to help Beethoven find them before Missy (Beethoven's partner and the puppies' mom) notices. You will have to guide the intelligent canine through four worlds full of obstacles, distractions and surprises in search of his offspring. And you better not come home empty-handed. Based on the hit film, Beethoven delivers fun platforming action for the whole family.

game.name: Best of the Best : Championship Karate
game.desc:
All your life you have dreamed of being the best. You have studied and trained karate from an early age, even when you had difficulty walking, learning not only the physical aspects of this sport but also the spiritual ones. After a life of full dedication to Karate, your time has come. You are in 16th place in the world ranking. Can you get to the top? Train your karateka to be an unstoppable machine by trying different fighting techniques and the 55 moves you have to master.
This game offers excellent graphics that will make you experience all the karate action.

game.name: Big Sky Trooper
game.desc: One day an alien race of slugs goes out patrolling space, when they suddenly come across the Lucasarts logo. The logo, as we all know, is a statue of a person with his hands stretched towards the sky. Upon seeing this logo, the slugs determine that human life is made up of bones and advertising, two things they simply hate. So they decide to attack humanity. With the slug invasion in full swing, the earth is outnumbered by these slimy beings. Your mission begins here by recruiting super soldiers, Big Sky Troopers, armed with heavy armor to combat this threat. So urgent is the need for these Troopers that recruitment and training are relegated to the background.

game.name: Biker Mice from Mars
game.desc: Based on the cartoons of the same name, Biker Mice From Mars is a motorcycle racing game driven by these mice, very similar to Rock 'n Roll Racing. The races are shown from an isometric perspective and you can choose between six different drivers who differ in levels of acceleration, maximum speed or grip. During races, you can use weapons like mines or missiles to slow down your opponents and collect random bonuses ranging from money to the chance to become temporarily invincible. After each race you will receive money, which you can spend on upgrading tires, armor, engines or weapons. There is also a two-player mode that allows you to play the main race with a friend or compete in a solo race.

game.name: Bill Laimbeer's Combat Basketball
game.desc: The game predicts a science fiction version of the year 2030 in which there are only robot basketball players (except Bill Laimbeer). Basketball teams play in grueling league games where new players are bought and sold. In this future, basketball uses a dedicated robot to take the shot at the beginning of each game, as Bill Laimbeer shot referees sometime before the year 2030. As a result, players now wear armor to their games and throw weapons at each other from the audience.

game.name: Bill Walsh College Football
game.desc:
The game features 24 college football teams from the 1993 season and 24 all-time college football teams from 1978. Game modes include exhibition, playoffs, and all-time playoffs and the SNES version also has an eleven-week season mode. With the National Championship as the ultimate goal.
The playbook consists of 56 offensive plays and 52 defensive plays. On offense, running backs can dive, turn and jump. Additionally, passing is solved by having the receivers in their own windowed boxes. When on defense, defenders can dip into the ball carrier and raise their hands to block kicks or intercept passes.
The game also features four weather conditions (fair, windy, rain, and snow) and three different quarter lengths (20, 40, and 60 minutes).

game.name: BioMetal
game.desc: Receive heart-stopping attacks with Techno music in this confrontation of BioMetal mutants in the last battle for intergalactic domination. You control the impressive firepower of the MF-92GX Halbard, armed with an arsenal of six interchangeable super weapons. Destroy BioMetals with the GAMW, a system biologically designed and built to protect and destroy. Six lethal alien environments for this epic confrontation to the rhythm of a cutting-edge soundtrack, composed by the world famous group Techno 2 Unlimited.

game.name: Blackthorne
game.desc: Sarlac's Lair, deep in the heart of Tuul: A horde of demons prepares the final offensive against King Vlaros. It will be a complete attack, with no intention of leaving survivors. Their goal: gain control of the Lightstone. Stonefist, South of the Border: Before the imminent attack, King Vlaros entrusts his son, Kyle Blackthorne, with the mission of guarding the Lightstone. Kyle is sent through a magical portal, awaiting the day he will return to Tuul to fulfill his destiny. That was 20 years ago...

game.name: BlaZeon : The Bio-Cyborg Challenge
game.desc: In the distant past, humanity saw the opportunity to conquer the cosmos, thanks to advanced technology. To do this, a global army called the Imperial Earth Army (I.E.A.) was created, equipped with the deadliest weapons and the most prepared soldiers for war. During their space travels, the Army came across a race of robots that had biological parts, which they called Bio-Cyborgs. In a desire for domination, the Bio-Cyborgs were captured and used by the I.E.A. to start a revolution, and thus take control of the Earth, since now they were unstoppable. Soon, chaos spread across the planet; Everyone was afraid and they obeyed the I.E.A. without question.

game.name: Bobby's World
game.desc: In the game, Bobby's mother tells him to clean his room. Bobby starts daydreaming about a toy. After beating a level, Bobby has another fantasy about another toy he keeps. The game was canceled

game.name: Bonkers
game.desc: A terrible theft has just occurred in Hollywood: Aladdin's lamp, the voice of Ariel the Little Mermaid, and Mickey Mouse's Sorcerer's Apprentice hat have been stolen. Bonkers and his partner Lucky go in search of the bandits responsible for these disappearances. Platform game inspired by the Disney series Bonkers.

game.name: Boogerman : A Pick and Flick Adventure
game.desc:
It is a dark and stormy night in Professor Stinkbaum's laboratory, where a machine has been built to save the world from pollution, sending waste to the X-cremento dimension thanks to the process of transexistence.
Eccentric millionaire Snotty Ragsdale has taken a job at the laboratory to investigate its safety, and find out exactly where all the pollution is going...he has a bad feeling about this strange device.
Tonight your suspicions will come true...
Due to Snotty's ill-timed sneeze on the machine, the mucosal balance is altered, and the portal to the X-growth dimension increases in power. So much so that, from the other side, a villain known as Booger Meister can peek into our world, and steal an important piece of the Professor's invention... now our world is in danger! Not only from being filled with contaminants, but also from being sent down the toilet from the other dimension. Fortunately, Snotty has an alter-ego...

game.name: Boxing Legends of the Ring
game.desc: Following a style of play similar to that of the previous installment, you follow the career of a created boxer, going through increasingly difficult and experienced rivals. As you win fights, you can assign skill points to your boxer, to distribute between attack, defense and resistance. This, along with training, will allow you to customize your abilities to fit your fighting style. Positioned behind your boxer, you will be able to move freely throughout the ring, and you will see interesting effects such as the damage indicator, and a certain Fade-out when you are about to be eliminated. Again, during the fight you will only hear the sound effects.

game.name: Boxing Legends of the Ring
game.desc: Following a style of play similar to that of the previous installment, you follow the career of a created boxer, going through increasingly difficult and experienced rivals. As you win fights, you can assign skill points to your boxer, to distribute between attack, defense and resistance. This, along with training, will allow you to customize your abilities to fit your fighting style. Positioned behind your boxer, you will be able to move freely throughout the ring, and you will see interesting effects such as the damage indicator, and a certain Fade-out when you are about to be eliminated. Again, during the fight you will only hear the sound effects.

game.name: Brain Lord
game.desc: Beyond memory there was a time when dragons and men traveled together through the skies. The blood of the Dragon Warrior flows deeply through your family. Now, you're the only one left. Your father has spent a lifetime searching for the Ancient Dragons, a life lived in vain. Now it's up to you to find them. You will find yourself in a world full of puzzles and riddles, enough to drive even the most rational person crazy. There are too many unanswered questions in your mind. What awaits me? Where do I start? What will I find? One thing is for sure, a dark presence awaits you. Can you find the secret? Will you be strong enough to survive? Are you a BRAIN LORD? We will see...

game.name: Bram Stoker's Dracula
game.desc: BRAM STOKER™'s Dracula for Super NES goes straight for your jugular with goosebump-inducing action so real you won't believe it. As vampire hunter Jonathan Harker, you'll delve into the world of the undead in the latest in interactive films. Seven terrifying levels, which incorporate different daily and night sections, in addition to the incredible three-dimensional graphics that bring to life the gloomy and dark dungeons of Dracula's castle, the horrible lands of Transylvania and the dark chambers of 19th-century London. XIX. During the day you must exterminate blood-thirsty rats and poisonous spiders while searching for weapons. At sunset, beware, the Prince of Darkness rises and looks for you... like a bat, a wolf, or even like an old man. Without a doubt, Bram Stoker's Dracula must be stopped!

game.name: Brandish
game.desc:
Brandish is a top-down action RPG in which you face hundreds of creatures using different weapons and armor, as well as using magic to obtain the treasures hidden in their dungeons.
You control Varik, a traveler who is accused by the sorceress Alexa of killing his master. Alexa, thirsty for revenge, attacks Varik with her magic, causing the earth to open and both fall into an underground kingdom from which Varik must escape using weapons and magic.

game.name: Brawl Brothers
game.desc: People are going missing in Bayside City and rumors say that someone responsible for conducting a human shadow cloning experiment is responsible. For Rick (akk.a. Hack) and Doug (ak.a. Slash), this situation has become personal. Especially after three friends from his martial arts gym are kidnapped. The duo headed to the enemy's secret air fortress to resolve this. These guys know all the moves, from martial arts to pro wrestling throws, and they don't hesitate to use them. They are not afraid to use knives, bats and other things they find to get the job done. And if that wasn't enough, when they get hurt they get angry, and you really don't want to mess with them at that time. They ignore damage and hit even harder than usual! They are ready for action. The question is: you?

game.name: BreakThru!
game.desc: In the award-winning tradition of Tetris, comes BreakThru! This time, your goal is to make as many bricks disappear as you can before time runs out. Click on a group of bricks of the same color to remove the bricks and make the wall fall.

game.name: Breath of Fire II
game.desc: The incredible sequel to the hit RPG Breath of Fire is here! You are the last member of the Dragon clan and fight to rid the world of a growing evil. A cast of unusual and exciting companions will join your adventures through a land filled with magic and mystery. You'll encounter strange mystical objects, memorable monsters, and exotic locations in your quest to defeat evil. There are a lot of strategies and spells in the adventure that awaits you. Breath of Fire II is the ultimate role-playing game!

game.name: Breath of Fire
game.desc: Long ago, in the days of darkness and magic, a young wanderer comes face to face with his destiny. You control the destiny of Ryu, a young warrior and descendant of the Light Dragon Clan. Together, with your mystical friend, Nina, you must search for magical spells and mysterious secrets. Along the way, gain experience and skill as you fight strange monsters. Discover valuable secrets that will help you on your adventure and you will discover the secrets of the Dragon Clan.

game.name: Brett Hull Hockey 95
game.desc:
AL MICHEAELS CALLS PLAY FOR PLAY!
Brutal controls. Awesome Stick Saves. 100 MPH One-Timers. This is Hockey with Attidude.
All the hard-hitting players in the NHLPA. True NHL style stats. Real ice hockey action. In this game you are playing forever. Control the blue line with guys like Leetch and Bourque. Blank-'em in the crease with guys like Richter and Irbe. Move down the wing and get into the slot behind legends like Modano, Yzerman, Bure, and of course, Brett Hull. Can you make the cut? Only the statistics will tell. Shots, controls, penalties and passing percentages. Make it or fail, it's crunch time. And this time, it's real.

game.name: Brett Hull Hockey
game.desc: Golden Brett returns to the SNES in the improved and updated BRETT HULL HOCKEY '95. The second game in this series also features a full NHLPA license, so you're sure to find your favorite players ready to hit the ice. Use every little trick in the book to get the job done: one-timers, fake shots, drop passes, and even dekes.

game.name: Bronkie the Bronchiasaurus
game.desc: You must help Bronkie and Rexo find the missing machine parts by blowing out the dust with your lungs, and hitting enemies with your feather dusters, before the dust returns and everyone chokes on the dust! But don't run into cigarette smoke or dust storms, otherwise your vision will be obscured, and you'll have a hard time figuring out where to go, encountering enemies everywhere!

game.name: Brunswick World Tournament of Champions
game.desc: The greatest exponents of the practice of bowling such as Mike Aulby, Randy Peterson and Johnny Petraglia meet in this game to face each other in any of the 6 available tournaments

game.name: Brutal : Paws of Fury
game.desc: Every four years, on the hidden Brutal Island, the fiercest martial arts fighters in the world are invited to compete in the toughest of tournaments. Only the winner of this tournament will earn the privilege of challenging the Dalai Llama, the world's greatest fighter, for the coveted Celestial Championship belt.

game.name: Bubsy II
game.desc:
A sinister character named Oinker P. Hamm tries to build the best museum in the world. Their project is called El Amazatorium, and includes the construction of a time machine that recovers objects from the past. But the truth is that the machine is being used to steal those objects, through the use of portals...
Bubsy and company, after an incident in their car, stumble (literally) into the museum. Curiosity prompts them to enter... and soon, Bubsy realizes that he is left alone! The others have been lost between the portals, and our hero must undertake search and rescue work inside the museum.

game.path: ./Bubsy in Claws Encounters of the Furred Kind (USA).zip
game.name: Bubsy in : Claws Encounters of the Furred Kind
game.desc: Bubsy is a feline that exudes personality, addicted to speed and adventure. But he has a problem: the world has been invaded by the Woolies, curious beings who have stolen all the balls of wool. And it's well known how much cats love that! Bubsy will take on the mission to recover everything stolen, on a journey that will take him around the world and beyond.
game.image: ./media/images/Bubsy in Claws Encounters of the Furred Kind (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Bubsy in Claws Encounters of the Furred Kind (USA).png

game.name: Bugs Bunny : Rabbit Rampage
game.desc:
Bugs Bunny, the world's most beloved carrot rodent, has set off in search of his nemesis, who has constantly been painting him in the craziest scenarios... a crazy animator has taken on Bugs!
Luckily, Bugs has an extensive Acme arsenal at his disposal. He'll throw pies in the faces of his enemies, use mirrors to deflect miniaturizing rays, paint white stripes on the backs of black cats... there are many tricks up this clever rabbit's sleeve. The animator will throw Bugs into the middle of dangerous situations, each one different from the other: one moment he will find himself misleading Elmer Fudd's hounds in the middle of the search, and the next he will be in a ring facing The Crusher face to face.

game.path: ./Bulls vs Blazers and the NBA Playoffs (USA).zip
game.name: Bulls vs Blazers and the NBA Playoffs
game.desc: Bulls vs Blazers and the NBA Playoffs pays tribute to the legendary playoffs of the 1991-1992 season. The official license ensures that you can play with the real names of the players, such as Michael Jordan, the best player of the season, as well as with the two All Star selections.
game.image: ./media/images/Bulls vs Blazers and the NBA Playoffs (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Bulls vs Blazers and the NBA Playoffs (USA).png

game.name: Bust-A-Move
game.desc: Bust-A-Move, also known as Puzzle Bobble, is a simple puzzle game for one or two players inspired by the popular arcade Bubble Bobble, featuring characters and themes from said game. The idea of ​​this game is to eliminate all the bubbles from the screen, to move on to the next stage. The mechanism is simple: when three or more bubbles of the same color come together, they explode and disappear. The problem is that the bubbles fall where you want them! Featuring Bub and Bob, the Bubble Bobble characters, this is a very fun, totally addictive game. Versus mode will keep you busy for hours... especially if you're playing against a friend!

game.name: Cacoma Knight in Bizyland
game.desc: Bizyland was a rich and peaceful land, a true paradise. Its citizens spent all day working happily; The king, with very little to do, dedicated himself to playing golf. That's how things were, until that day... That terrible day when Wagamama, the queen of Lazyland, used her magic mirror to exchange the countries. Suddenly, Bizyland had switched places with its terrible neighbor to the north. Wagamama now owned the riches of Bizyland! Having fulfilled its end of the bargain, the magic mirror whispered to Wagamama... "I have made your wish come true. Now I will fulfill mine." The mirror put the princess of Bizyland in the mirror world, dividing her image into many pieces. If the princess is not found before the next full moon, she will be trapped forever!

game.name: Cal Ripken Jr. Baseball
game.desc: The world record for consecutive games played is held by the legendary Cal Ripken, the central character of this title in which you will feel the experience of a complete baseball game. You can choose 16 teams without the official MLB license and two special All-Stars teams.

game.name: California Games II
game.desc: Boost your bravery and cool to the max in several innovative California action sports. Show off your skills by speeding around the skate park, bodyboarding on icebreakers, sliding over the ocean, and snowboarding down dangerous slopes.

game.name: Cannon Fodder
game.desc:
Don't wait to have them on you. Don't fool yourself by saying that it will all be over soon. Don't try to suppress the screams. And don't forget to wash your hands when you're done. CANNON FOLDER: War has never been so much fun
Control a squad of men in real time in this fun mix of action and strategy.

game.name: Cannondale Cup
game.desc: Put on your music, choose your Cannondale mountain bike and get ready. Face the toughest competitors, obstacles and enemy bosses trying to get you out of the way. Punch at full speed, jump and punch your way across deserts, mountains and cities to achieve victory.

game.name: Capcom's MVP Football
game.desc: It's 4th and goal, there are 5 seconds left on the clock and you lose by 4 points, facing the toughest defense in the NFL, you run, turn to the right and look for an open receiver and throw a great pass... you decide in CAPCOM's MVP FOOTBALL! Choose any AFC or NFC team. You can play in different types of weather and pitch conditions, it's the closest thing to real American football without getting dirty. It has three game modes: VS, Playoffs and MVP Mode. Choose from over 30 offensive and 25 defensive tactics. Officially licensed by the NFL.

game.name: Capcom's Soccer Shootout
game.desc: With a dozen teams that you can guide through 6 game modes, Soccer Shootout is one of the titles that provokes the most nostalgia among former SNES fans, mainly for being one of the first to accept four simultaneous players. Each team has its own strategies, styles and formations, achieving a wide variety of tactical options.

game.name: Captain America and the Avengers
game.desc: Captain America and The Avengers is an arcade video game released by Data East in 1991. It features the Marvel Comics characters The Avengers in a side-scrolling brawl and shooting adventure to defeat the evil Red Skull.

game.name: Captain Commando
game.desc: You must choose one of these four characters, who must fight their way through an army of genetically engineered super-criminals, traveling through a series of locations such as the bank, the museum, the circus, the aquarium and many others, until reaching a planet called "Callisto", where the evil behind "Scumocide" awaits. All four characters have their own special attacks. Captain Commando can use the power of his suit to shoot electricity through his palms. Baby Head walks around in a mech suit that does more damage. Mack can use short knives. Each location ends with the character defeating a boss before moving on to the next.

game.name: Captain Novolin
game.desc: Captain Novolin is the only one who can stop the alien Blubberman and rescue the mayor. He rides a motorboat and needs to avoid invading aliens who have turned into junk food by eating healthy food to keep his blood glucose levels within a safe zone.

game.name: Carrier Aces
game.desc: Players control an airplane pilot from the United States or the Japanese Empire. Based aboard an aircraft carrier, the player can participate in the following missions: 1vs1 dogfights, strafing runs on enemy ships, dive bombing on enemy ships, torpedoing enemy ships, and carrier landings. All missions are made up of these elements, however campaign missions also feature the ability to decide which aircraft to take into battle, each with their own statistics, and track progress on an area map. When two forces face each other on this map, players can choose which aircraft to bring into battle and will lock in a 1v1 battle with the enemy.

game.name: Casper
game.desc: Casper the Friendly Ghost's 3 uncles have turned Dr. Harvey into a mass of ectoplasm. Now it's up to Casper and Dr. Harvey's daughter Kat to find a way to rescue Dr. Harvey. To accomplish this task, they must find seven Cell Integrator Pods located in Whipstaff Manor. Once found, the capsules can be used in the Lazarus Machine. This machine has the power to cure Dr. Harvey of his situation.

game.name: Castlevania : Dracula X
game.desc: In Transylvania, people lived in fear of the evil Count Dracula. The latest incarnation of evil, Dracula passed his dark hand across the land, turning people into mere sheep for his bloodlust. But when a young woman named Sonia Belmont came out to confront him, he made a terrible mistake: he underestimated her. Thus, the battle between Dracula and the Belmont family began.

game.name: Champions : World Class Soccer
game.desc:
This soccer game offers 32 national teams to play, without showing any of the players' names. Shown from a slightly tilted side perspective in 3rd person, players can do an exhibition match, a full tournament, or go against a human player in 2-player exhibition mode. Different teams are ranked by speed, attack and defense, and different team formations can be selected.
The gameplay is very basic: players can pass, shoot, tackle with a third button used to switch players. In the options menu, fouls and offsides can be disabled, the amount of time per half can be determined, and there is a radar and mini-map to follow other players. The European edition is endorsed by Ryan Giggs and the game uses a password system to continue tournaments.

game.name: Championship Pool
game.desc: Championship Pool is a pool game in which players can play an 8-ball or 9-ball pool tournament, starting with the BCA Regional Championship where the player must defeat 32 opponents in a first-to-four-game match. If the player loses against any of the 32 opponents, then they will be eliminated from the tournament. The winner of that will then go to the World Championships.

game.name: Championship Soccer '94
game.desc: It's addictive! No other soccer game compares. Created for hardcore soccer fans, Championship Soccer '94 offers the ultimate in speed, game control and ultra-realistic gameplay. It is the perfect soccer game for players who demand an unbeatable combination of strategy and action. Take control of one of 100 European clubs or national teams around the world. Excellent game with unique height control and ball curve.

game.name: Chester Cheetah : Too Cool to Fool
game.desc: One day when Chester Cheetah was riding a motorcycle through his beloved Hip City, carelessness behind the wheel meant he suffered an accident, ending up with his vehicle in pieces. The evil Mean Eugene and his dog were lying in wait, and took advantage of the moment to steal all the parts of the vehicle, after locking Chester in the zoo. Of course, now Chester wants to get his motorcycle back and get back to town, so he'll immediately begin his search... Unfortunately, getting to the places where Eugene has hidden the pieces won't be an easy task!

game.name: Chester Cheetah : Wild Wild Quest
game.desc: Hello! I'm Chester Cheetah, and I invite you on a wild quest! I was finally able to escape the Four Corners Zoo and begin my journey in search of Hip City... but Mean Eugene keeps getting in my way. While I was traveling, having the map safely stored in my motorcycle bag, Eugene managed to pass me, stealing it from me! Immediately that rat got on his airplane, and scattered my map all over the country. Now Mean Eugene is hunting me, while I search from town to town for each of the pieces of my map. And when I gather all ten, I can resume my search for Hip City. You will have to be attentive, because you can choose to move in any direction across the country; As you find the pieces, you can guide yourself with the map to see which cities the others have.

game.name: Choplifter III
game.desc: Choplifter III for the SNES features completely different levels from the Game Gear and GameBoy versions, and plays a little differently than other Choplifter games. While the controls and basic gameplay have not changed significantly, and the main objective of each level remains to rescue a certain number of hostages, Choplifter III is faster and more action-oriented than previous Choplifter games.

game.name: Chrono Trigger
game.desc: The millennium. A portal is open. The time chain is broken. A young man is transported to the past, altering the course of history and the outcome of the future. He has to find his way home, but first he must travel to the outer edges of time to repair the world's chronology. Along the way, he encounters strange friends and enemies, uses incredible devices and vehicles, and penetrates and neutralizes strongholds from the past, present, and future. A paradox has been created. If you don't restore the order of time, nothing will ever be the same. He is the one who will become a hero. He is Cronus.

game.name: Chuck Rock
game.desc: Chuck Rock is your average caveman. He likes to spend Sunday afternoons watching football and drinking beer. Unfortunately, his peaceful existence is interrupted one day when his wife, Ophelia Rock, is kidnapped by the town wierdo, Gary Gritter. So, Chuck is pretty upset about this whole situation and you have to help him make things right.

game.name: Clay Fighter : Tournament Edition
game.desc:
Clayfighter: Tournament Edition is a modification of the original game exclusively for Super Nintendo, various bugs were fixed and changes were made. It continues with the same fighting game theme, characterized by its characters being modeled from clay.
The changes were: Most of the game's scenarios were modified. Bad Mr. Frosty and Blob's scenarios do not present changes (as well as N. Boss's scenario, since it was only a recolor of Blob's scenario), however the scenarios of the other six characters were edited.

game.name: Clay Fighter 2 : Judgment Clay
game.desc: Bad Mister Frosty is polished and faster than greased lightning. This tough snowman has a mess on his head...but there's a new bunny in town with a hare-trigger temperament. You can bet the fur will fly when this wild hare unleashes a barrage of rabbit punches in Bad Mister Frosty. Could there be a new top bunny in town, or will he get his cottontail kicked?

game.name: Clay Fighter
game.desc: A meteorite, composed of clay, hits a humble American circus, contaminating all the circus employees and transforming them into strange caricatures with new superpowers. The game itself is a parody of other classics such as Street Fighter, where we will see characters imitating some of the most representative movements with a certain grace, at the same time they also parody in a certain way the Double K.O.

game.name: Claymates
game.desc: From the creators of Clay Fighter comes a game about a shape-shifting ball of clay. You play as a boy named Clayton, whose father has developed a serum to turn humans into animals. However, an evil shaman desires this serum, and when he is denied ownership, he kidnaps Clayton's father and turns Clayton into a ball of clay. It's up to the unlikely hero to rescue his father, the serum, and the world!

game.name: Cliffhanger
game.desc:
Standard side-scrolling fighter based on the Stallone film of the same name. Sly must battle thugs and the elements while tracking suitcases of stolen money falling around the peaks of the Rocky Mountains. Combat follows the Final Fight standard, broken up by some avalanche climbing and running (or 3-D snowboarding on the Sega CD).
Enemies are standard brawlers, occasionally carrying weapons and knives that the player can pick up. The game tends to follow a pattern of facing a natural hazard (climbing a cliff, jumping gaps), then locking the screen for a combat segment, nature again, fighting again, etc. The fighting moves available are limited, compared to other games of this type, and the ability to hit an enemy character is noticeably less precise.

game.name: Clue
game.desc: In addition to playing by the original rules, Clue has an additional mode that allows movement through "points." Each turn starts with nine points and each action the player takes costs points. The player can only do as many things as he has points. For example, changing from square to square costs one point, so a hint costs three points. Many players prefer this game mode as it makes the game more balanced with each player getting the same number of "moves" each turn.

game.path: ./College Football USA '97 - The Road to New Orleans (USA).zip
game.name: College Football USA 97
game.desc: September is a wonderful time of year as the leaves begin to change, kids go back to school, and Christmas is just a few months away, but it also means college football season. Well, now you can host your own college football season any time you want thanks to COLLEGE FOOTBALL USA '97. Choose from 111 Division I teams and hit the gridiron for some hard-hitting soccer action as you try to lead your team to the national championship. There are eight different conferences you can compete in with the ACC, Big 12, Big East, SEC, WAC, Big 10, Conference USA, and PAC 10, each with their own style of play.
game.image: ./media/images/College Football USA '97 - The Road to New Orleans (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/College Football USA '97 - The Road to New Orleans (USA).png

game.name: College Slam
game.desc: As part of the NBA Jam basketball game series, College Slam lets you choose from over 40 real college teams and participate in head-to-head games, tournament games, and season-long games. The gameplay is two-on-two arcade style, with backboard smashing wild dunks, power-ups, and other crazy moves. The game also features fight songs from all available teams.

game.path: ./Congo - The Movie - The Secret of Zinj (USA) (Proto).zip
game.name: Congo : The Movie, Secret of Zinj
game.desc:
Congo: The Secret of Zinj is an unreleased Super Nintendo game based on the hit 1995 film. The game was canceled after a short period of development and testing indicated that it was not of sufficient quality to be released. The fact that the film had a disappointing performance also played a role.
Congo is divided into five different types of gameplay. The main levels include a light gun-style shooter, a raft level that functions as an "avoid the edges" maze, a sliding section where the character must jump to avoid spikes and other obstacles, a rail platforming level, and a 2.5D aerial perspective stage.
game.image: ./media/images/Congo - The Movie - The Secret of Zinj (USA) (Proto).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Congo - The Movie - The Secret of Zinj (USA) (Proto).png

game.name: Congo's Caper
game.desc: If you were a monkey having a nice time in the jungle with your girl, and a magical ruby ​​falls from the sky and hits you both, turning you into half-human while a little demon kidnaps your girl, what would you do? You would go after them and you wouldn't stop until you saved her. You are Congo, the monkey turned superkid and only you can defend the law of the jungle. But not everything is jungle, the search for little Congette will take you to ghost towns, pirate ships, ninja castles and even the belly of a Tyrannosaurus. This is not the time to eat bananas, I'd better put on your overalls.

game.name: Contra III : The Alien Wars
game.desc:
In the year 2636, the raging alien war continues and only two soldiers, Jimbo and Sully, can put an end to the invasion. Fight your way through six levels full of shooting and non-stop action in the American version of the Super NES console classic, where you can enjoy individual games or play with a friend.
Pick up upgrades like bombs, flamethrowers, scatter beams, lasers, and missile launchers. Take control of Jimbo and Sully on a journey through devastated cities and use aerial vehicles and even missiles to finally reach the alien base, where you must take down the final boss once and for all.

game.name: Cool Spot
game.desc: BY NO MEANS! Your SPOT friends are locked up! YOU MUST HELP THEM! You, as Cool SPOT, are here to save them and fix the day. Stop gawking at the idyllic landscape, incredible animations and spectacular sound around you. Let's play, man! It's a delicate situation.

game.name: Cool World
game.desc: It is an imaginary, but real, world that exists in another dimension, where cartoon characters, called Doodles, come to life. It was Vegas Vinnie who first found the tunnel that connects the real world with the COOL WORLD. There he found the golden spike, the key of power that maintains the balance between the two worlds. To keep it safe he hid it on top of the Las Vegas hotel. Now, a Doodle named Holli Would wants the golden spike and its power, she wants to get a real body and live in our world. If he gets it, both worlds are in danger! As Frank Harris, your mission is to prevent Holli from entering the real world.

game.name: Cutthroat Island
game.desc: Sharpen your long sword for the last battle on the high seas. As you loot and discover treasures, precious stones and gold bars, battles of bloodthirsty pirates with knives and guns await you. Chart your course through dangerous places, but think twice before you set sail, the dead tell no tales on Cutthroat Island.

game.name: Cyber Spin
game.desc: The Grand Prix championship is not for the weak! Seven drivers from all over the world want to be No. 1. Pilot your Cyber ​​car to victory on the most dangerous circuits ever invented.rnCompetition requires good reflexes and nerves of steel. Turn tight curves, cross deep canyons and accelerate on city streets. Don't let a single car pass you, to win you have to drive as if your life depended on it. Accept the challenge and do it our way, through the most difficult terrain in countries like Peru, Kenya, Spain, England, USA, and some other surprises.

game.name: Cybernator
game.desc: Year 2065. The nations of Earth have once again divided into two great powers. The line dividing these new enemies reaches all the way to the lunar border, where Axis forces have built a base capable of launching intergalactic battlecruisers. Your mission is to take command of the Cybernator and face the most powerful enemy in the SNES universe. You will face a stunning graphic display of destruction and carnage so realistic and intense that you will want to run and hide. The sound effects alone will make your guts flutter as if you were standing next to a speaker at a Rock concert.

game.name: Daffy Duck : The Marvin Missions
game.desc: The fate of the planets rests squarely with Duck Dodgers - aka Daffy Duck - the intrepid space crusader from the cartoon adventure series. Marvin the Martian, the diabolical extraterrestrial, is about to destroy the galaxy. So choose your weapon and help Daffy in this crazy chase from planet to planet. Search secret chambers and caves for mystery bonuses, help Daffy protect himself from needles shot by crazed cacti, avoid an explosion from enemy space mines, fight an underwater army? You have to stop Marvin!

game.name: Darius Twin
game.desc: For millennia, the space tyrant Belser and his cosmic minions have terrorized the once peaceful galaxy. Now, no sector is safe from these stellar mercenaries and their evil empire. The Galactic Federation has finally asked two of its best pilots to help them with their Silver Hawk ships to confront the evil followers of Belser and rescue the planet Darius. Slip into the pilot's seat and prepare to carry out a solo mission against Belser's forces, or take on the enemy with another Federation pilot in a two-player simultaneous attack. The future of the galaxy depends on the success of this dangerous mission.

game.name: David Crane's Amazing Tennis
game.desc: Swap the racket for the controller, sports video games have just taken a leap into a new dimension of realism, developed by David Crane, a pioneer in the industry and one of the most successful game designers. David Crane's Amazing Tennis uses 22 different depth planes and excellent animation quality to provide an unbeatable gaming experience. 1 or 2 player mode, slow motion replays and the real voice of famous chair umpire Frank Hammond.

game.name: Daze Before Christmas
game.desc: Christmas is a time where people gather, eat and give each other gifts. But this year there has been a problem. You see... while Santa was sleeping in his bed, an evil, cold snowman has kidnapped Santa's elves and reindeer. There won't be any Christmas if Santa doesn't get them back.

game.name: Demolition Man
game.desc: In a dystopian future of Los Angeles, in 1996. John Spartan is the most fearsome police officer in the country and pursues his enemy, Simon Phoenix. However, in doing so, he kills several innocent civilians and they are both sentenced to cryostasis rehabilitation where they are brainwashed for 30 years. However, the brainwashing does not go as planned, and upon awakening, Phoenix plunges into a new wave of crimes. However, in 30 years the world has changed and Los Angeles has become San Angeles, a utopian society free of violence. As a holdover from a more violent past, police officer John Spartan is sent again to capture Phoenix.

game.name: Demon's Crest
game.desc: One day, six magic stones fell from the sky, into the demon realm. Engraved on the stones were the emblems of Fire, Earth, Air, Water, Time and Paradise. Soon, demons began to fight over these magical stones, and a civil war broke out in the kingdom. It was then that the demon Firebrand appeared, a fallen, impious spawn of the flames of hell, and rose victorious over his fellow humans. But Firebrand's problems have only just begun...

game.name: Dennis the Menace
game.desc: Grab your slingshot, water gun and slingshot. Margaret and Joey are missing, as is Mr. Wilson's valuable coin collection. Can Dennis sneak into Mr. Wilson's house and find his slingshot and slingshot without being discovered? It's going to be difficult. But he needs his weapons to face the beast Betty Sue Dubrovski, the crazy car, the disgusting fish and the scary Switchblade Sam. On this nighttime escapade, bees, bulldogs, birds, frogs and even rabbits will be a threat to Dennis.

game.name: Desert Strike : Return to the Gulf
game.desc: General Mubaba, terrorist leader, surprises the world by invading and conquering a small but important Emirate. The General is unbalanced, and has built his reputation on showing no mercy to those who stand in his way; From his headquarters, he plans a missile attack that could destroy the world. The president has put the best helicopter in the special forces squadron in charge of the situation; a pilot of exceptional skills, whose mission is to prevent a massive air raid. Now, the anonymous pilot and his helicopter have reached the Gulf, in an attempt to prevent a third World War.

game.name: D-Force
game.desc: In 1991, a powerful dictator, owner of oil wealth in the Middle East, has waged a battle against the world. You must pilot an Apache nuclear helicopter (D-Force) through six countries, infiltrating the headquarters of your enemies. In addition to constant enemy attacks, this leader has scientists developing prehistoric beasts to knock out your helicopter, and we're not talking about ordinary dinosaurs, but creatures that literally eat helicopters. You have the latest weapons on your side, and the further you go, the more chances you will have to use them. If you are able to defeat the enemy... wait, be careful! We're losing you! Your radio is stopping working... Good luck! Now you are alone. Your helicopter's propellers are spinning. There is no turning back now! Fear not, you are in charge of the ultimate weapon: D-Force!

game.name: Dig & Spike Volleyball
game.desc:
Dig & Spike Volleyball is a volleyball game where the player can choose between two different locations, each with its own rules. They can choose an indoor event, where they can choose from international teams and compete in a 6 vs 6 person team with rules and regulations, giving it an authentic feel. There is also a 2 vs. beach game. 2 in which the game is more relaxed, which is ideal for beginners to the game, allowing them to learn the basics such as serving, shooting and blocking.
There is also a practice mode that shows players the controls of the game and helps them get started. The game also contains two-player action that allows friends to compete head-to-head.

game.name: Dino Dini's Soccer!
game.desc: The creator of KICK OFF (the best-selling soccer game series of the time) presents DINO DINI'S SOCCER, a game so advanced and full of features that it will keep you busy at least until the next World Cup. Six different fields, including one with snow, menu system with icons, three different field views and four game modes: league, arcade, friendly and World Cup.

game.name: Dinocity
game.desc: While walking with a friend through your father's laboratory, you are suddenly sent back in time to when dinosaurs roamed the Earth! Lucky for you, dinosaurs are fans of time travelers, and they're willing to help you get back to the future. The only problem is that the Neanderthals are not very happy with the strange visitors from another time, and have made a plan to destroy DinoCity and all its inhabitants. Now you have to join your new friends and fight against the prehistoric terrorists to save the dinosaurs and their home. Jump on the back of a dinosaur and crush the Neanderthals, or you can challenge them to a hand-to-hand fight. In DINOCITY the fate of the dinosaurs is in your hands!

game.name: Dirt Racer
game.desc: Players must drive their dirt track racing vehicle through a road rally. The car comes complete with a speedometer (in kilometers), a lap counter and a lap time counter. There are a predetermined number of opportunities to complete the game, like in Super Mario Kart and F-Zero. If the player cannot beat the game in that number of tries, then the player gets an automatic play. A yellow smiley is displayed to track driver performance. If he is smiling, then the player is winning. Otherwise, the player is losing the game.

game.name: Dirt Trax FX
game.desc: Dirt Trax FX puts you in control of a racing motorcycle, where you must compete against 16 riders for elimination or glory. Includes 8 different characters, 3 difficulties, 3 game modes, split-screen racing, multiplayer option and a Password system.

game.name: Disney's Aladdin
game.desc: Discover a whole new world of adventure... For years, Jafar, the Sultan's evil advisor has searched for a magical treasure: a single lamp that holds the key to the world's greatest power. With this goal in sight, Jafar discovers that only one person in the world can claim the magic lamp from the dreaded Cave of Wonders, one whose rags hide a pure heart, a diamond in the rough! Join Aladdin and his pet monkey, Abu, as they race through the market toward their date with destiny. Watch as Jafar tricks our hero and his friend into retrieving the lamp from the dangerous Cave of Wonders. But Aladdin and Abu outwit Jafar, unleashing the power of a mad blue genie! Now Aladdin will have the chance to spoil Jafar's devious plans and win the hand of the beautiful princess Jasmine. But it will take more than magic to make your wishes come true...

game.name: Donkey Kong Country : Competition Cartridge
game.desc: Here's the speed fan's version of the biggest video game hit of all time. We collected the five-minute timed action games played at the BlockBuster II World Video Game Championship. Now it's your turn. The clock is ticking as you race through Donkey Kong Country. Forget about bananas, just complete as many levels as you can. To go through eight random levels, you must have a lot of juice. Do you think it's easy? Only the few and the fleet will be able to accept the challenge, because Nintendo minted only 2,500 of this special edition.

game.name: Donkey Kong Country 2 : Diddy's Kong Quest
game.desc:
The evil Captain K. Rool has kidnapped Donkey Kong and, as ransom, demands his stash of bananas. But the Kongs aren't going to give up that easily!
In this sequel to the hit Donkey Kong Country set in the pirate world, guide Diddy and Dixie Kong through eight wild worlds of comical action where you will have to combat the numerous Kremlings that infest Crocodile Island.
Reveal secrets, learn new skills, meet new members of the Kong family, and take the reins of new animal friends like Squitter the spider and Rattly the rattlesnake.

game.path: ./Donkey Kong Country 3 - Dixie Kong's Double Trouble! (USA).zip
game.name: Donkey Kong Country 3 : Dixie Kong's Double Trouble!
game.desc:
Donkey Kong and Diddy have been kidnapped by the Kremlings, so Dixie Kong and her new ally, Kiddy, must embark on a mission to rescue them.
In the latest installment of the Donkey Kong Country trilogy, you control Dixie and Kiddy, using their abilities to traverse dangerous terrain, search for the elusive banana birds, and defeat KAOS, the new boss of the Kremlings.
Dixie Kong's Double Trouble brings you double the fun with the usual animal friends and new additions, a team mode and a competition mode for two players and even more impressive graphics.
game.image: ./media/images/Donkey Kong Country 3 - Dixie Kong's Double Trouble! (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Donkey Kong Country 3 - Dixie Kong's Double Trouble! (USA).png

game.name: Donkey Kong Country
game.desc: Join DK and Diddy in their quest to recover their stolen supply of bananas. Enjoy more than 30 levels that will test you, take a ride on the back of your friends from the animal kingdom and survive the dizzying phases of mining carts. Don't be the last monkey and play Donkey Kong Country!

game.name: Doom Troopers : Mutant Chronicles
game.desc: For the first time, humanity is about to be overwhelmed by the terrible forces of the Dark Legion. The malevolent troops of Algeroth have emerged from their portal and established citadels across the solar system. Megacorporations, desperate to maintain their power, deployed Doomtroopers to defend the solar system. The Doomtroopers' mission will be to annihilate the Dark Legion, and force Algeroth to return through his portal, trapping him in the Dark Symmetry.

game.name: Doom
game.desc: The Union Aerospace Corporation has been experimenting with teleportation technology on the Mars moons Phobos and Deimos. After the first progress, something goes wrong. It seems that scientists have opened a direct door to hell. The Phobos base is filled with demonic creatures, and Deimos simply disappears. A squad of marines is sent to Phobos, but all but one are quickly annihilated. The surviving marine must face the demons alone.

game.name: Doomsday Warrior
game.desc: The Doom Squad is a group of fighters under the control of an evil sorcerer. They threaten the earth and bring destruction. One of the Doom Squad members betrays his group and becomes the doomsday warrior. This warrior must defeat the other members of the Squad and finally the magician controls everything.

game.name: Double Dragon V : The Shadow Falls
game.desc: The Master of Shadows has created a deadly virus with which he plans to destroy the world. You will have to fight many evil characters before facing the Shadow Master and defeating him, and saving the world once again. The successful Double Dragon franchise comes to your console with a very intense fighting title that includes 12 contenders, each with their special abilities.

game.name: Dragon : The Bruce Lee Story
game.desc:
