Martial arts action is defined by one man: Bruce Lee! Now enter the world of Dragon for the ultimate martial arts showdown...authentic, fierce, brutal. It's a Jeet Kune fight to the finish with multiple combat modes, deadly weapons, and chain-wielding villains. In the end, you must face The Phantom... in a mystical battle for your soul!
3 player fighting action with multiplayer adapter.

game.name: Dragon Ball Z - Hyper Dimension
game.desc: Outperforming the original! Fight in three dimensions as the legend continues with more Dragon Ball Z fights! For the first time, Vegito appears and is ready to fight! The fights are more intense than ever, and the battlefields go up, down, right and left! Force your enemies to the ground. THIS IS A HYPER DIMENSION!

game.name: Dragon View
game.desc: In the small warrior village of Rysis, a young couple watches the sunset. The man, Alex, is a brave aspiring soldier, who takes advantage of every moment he can spend with Katarina, his beloved. That night, as the sky filled with the colors of sunset, Alex gave Kat a beautiful earring that had been in her family for generations. Everything seemed perfect and serene as they both enjoyed each other's company... Little did they know of the dark threats that stalked their lands, or the evil plans in which they would soon become involved. And little did they know that this beautiful night was going to be the last one they would share before their lives, along with the fate of the world, changed forever.

game.name: Dragon's Lair
game.desc: Dragon's Lair for the Super Nintendo, released in 1993, is an adaptation of the classic interactive adventure arcade game. In the game, players control knight Dirk the Daring as he attempts to rescue Princess Daphne from the evil dragon Singe and his castle full of traps and enemies. Unlike many action games, Dragon's Lair relies on a series of quick decisions and predefined sequences of events, where players must choose the correct actions at specific times to advance. With graphics that emulate the animation of the original and gameplay based on decision-making and precise timing, Dragon's Lair offers a unique and challenging experience that captures the essence of the arcade game.

game.name: Drakkhen
game.desc: When the dragons are destroyed, a new world will be born. But humans may also be destroyed... The humans did not listen to the gods' advice, and eliminated all the dragons. As a result of this, the gods created a new world... one just for the Drakkhen: half human, half dragon. The new island-world was divided into four parts: they were Earth, Fire, Air and Water. Each is ruled by two Drakkhens... and the human world is in danger of being destroyed by these terrible beings. But the gods have granted humanity one last chance to survive! They will be forgiven if they are able to collect the eight Tears of Drakkhen Island. Start your quest by checking Prince Hordkhen's castle; His castle is before you. Forward! May luck be with you!

game.name: Dream T.V.
game.desc: A magical television has challenged 2 boys to complete missions in various worlds. The first world is in medieval times, a land of castles, dungeons, skeletons and evil knights. The goal is to collect a series of puzzle pieces and exit the world. It also includes the following worlds: ancient Egypt, prehistory and the world of the future.

game.name: Dungeon Master
game.desc: Are you smart enough to solve the twisted puzzles of an evil sorcerer? Do you have the necessary concentration to explore a mysterious labyrinth? Can you give up tempting treasures, defeat horrible monsters, and escape the traps hidden in Lord Grey's terrible dungeon? Yeah? Then perhaps you will be the one to enter the caves of the sacred mountain to recover the Firestaff from the evil of Lord Chaos. To succeed, you must organize a group of four adventurers and lead them in fierce battles against the terrible Dark Lord who now rules the dungeon. What if you fail? At best, you will meet your horrible end in the squalid catacombs of the dungeon, like hundreds of brave adventurers who tried before you. Or much worse, you could become a captive "trophy" of the evil Lord Chaos, suspended forever in the eerie mirrors of the Hall of Champions.

game.name: E.V.O. : Search for Eden
game.desc: The story of E.V.O.: Search for Eden follows the same patterns as modern Evolution theories. Players first control a prehistoric marine organism, and fight to earn evolution points with which you can upgrade your fish's body parts and improve its attack/defense abilities. The gameplay is not completely linear, meaning that certain path and stage choices will affect the player's success. The game is made up of a series of stages, in which the sea organism slowly evolves into an amphibian and then a land creature. The physical changes are quite scientifically accurate, which gives the game a semi-educational purpose as well.

game.name: Earth Defense Force
game.desc:
A SUPER SAGA OF THE 20TH CENTURY SATELLITE WAR!
The graphics will amaze you, the speed will amaze you... but if you don't think fast and shoot faster, you won't stand a chance against the alien firestorm. Because in EARTH DEFENSE FORCE, the best defense is always a great offense. Get ready to strike first and strike fast in the toughest screen-slamming adventure on Super NES!

game.name: EarthBound
game.desc: Intergalactic terror strikes the small town of Onett when a flaming alien object crashes in the night! The earth now faces imminent destruction by the universal evil threat known as Giygas! Armed with a cracked baseball bat, a cookie, and an ATM card, a brave boy named Ness vows to save the planet from horrific destruction. First he must find his heroic companions, Paula, Jeff and Poo. Will Ness succeed in his attempts to ambush countless terrifying monsters while traveling? The final test is in the imminent encounter with the almighty Giygas!

game.name: Earthworm Jim 2
game.desc:
Two times two is four! Too much to list, but read on:
From Evil the Cat's Circus of the Scars' to the Planet of the Flesh, join Jim on a crazy chase across the galaxy. Saving cows, frustrating lawyers, and outwitting Psy-Crow is all a day's work for Jim. Are you up for the challenge? Can you handle the new amazing weapon? Excellent! Then stop reading this. Take it to the counter and try it at home. Trust no one to play it...OR EAT THE DIRT!

game.name: Earthworm Jim
game.desc:
A crow is chasing a worm named Jim while he is in outer space. Psy-Crow pursues a renegade ship. The ship's captain has stolen an ultra-high-tech, indestructible super cyber-suit and Queen Slug-for-a-Butt has ordered Psy-Crow to get it, since it can make her more beautiful than Princess. -Your name. Psy-Crow hits the captain and the suit falls to planet Earth.
Back on Earth, Jim wonders if he'll finally be safe when an ultra-high-tech-indestructible-super-space-cyber-suit lands on him. Fortunately, Jim rests on the collar ring of the suit. The space particles then begin to interact with Jim, causing a light speed evolution. Jim soon realizes that he has control of the suit.
Jim overhears the Queen's plans for the costume and decides to meet this princess...

game.name: Eek! The Cat
game.desc:
KOOM-BY-YAH!
Look forward to a hair-raising adventure with your favorite Saturday morning superhero, debuting on Super NES. Now you can play with EEK! Every day of the week!!!
Get bombed and splashed through six hilarious adventures as you try to rescue Annabelle from wacky aliens... Reunite Pierre with his Squishy Bear siblings... Save a sleepwalking grandmother from a zoofull of accidents... Catch orphaned Joey the Christmas present... And put your tail on the line nine times against Sharky the shark...

game.name: Elite Soccer
game.desc: Play Elite Soccer and have fun in the biggest soccer tournament on earth. Experience the ultimate soccer game by taking your favorite international team, out of 24, on a journey through the most prestigious soccer tournament in the world. The World Cup!

game.name: Emmitt Smith Football
game.desc:
A generic football game, Emmitt Smith Football has the standard Exhibition and Season modes with multiple camera angles. It also features 360-degree TV-style instant replay for crunchy, bone-crunching games.
The only thing that sets it apart from the others is the ability to create and save (using battery backup) 64 unique plays that can be accessed at any time during a game along with the standard preset plays. Although it is not licensed by the NFL or NFLPA, it does not include Dallas Cowboys star running back Emmitt Smith, who is also on the box cover.

game.name: Equinox
game.desc: Equinox is the sequel to the classic NES game Solstice. It is presented in a 3D isometric view with very colorful graphics. The game is based on solving puzzles to advance to the next dungeon. In the game, you play the son of the hero in the first game; Shadax. Shadax has been kidnapped by an evil witch and you must rescue him. There is a wide range of weapons and powerful magic spells that you can use during your quest, some of which are necessary to solve puzzles. In Equinox, you can travel on the map above ground as well as in the underworld, although all of the action, except for some battles, will still happen underground. If you've played any of the Zelda games before, much of the game will be familiar: you must search for keys, blast or avoid monsters, solve physical puzzles on your way to the final level guardian that you must defeat to progress.

game.name: ESPN Baseball Tonight
game.desc:
ESPN Baseball Tonight is a baseball game with exhibition and playoff modes. Other modes included are both practice modes (both pitching and batting) and Home Run Derby. The game contains 28 real MLB teams but no real players. Gameplay options include being able to turn errors on or off and fielding on or off.
The game has the point of view behind the batter, whether pitching or batting. One thing to keep in mind when pitching, the player must manually throw the ball to the thrower for the game to continue.

game.name: ESPN National Hockey Night
game.desc:
ESPN National Hockey Night was one of many hockey games released on the day. This featured all the NHL teams for its time, but lacked an official player license.
It had four game modes to choose from: Exhibition, Challenge, Playoff and Season. The game also features a horizontal and vertical ice perspective, a battery backup to save progress, and also featured the voice of Bill Clement for play-by-play commentary.

game.name: ESPN Speedworld
game.desc: Inspired by fast-paced NASCAR racing, take the wheel of one of these cars and be the best along these oval tracks based on existing NASCAR circuits from the 1990s. All cars in the game have the ability to go up to 200 miles per hour (approximately 322 kilometers per hour) and have characteristics that can be modified such as color and style. The objective of the game is, logically, to come in first place. This game uses the voice of commentator Dr. Jerry Punch and interactive team gear to simulate the authentic feel of a driver during the 1993 Winston Cup season.

game.name: ESPN Sunday Night NFL
game.desc:
ESPN Sunday Night NFL was one of many football games released at the time. It features all 28 official NFL teams and their respective logos, but is not licensed by the NFLPA, so there are no real player names in the game.
There are four different game modes to choose from: playoffs, single play, season, and another season mode that allows the player to play the schedule of the 1994 NFL season. It also offers variable weather conditions to which players on the field react differently and the ability to save games. It also featured Chris Berman, who not only graced the cover, but also lent his voice to the commentary.

game.name: Exertainment Mountain Bike Rally + Speed Racer
game.desc:
Mountain bike racing simulation game in which you can compete in regional, national and world championships.
There are a selection of bikers, including a demon, a California surfer and a ninja. The only violence in this game comes from spectators throwing objects at riders to cause damage. Finding a repair bond at the track can fix the damage and make the bike run faster again. There are also bonuses on the track to add points and energy, giving the player more strength to push their bike to maximum speed.

game.name: Exertainment Mountain Bike Rally
game.desc: The player starts qualifying and as they play more frequently they can qualify for regionals, nationals, the championship and the grueling final race where they must get first place in order to beat the game. . Players will literally spend hours on the easier modes and this game is like exercise for their thumbs.

game.name: Extra Innings
game.desc:
This is a baseball game with 12 fictional teams, plus the player can also create 2 custom teams. Game modes include an exhibition mode, an All Star mode, a flag race, and a display-only mode.
While the exhibition mode can be a one or two player match, the All Star game is strictly two player. When playing, hitting and throwing are done from a vantage point behind the bat.
The flag race involves 6 teams playing each other over the course of a season consisting of a series of games chosen by the player.
Viewing mode allows the player to watch two teams controlled by the machine play against each other.
Game options include having auto or manual fielding, having bugs, wind on or off, weather conditions such as cold, and being able to jump or watch opponents' pennant games.

game.name: Eye of the Beholder
game.desc: Something evil is lurking beneath the city of Waterdeep. The Lords of Waterdeep summon a group of heroes to investigate, but someone or something has been watching the proceedings. After the heroes enter the sewers, the ceiling collapses behind them. The only way out is the way down, into a dungeon full of monsters, traps and puzzles.

game.name: F1 Pole Position 2
game.desc:
F1 Pole Position 2 is basically the same game as its predecessor F1 Pole Position. It is a racing game based on Formula 1 with the possibility of participating, as in the first installment of the game, in the World Grand Prix (the entire season), battle mode (a single race with configurable parameters such as the number of laps) and test (to practice the various circuits). The game is one of the most realistic of the genre and it still allows you to customize many parts of the car, such as brakes, tires or suspension.
Changes compared to the predecessor include some updated licenses, multiple difficulty levels, and different modalities in full-screen graphics when playing in single mode.

game.name: F1 Pole Position
game.desc:
This Formula 1 racing game has 3 game modes and 16 tracks to compete on. The game modes included are Battle, World Grand Prix and Trial.
Battle Mode consists of an exhibition race where the player can choose any circuit and the number of laps to complete. The player can also choose to race with up to 13 opponents.
The World Grand Prix allows the player to compete in all the races that take place throughout the F1 season. In each race the driver will add points depending on his position at the finish line, with the title being won by the one who adds the most points throughout the season.
Test Mode allows the player to practice any track without interference from other drivers.

game.name: F1 ROC : Race of Champions
game.desc:
Get into the cockpit, step on the accelerator and travel through the high-speed world of Formula One with F1 900.
You are going to test your skill on the famous Monte Carlo hairpins. Get your nerves on edge on Monza's legendary straights. Race to win in a total of 16 exciting international courses.
Best of all, you can customize your career in a million different ways.
If you're ready for the winner's circle, get ready for ROC!

game.name: F1 ROC II: Race of Champions
game.desc:
OK race fans, you've seen the rest, now here's the best one'
Seta's new Super DSP chip separates the men from the boys in this high-speed Formula One racing tour. Drive real cars, such as the FW14B Williams, McLaren's MP4/7, F92 Ferrari, V8 Ford Benettion B192 and other Formula One racing machines. You'll start in a Group C prototype car and must win on all 8 tracks to move up the ranks. Next, race F3000 cars to develop the fast reflexes needed to survive Formula One racing. Finally, you take on the real drivers from the 1992 Formula One season and their cars. On the 16 international courses, it's a duel of nerves, skill, sand and nitro. This game blows up the competition.
A new standard in racing simulation is born and F1-ROC II is it.

game.name: F1 World Championship Edition
game.desc: F1 is the ultimate challenge for a professional racing driver. This edition of the World Championship actually allows you to drive for any of the 12 real teams in the 16 official Grand Prix races against real F1 drivers. If this isn't enough of a challenge, there are 3 difficulty levels, changeable weather conditions, a choice of Championship or Knockout challenges and, to top it all off, a phenomenally fast split-screen option where you can compete head-to-head against a friend or even your SNES! Start your engines! Get ready for the race!

game.name: Faceball 2000
game.desc:
"Virtual reality" for your Super NES!
Welcome to the exciting new world of FaceBall 2000, where 3D graphics, first-person perspective and 360° maneuverability make you feel like you're inside your video game! What you see is where you are, as you work as a team, compete against a friend, or play alone against computer-controlled opponents.
Warp within the walls of CyberZone, where you will be surrounded by menacing enemies lurking in a series of treacherous mazes. Or, enter the Arena where “Have a Nice Day” takes on new meaning in fast-paced rounds of high-tech combat.
Wherever you go in FaceBall 2000, it's your chance to wipe the smiles off those happy and annoyed faces, and maybe some of your friends, once and for all!

game.name: Family Dog
game.desc:
Based on a short-lived primetime animated television series created by Steven Spielberg and Tim Burton, you play as the titular dog across three levels. The child in your family likes to attack you for his antics. He fires volleys of tennis balls and unleashes a vacuum cleaner that you should avoid. The cat and other obstacles are waiting for you in your house while you collect bones for power.
After all the trouble you cause at home, you are sent to Obedience School and have to run away with a large number of gung-ho instructors and ferocious Dobermans in the heavily guarded compound. If you manage to escape, you will reach a forest full of wild animals.

game.name: Family Feud
game.desc:
This version differs from others, with over 4,000 survey questions. The rules fit the shows, divided into rounds until a family reaches 300 points and the "Three Strikes" rule. He also introduced the new "Bulls Eye Round" that was introduced to the show at that time.
To answer questions, the player uses the D-pad to move a cursor and press the required button to select that letter and spell their answer. Players can also battle each other and customize their family to their liking, from their appearance, hobbies, intelligence, and occupations, and customize the rules to suit the player.

game.name: Fatal Fury 2
game.desc: After the death of Geese Howard in the original Fatal Fury, a mysterious nobleman becomes the sponsor of the new "King of Fighters" tournament. This time, the tournament is held all over the world with fighters from all over the world competing. As the single-player mode progresses, the mysterious challenger begins defeating participants from the previous Fatal Fury game, searching for the man responsible for defeating Geese.

game.name: Fatal Fury Special
game.desc: THE GRANDMOTHER of all battles! 15 of the top stars of the FATAL FURY series reunite in the match of the millennium! Use the resurrected Geese Howard and Wolfgang Krauser in a dazzling arena! Everything you've ever wanted in a fighting game is here in FATAL FURY SPECIAL!

game.name: Fatal Fury
game.desc: The tyrant Geese Howard has established anarchy and chaos in the fictional American city of Southtown. Now, it's up to you to defeat the evil dictator Howard and restore peace to Southtown. Choosing from one of three characters: Joe Higashi, Terry Bogard or Andy Bogard you must compete in the annual King of Fighters fighting tournament, hosted by Crime Boss Geese Howard and emerge victorious to bring home the championship and defeat Geese. There are dozens of special moves to master and eight different locations to battle. You can enter the ring in two different fighting modes: Championship or Street Fight and you can take on opponents controlled by the machine or a friend in hand-to-hand combat.

game.name: FIFA : Road to World Cup 98
game.desc:
The late 1997 edition of FIFA was closely related to the qualification procedure for the 1998 World Cup. In Road to the World Cup mode, you take a team from the first qualification to the main tournament, using the different systems in different parts of the world. The game features 16 different outdoor stadiums. League play features 189 clubs and 11 leagues. Each team has specific crowd chants incorporated into the ambient sound.
The action is faster than in previous versions, and AI has been expanded. Players have different facial features and hair styles. Each match is presented by Des Lynam and commented by John Motson and former Scotland international Andy Gray.

game.name: FIFA International Soccer
game.desc:
The game that started the best-selling soccer series, this first installment used a dimetric point of view (colloquially known as "isometric"), previously unusual in soccer games but quickly imitated by several titles. The television presentation, one of the unique points of the early EA Sports titles, with hosts presenting the matches, was another thing that made the game stand out in a market dominated by Sensible Soccer and Kick Off games.
Based on international teams (with fictitious player names), their skills in each area are up to 10 points to give the player an overall impression of the quality of the players. The game favors quick runs, short passes and powerful shots from outside the penalty area, On the tactical side, formations can be selected, with 5 different strategies, as well as team coverage, the areas covered by defenders, midfielders and forwards.

game.name: FIFA Soccer 96
game.desc: FIFA96 features eleven leagues from around the world, ranging from the unknown players of the Malaysian league to the famous stars of the English and Italian leagues. There are also 59 international teams featured, and it is possible to match the teams you want with each other through friendlies, or you can also choose to play national or international tournaments such as the World Cup. If you are not happy with the composition of the different teams, you can create your own dream team through the custom team builder.

game.name: FIFA Soccer 97
game.desc: Once again, get ready to compete in the most popular sport in the world, where competition is fierce, even among amateurs! You will feel the adrenaline rushing as you face the best teams in the world, enjoying a game that is more realistic than ever. Who said, "It's just a game!"? -4 game modes: exhibition, league, playoff and tournament. -Optional password, to return to the game already started. -Improved graphics and gameplay. -Extremely detailed statistics on players, teams and games.

game.name: Fighter's History
game.desc: There are three different game modes available. CPU Battle is the traditional arcade mode, where the player selects a character and tries to complete the game by beating all the other fighters. In survival mode, the player selects a team of five characters to face another team. And finally versus mode, where the player can go against his friends.

game.name: Final Fantasy : Mystic Quest
game.desc: Focus Tower is the center of the world and balances the forces of the world. However, 4 monsters have taken the 4 elemental crystals (Earth, Water, Fire, Wind) for their own use, and have also taken the 4 keys to the doors inside the Focus Tower. With the balance disrupted, disasters fall upon the world. A boy named Benjamin discovers that his home village has been destroyed. Meeting a mysterious old man while trying to escape the earthquakes, she soon discovers that he is the prophesied hero and the only one who can save the world. Benjamin must recover the 4 crystals, unlock Focus Tower and defeat the last monster before the fifth crystal, the Life Crystal is damaged.

game.name: Final Fantasy II
game.desc: In Baron's kingdom, powerful airships rule the skies. At the head of this elite fighting force is Cecil, Captain of the Red Wings. As our adventure begins, Cecil and his squad are ordered to steal a powerful crystal from a rival kingdom. Upon his return, Cecil questions the King's orders and is stripped of his command. To prove his loyalty, he must kill a terrible monster and deliver a mysterious package to a neighboring town. But when the package explodes, destroying everyone, Cecil and his friend Kain vow to fight the King's dark forces. Will you be able to save the world from their evil plan to control the crystals? Get ready for the most challenging role-playing adventure ever.

game.name: Final Fantasy III
game.desc: Long ago, evil beings created powerful creatures called Espers and unleashed them against each other. The resulting battles left their world a smoking wreckage. Legend has it, the Espers destroyed themselves and most of humanity. The magic disappeared forever. Centuries have passed and now a rational world exists with Espers living only in myths, until a solid frozen from ancient wars is discovered. Suddenly, there are reports of magical attacks on civilians. Imperial Commandos launch raids using MagiTek magical weapons. Magic is obviously alive and the world is in danger again. Who or what is behind the rediscovery and redistribution of this legendary power? What chaotic plans exist that will wreak havoc on this ordered world?

game.name: Final Fight 2
game.desc: It's Mad Gear madness! They have come back stronger than ever and want revenge. With a new mysterious leader they plan to dominate the entire world. This time they have kidnapped Genryusai and his daughter Rena. This time Haggar must travel around the world to search for Genryusai and Rena. But he doesn't go alone. Carlos and Rena's sister, Maki, will join the slam festival to end the gang for good. Use numerous weapons such as knives and bats or find food to regain your strength. Choose between Haggar, Carlos or Maki, each with their own fighting style. Or have a friend team up to double your strength and crush any bad guys who get in your way.

game.name: Final Fight 3
game.desc:
Metro City is under attack, and this time a new criminal organization is claiming responsibility. Taking pages from the Mad Gear Gang guide, the feared group called SKULL CROSS is up to the same tricks: arson, terrorism, assault and armed robbery.
Mayor Mike Haggar returns with the mighty Guy at his side. And with the help of Cody's friend Lucia and Dean, a fighting machine out for revenge, the Final Fight team will ambush the enemy in their next move. Choose to play one of 4 characters, each with their own fighting style and "SUPER" elimination techniques. Get a friend to team up for a double assault on the city scum and crush any punk that gets in your way!

game.name: Final Fight Guy
game.desc:
Mayor Mike Haggar vows to take Metro City's streets back from thieves with his bare knuckles! But the Mad Gear Gang snatches his daughter Jessica. Now there are going to be dues to pay!
The urban ninja boy hits the streets with Haggar, sinking heads downtown and hitting the slums. It's a one-man army! Your weapons are whatever you can find: swords, knives or pipes.
Now you are either Haggar or Guy, each with their own fighting style. Take down bandit henchmen, samurai swordsmen, and muscle-bound crime bosses in a fist-to-nose frenzy!

game.name: Final Fight
game.desc:
Mayor Mike Haggar vows to take Metro City's streets back from thieves with his bare knuckles! But the Mad Gear Gang snatches his daughter Jessica. Now there are going to be dues to pay!
Jessica's boyfriend, Cody, hits the streets with Haggar, making a dent downtown and hitting the slums. It's a one-man army! Your weapons are whatever you can find: swords, knives or pipes.
Now you are Haggar or Cody, each with their own fighting style. Take down bandit henchmen, samurai swordsmen, and muscle-bound crime bosses in a fist-to-nose frenzy!

game.name: Firepower 2000
game.desc: The most powerful weapons in the world have fallen into the hands of the forces of evil, who are trying to destroy the world. Now it is your turn to fight against the forces of evil, and their weapons, or the world will be condemned to destruction. Drive a jeep with heavy weapons, or a helicopter equipped with missiles, you go to war alone. You will be able to find and equip yourself with a wide variety of weapons including flamethrowers, plasma cannons, lasers, guided missiles and nuclear weapons. The main mission of Firepower 2000 is to kill or be killed, fast-paced and intense action, keep your finger on the trigger and aim quickly, or else you will end the game very quickly.

game.name: FireStriker
game.desc:
Long ago, in a distant world, there were four kingdoms ruled by four constantly fighting tribes. One day, Archmage Wylde proposed a solution to the constant battle. He offered to grant the title of FireStriker and ruler of the four tribes, over which he could control the fire elemental orb known as the Trialight. However, Archmage Wylde had a hidden purpose. His true reason for bringing peace to the world was so he could destroy the four kingdoms at once.
Now, Slader, the last FireStriker, has offered to risk his life in battle against Wylde and his monsters. The time has come to launch the Trialight. The future of the world hangs in the balance.

game.name: First Samurai
game.desc: First Samurai and SNES transport you to medieval times full of samurai from the Bushidou code. You play as a samurai who arrives in an unknown land. First with fists and kicks, then with a magic sword, you must fight various enemies. Fortunately, you can help yourself with the special items and weapons that you will find throughout this world and find the exit from each level.

game.name: Flashback : The Quest for Identity
game.desc: 2142. After escaping from the spaceship, young scientist Conrad B. Hart wakes up with amnesia on Titan, a colonized satellite of the planet Saturn, with his enemies and kidnappers hot on his heels. He must find a way to return to Earth, defend himself from the dangers he encounters along the way, and dismantle a gigantic alien plot that threatens the planet...

game.name: Football Fury
game.desc:
An American football game with fictitious teams. Even though the teams are fictional, they are based on the actual NFL team cities and division setup of that time period.
The game involves the usual football fare of choosing a play and attempting to execute it. On offense, when you throw the ball, a meter appears that measures the strength of the passer's throw. On defense, the player controls a defensive player and tries to attack the opposing ball carrier or try to break up a passing play.
There is an option to play with background music on or off.

game.name: Foreman for Real
game.desc: Before marketing fat-reducing grills, boxing legend George Foreman endorsed this boxing game with a third-person view similar to Punch Out. A wide range of hits and jabs are available, with full scoring per turn by the judges. You can choose from 3 to 12 rounds, and there are 2 camera views, as well as an auto-switch option.

game.name: Frank Thomas Big Hurt Baseball
game.desc: Baseball player Frank Thomas licensed one of the first baseball games to use motion-captured 3D graphics and multiple camera angles. 28 stadiums have been rendered in 3D, and each has its own visible and significant differences.

game.name: Frantic Flea
game.desc:
In Frantic Flea the player has to take control of a flea warrior to protect his world from an evil race of insects called the Insideos who enslave his friends and family.
The game has six different levels, where the player explores each stage, freeing imprisoned flea companions and using weapons and devices to aid in their missions such as the Hoverpod that allows flight and the Stikko that gives the player the ability to climb walls. The graphics are made in a cartoon style with over 100 animation frames to give a more fluid feel.

game.name: Frogger
game.desc: The road is filled with cars and trucks, at varying speeds. The river water itself is fatal, as are the snakes floating in later levels. Frogger must use the layout of logs, turtles (which are only there for a short time), and alligators (but stay away from their faces), and then jump to one of the open cells, ideally one containing a fly for extra points. . Once all the holes have been filled, you will move on to the next, harder level.

game.name: Full Throttle : All-American Racing
game.desc:
Full Throttle Racing takes on chaotic, violent, no-holds-barred racing across the United States. The race takes place on both land and water, with motorcycles and boats featured.
There are 6 racers in the game, each with their own short profile, including a guy fresh out of jail, a token woman, and a token African-American. You can compete in one or both disciplines, either in an individual weekend or in a full championship.
As you play, you can upgrade your vehicle with faster engines, better tires, and more nitros. As in Road Rash, throwing your legs at other runners is potentially advantageous.

game.name: Fun 'n Games
game.desc: Fun 'N' Games is a collection of mini games, arcade games, a music composer and a drawing program.

game.name: F-Zero
game.desc: F-Zero is a futuristic racing game where characters control flying cars and compete in an intergalactic tournament. In total there are four characters with their own vehicle, each one having different characteristics. A race consists of doing five laps along a track, and it is mandatory to complete each of them in one of the first places to avoid being disqualified. When a lap is completed the player is rewarded with a power called "Super Jet", which lasts six seconds or so. The objective of the game is to defeat the other characters by crossing the finish line at the end of a race, avoiding certain areas of damage within the tracks. Each vehicle has its own energy meter, which works as a way to measure the durability of the machines; This in turn decreases each time the player passes through a sandy area or crashes. Energy can be replenished while driving over a pit stop.

game.name: Garry Kitchen's Super Battletank : War in the Gulf
game.desc:
Enjoy one of the most realistic military games you have ever experienced!
In Super BattleTank, you command an allied forces super tank M1A1, which contains the best possible weaponry.
You will have available all the weapons that make up the reputation of the M1A1, smoke grenades, spectacular graphics that will make you feel as if you were in the middle of a tough combat in the desert.
It also adds visibility as if you were in a tank, with special sounds, spectacular graphics that will make you feel as if you were in the Gulf War.
· 10 different Missions. · With Soviet Mi-24 HIND helicopters, T-62 tanks and missile launchers. · Receives orders from the commander of the allied forces. · Digitized graphics of authentic realism. · Digitized sound for special effects and music.
Designed by Garry Kitchen and Alex DeMeo.

game.name: Gemfire
game.desc:
Koei made a foray into the fantasy worlds of magic with this game.
Six wizards, each trapped inside a magical gem, are freed from the Gemfire crown by Princess Robyn, daughter of Ishmeria's tyrannical ruler, King Eselred. Fleeing across the island nation, each chooses a leader from the greatest noble houses as their champion to overthrow Eselred and bring peace to Ishmeria.
Players select one of these nobles and seek to unite all the provinces under their banner through a combination of war and diplomacy.

game.path: ./Genghis Khan II - Clan of the Gray Wolf (USA).zip
game.name: Genghis Khan II : Clan of the Gray Wolf
game.desc: As in the first part, you can participate in two conquests: the Mongol conquest and the world conquest. In the first you must unite all the small tribes in the country. Conquering the world is more complex: you must use all your senses to make the world as you wish.
game.image: ./media/images/Genghis Khan II - Clan of the Gray Wolf (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Genghis Khan II - Clan of the Gray Wolf (USA).png

game.name: George Foreman's KO Boxing
game.desc:
You play heavyweight champion George Foreman, this is a boxing simulation where players, taking the role of Foreman, go through a series of twelve rounds against different boxers to win the championship title.
Played from a third-person perspective, using a view from the right over the boxer's shoulders, players can move left and right to dodge punches, block, and throw left and right punches. A fight consists of a maximum of three rounds of three minutes each. When a boxer is knocked down four times, the match is over. The screen shows an energy counter that goes down as hits are received.

game.name: Ghoul Patrol
game.desc: In the sequel to Zombies Ate My Neighbors, you, as children, Zeke and/or Julie, have to save the world from the demon, the lord of skeletons, demons, ghosts, etc. Shooting them with super new weapons like Plasma Gun or Lobbing Smash. Gun, you need to rescue ten trapped victims in each level and fight the boss at the end. But you must also remember that ammunition is limited.

game.name: Goal!
game.desc:
Goal! or also known as Super Goal, is a soccer game for the Super Nintendo console.
You play with a full team of 11 players, each ranked in 7 different skill categories. You can play against a machine-controlled team or against another player. You can even team up with a friend and combine your skills to compete against the machine.

game.name: Gods
game.desc: Hercules aims to achieve immortality by completing the task that the Gods have assigned to him. Your task is presented as a platform adventure set in ancient Greece, featuring a variety of enemies as you play.

game.name: Goof Troop
game.desc:
Goofy and his son Max were enjoying a peaceful day of fishing, when Keelhaul Pete runs away with Pete and PJ.
Now it's up to Goofy and Max to travel to Spoonerville Island and venture through the jungle to rescue their friends. Like any character, you'll take on an army of daring swordsmen as you dodge explosive cannonballs and search dank dungeons on your way to the final showdown with Keelhaul Pete.
Along the way, you'll have to search for treasure and solve puzzles to find the keys that will allow you to enter the pirate's hideout and confront Pete.

game.name: GP-1 Part II
game.desc: GP-1 II, the second part of the well-known GP-1. Once again you will be able to compete with motorcycles on 17 different tracks located in 14 countries. You can choose between six different motorcycles. You can also improve your bikes by winning races and earning points, earning enough points will allow you to get better parts for your bike.

game.name: GP-1
game.desc: GP-1 is a motorcycle racing game. The player competes against 15 opponents on 13 tracks located in 12 different countries. There is a two-player mode where you can compete against a friend and a career mode where you will complete an entire season. The player can choose from six different motorcycles. Once the player starts career mode, they can purchase upgrades and parts for their motorcycle. The player can also choose a mechanic to fix their bikes.

game.name: Gradius III
game.desc: Gradius III is the third game in Konami's Gradius series, which also includes games like Life Force and Nemesis. Like most Gradius-type games, you control a highly advanced Vic Viper fighting against enemy hordes. Weapons can be selected in packs, or created to our liking. Gradius can be played in "Single Player" mode, or by two players alternating turns. The game offers three levels of difficulty.

game.name: GunForce
game.desc:
The player takes control of a soldier who is thrown onto an island and must fight his way through hordes of enemy soldiers until he reaches the final showdown to protect Mother Earth from invaders.
The gameplay consists of moving forward and blowing up all the enemies that cross your path. The player starts with a normal pistol, but may find other weapons in a level, such as a flamethrower or a laser gun. While the normal pistol has an infinite amount of bullets, the other types of weapons will eventually run out of ammo. With these weapons, the player can shoot either straight, up, or diagonally. The player will also have the opportunity to command a vehicle, from which they can also fire bullets.
The player starts with 5 lives and continues with 3. Each of the stages must be defeated in a certain amount of time or the player loses one of those lives.

game.name: Hagane : The Final Conflict
game.desc: Only one man alone can save the world from the KOMA clan and their plan to destroy the world. His name was "HAGANE". The only survivor of the FUMA clan, who was massacred by the KOMA clan. Brought back from the death row and given a cyborg body, "HAGANE" swears against the KOMA clan.

game.name: HAL's Hole in One Golf
game.desc: It's the 18th hole: Hal Open Tournament. Sixty of the best golfers in the country gather in one place to determine who will take home the Grand Prix trophy. You're 7 under par, tied for first. This 22-food putt is all that stands between you and glory. A hush falls over the gallery... you address the ball... you measure your swing... Hal America brings the excitement of competitive golf to the SNES. Multiple game options and a challenging course will challenge beginners and seasoned pros alike!

game.name: HammerLock Wrestling
game.desc:
Plug in Hammerlock and check out action-packed wrestling like you've never seen before: up close. How close? Jaleco's unique ringside perspective brings the action right under your eyelids. In addition to the main screen, you get two ringside screens. Watch your opponent's hand retreat to take a hit, so you can time your dodge perfectly. Then watch as the close-up screen explodes to twice its normal size as you grab his legs and throw him into a spine-splintering suplex. See everything as if it were inches away, closer than you've ever seen.
- 12 fighters and more than 60 heartbreaking moves! - Up to 4 players can compete in tag team matches AT THE SAME TIME! - Tournament, tag team and exhibition matches for a variety of fun.

game.name: HardBall III
game.desc: HardBall III is a baseball game. One or two players can play. Real teams and players that participate in the major leagues are at your disposal in this title where you have the option to record your favorite plays.

game.name: Harley's Humongous Adventure
game.desc:
HARLEY is a brilliant young genius whose greatest experiment has just backfired in the most egregious way.
Something went wrong with Harley's machine. Now you have an error size and the machine exploded. Fake!
Now Harley has to search for the missing parts of his machine. You will have to run, jump, swim, climb, fly with a jet pack, search for weapons and fight mutant insects.

game.name: Harvest Moon
game.desc: Have you ever wanted to live life on a farm, with nothing but the sun, the fresh scent of your crops, the muddy fields below, and the cows and chickens to keep you company? Well, you're in luck, because you just inherited your grandfather's ranch, but it's in a terrible state of disrepair! What can you do?

game.name: Head-On Soccer
game.desc: You will have 50 national teams at your disposal and two game modes to select from: Quick Match and Tournament. Tournament mode is a series of seven matches across four continents, while Quick Match mode offers a simple match for one or two players.

game.name: Hebereke's Popoitto
game.desc: This is a game starring the eight unique Hebereke characters! Play against the machine or against a friend. Line up four or more Popoons of the same color to make them disappear. Some creatures are mobile, they move slowly from left to right so you have to remove them at the right time.

game.name: Hebereke's Popoon
game.desc: This is a block grouping game. There are eight characters to play with, each with different abilities. In single player mode, the player is forced to choose Hebereke and must play against Oh-Chan. After defeating Oh-Chan, the player can choose between Hebereke and Oh-Chan and in the next match he will face Sukezaemon, and so on, until the player has "unlocked" all the characters. Each game consists of a single round. A defeated player may choose to resume play by using a continue. In two-player mode, all characters are available to each player and the best of three rounds wins each match. Players can also select a level from 1 to 5 to increase or decrease the difficulty of the game.

game.name: Hit the Ice : The Video Hockey League
game.desc:
SKATE FOR VICTORY AND SURVIVAL!
This radical hockey game will pit you and your team against some of the most demanding skaters to ever burn a hole in the ice! Victory goes to the team that kicks, punches and slugs their opponent into slush. Standard hockey rules apply, plus a few surprises to shake things up. So lace up your skateboard and fasten your mask – hockey is about to break loose!

game.name: Home Alone 2 : Lost in New York
game.desc: It's Christmas and, somehow, Kevin McCallister has become separated from his family again. Only this time the action takes place in New York City. Everything from Central Park thieves to sewer rats will come in the way of this young man as he traverses the gigantic city to find his family. Harry and Marv are hot on his heels, and this time they've enlisted the help of some thugs from their old gang. To make matters worse, he is also chased by the entire staff of the Plaza Hotel. Can this child survive in New York?

game.name: Home Alone
game.desc: As young Kevin McCallister, this family has left you alone this Christmas. The big problem here is that a pair of thieves have set their sights on McCallister's belongings as their latest robbery. You are the only thing standing in their way and they are not willing to negotiate. Race through the house, basement, and tree fort as you set up amazing traps for unwanted intruders! He throws candlesticks and irons from his walnut trees in an attempt to buy you valuable time while the police rush to your rescue. Can you stay out of Marv and Harry's clutches and protect your family's treasures? Discover this hilarious adaptation of the classic comedy hit of the year!

game.name: Home Improvement
game.desc: Based on the hit sitcom, Tim "The Tool Man" Taylor's name has been put on Binford's new line of power tools and he is on a quest to recover the missing tools when he discovers they are missing when he is about to present them on Tool Hour. It's a race against time as you must collect several metal nuts to stay alive and collect some wooden boxes of tool parts to move on to the next part of one of the four sound stages you find yourself in. Defend yourself from your various common tools. Take out weak walls and floors with your sledgehammer and jackhammer, and use your grappling tool to swing, lower, and lift yourself to distant areas.

game.name: Hook
game.desc: Your blood is pumping and a chill runs down your spine. You finally come face to face with the most infamous pirate of all, Captain Hook, the demon who has kidnapped your children and sworn never to let them go. Like Peter Pan, this is the fight of your life. Everything that happened before - duels with Rufio, your battles against pirates, even your soaring flights above Neverland - are nothing compared to this moment.

game.name: Hungry Dinosaurs
game.desc: Hungry Dinosaurs is a variant of the Othello board game but with dinosaurs. On each turn, a player can place an egg on a 9x9 grid of the playing field. When a player manages to catch a row (horizontal, vertical or diagonal) of an opponent's eggs, that is, having an egg at each end of the row, the ones in the middle change color. A round ends after a certain amount of time and whoever has the most eggs on the field wins. A game is made up of several rounds. Up to 4 players can participate.

game.name: Hurricanes
game.desc: The owner of the Gorgons (the Hurricanes' rival team) will challenge us to a game on his island, with the condition that if we don't show up on time, the game will count as a loss. It seems like a very absurd plot and it really is, but this plot will justify that we have to cross 15 places on Gorgon Island to get to the match on time, driving one of our two protagonists (to be chosen by ourselves). It also has a "two player" mode. The levels will gradually increase in difficulty, becoming really hard from level 5-6 onwards. We will have to go through dangers such as the jungle, the airport and even the stadium itself to finally face the final enemy (the owner of the Gorgons).

game.name: Hyper V-Ball
game.desc: This is a volleyball simulation game viewed from a side perspective, meaning that it is only possible to move players to the left or right. The player can choose between three different leagues: Men's League, Woman's League and Hyper League. Two buttons are used to control the ball, one for normal actions and one for "Hyper Plays", special attacks, which can only be learned and used in the Hyper League. How a player will block or attack depends on the speed of the ball and the position of the players. Team members not under the player's direct control will also act on their own. They will not block shots on their own, however, but it is possible to let players not under direct control block shots by pressing one of the action buttons at the right time.

game.name: HyperZone
game.desc: Hyper Zone plays like a cross between a racing game and a shooter. The goal of the game is to navigate each level while shooting enemies and earning points, until finally a boss encounter ends each level. After enough points are acquired, the player earns an "extension" and their ship is upgraded to the next stage. The player's ship can receive up to six upgrades.

game.name: Illusion of Gaia
game.desc: Radiating an ominous light in its path, the Chaos Comet threatens the existence of the planet. Battles erupt and a tentative peace is returned to the lands. Danger lurks as the orbits of the Chaos Comet and fearsome beasts await. In the Age of Exploration, a boy named Will is born. Tragedy strikes during an expedition to the Tower of Babel that separates Will from his father. Telekinetic forces awaken when Will returns to South Cape. Armed with his transformation abilities of two great warriors, Will must save the planet. Gaia, Will's spirit guide grants magical powers and advice throughout his journey. With the help of his friends, Will must fight relentless enemies and solve the puzzles of the ancient ruins. Patience and knowledge are essential to reunite this father and son.

game.name: Imperium
game.desc: The year is 2027, on a distant planet where high-tech robots have enslaved a class of mechanized creatures. These robot slaves have formed an underground resistance movement and developed a suit of armor that may hold the key to victory over the high-tech robots. The only problem with these robots is that the armor can only be used by a human being. The player takes control of that human being.

game.name: Incantation
game.desc: You control a young wizard who has to complete several levels. Enemies are defeated using different ranged spells that can be found throughout the levels, with different types of shots and powers. Some levels require players to collect a certain number of items, while others are level boss battles.

game.name: Indiana Jones' Greatest Adventures
game.desc: Grab your trusty whip and embrace all three Indy classics in this no-holds-barred video game adventure! If it happens in the movies... it happens here... the giant rock from Raiders of the Lost Ark, the Temple of Doom mine cart chase, Three Trials from The Last Crusade. It's three times the Indy, all in one blockbuster RPG!

game.name: Inindo : Way of the Ninja
game.desc: In 1581, Warlord Oda Nobunaga sent a large army towards Iga, as part of his effort to conquer all of Japan. A small group of Iga Ninja attempted to defend themselves, but were quickly overwhelmed by Nobunaga's hordes. When the attack ended, all that remained was a nightmare landscape, ravaged by flames. Will no one take revenge for Nobunaga's crime? Inindo: Way of the Ninja is a wonderful turn-based RPG. It has an extensive map, set in feudal Japan, which includes the same provinces of that time.

game.name: Inspector Gadget
game.desc: Inspector Gadget is on another mission against the evil Doctor Claw and his army of M.A.D. agents. This time it's personal because Doctor Claw has captured Gadget's niece, Penny. With the help of his trusty dog, Brain, and his suit filled with special gadgets, Inspector Gadget must save Penny and defeat Doctor Claw and his henchmen!

game.path: ./International Sensible Soccer - World Champions Limited Edition (Europe).zip
game.name: International Sensible Soccer - World Champions : Limited Edition
game.desc: Launched in conjunction with the 1994 World Cup, this was the first version of Sensible Soccer to feature teams from outside Europe. The World Cup tournament is presented in its entirety, and you can adjust the 24 teams it features, a particularly crucial feature for English and French fans as their nations did not qualify. For the first time in the series, a referee appears on screen. The club's kit details have been updated to take into account transfers and kit changes since the previous version. The game mechanics are very similar to previous editions, and are viewed from above with small sprites and loose ball control.
game.image: ./media/images/International Sensible Soccer - World Champions Limited Edition (Europe).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/International Sensible Soccer - World Champions Limited Edition (Europe).png

game.name: International Superstar Soccer Deluxe
game.desc: The most exciting football match now with 36 teams made up of famous players. The new, smarter CPU will make the game a challenge for novices and experts alike. Choose from over 16 formations, 8 strategies, 20 players and 9 specific player skills to take your team to the top. And you can play up to four friends with a multitap!

game.name: International Superstar Soccer
game.desc: International Superstar Soccer is a soccer game for the SNES and the first in the ISS series. The game has a series of game modes: Open Game (with 1 or 2 players), International Cup, World Cup, Training, quick match and penalty round. In ISS we can choose 26 national teams, although unfortunately, their squads are made up of invented players. In Italy there is not Roberto Baggio, but Galfano. On the Dutch side, Bergsen plays Bergkamp, ​​while in Germany a certain Sieke scores goals as if he were Jurgën Klinsmann himself.

game.name: International Tennis Tour
game.desc: International Tennis Tour is a video game about tennis and an international superstar. There is a practice, exhibition and career mode where the player receives a generous amount of dollars and must compete in the world tennis circuit to earn more money.

game.name: Izzy's Quest for the Olympic Rings
game.desc: Izzy is a relatively anthropomorphic being who is said to live inside the fire of the Olympic torch, specifically in a universe called Torchworld, which is where the game supposedly takes place. Its inhabitants are responsible for making the flame bigger and brighter every year. But the evil inhabitants of the infernal part (which theoretically also exists in that world) try to destroy its inhabitants and thwart the Olympics. Izzy, the most seasoned and outstanding athlete in the city, will have to stop them, either with jumps or a baseball bat.

game.path: ./J.R.R. Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings - Volume 1 (USA).zip
game.name: J.R.R. Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings : Volume 1
game.desc: This game is based on the book The Lord of the Rings. Although the title suggests there should be more parts, the other two were never produced. In this game you play with Frodo Baggins, a Hobbit. The game begins at Bilbo's 111th birthday. Your first mission is to find Pippin. In his search he will have to take the ring of Rivendell. You'll start alone, but later you'll get other characters to join your quest, like Sam and Gandalf. The game was originally designed for the NES, but the release was held back and later ported for the SNES. Games can only be saved by remembering a code. The code must be entered later in the game to continue.
game.image: ./media/images/J.R.R. Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings - Volume 1 (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/J.R.R. Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings - Volume 1 (USA).png

game.name: Jack Nicklaus Golf
game.desc: Jack Nicklaus Golf is a golf simulation game. The video game also has a two-player mode and the ability to save progress through passwords.

game.name: James Bond Jr
game.desc: This animated television series adaptation differs significantly from its NES namesake. The nephew of Agent 007 must thwart the plans of the malevolent S.C.U.M. agents, who are searching for rare artifacts that will allow them to dominate the world. Unlike the NES game, this version is a more action-oriented side-scrolling game without detailed mission objectives or puzzle solving.

game.name: Jelly Boy
game.desc: Jelly Boy is a humanoid pink blob jelly on a mission across strange worlds. Travel through landscapes such as giant toy factories and Arctic snowfields during your quest, facing all kinds of enemies and dangerous obstacles. He can jump and can throw a big fist from his stomach (he is a blob after all). Additionally, different levels have special power-ups that allow the bubble to assume different shapes that are useful in specific circumstances. These include a hot air balloon (to float up to special objects), a hammer (to break obstructing blocks), a submarine (to more effectively navigate an underwater bonus level), a skateboard (to traverse a level in a time frame), and a pogo stick (to jump higher). However, not all power-ups are useful. One item turns Jelly Boy into a block so he can't move for several seconds.

game.name: Jeopardy! : Deluxe Edition
game.desc: Jeopardy! Deluxe Edition is an updated version of their Jeopardy! predecessor that features over 3,500 different new questions along with standard Jeopardy features like Daily Doubles, a digitized image of the host, Alex Trebek, and even the theme music. As in the previous version, the player uses the buttons to activate and use the d-pad to highlight letters and spell their answers. The player can also play against two friends or play against the computer A.I. instead.

game.name: Jeopardy! : Sports Edition
game.desc: This version of Jeopardy! It focuses more on sports-related topics with 700 different categories and 3,500 questions to answer related to sports like baseball, football, hockey, etc., along with many other subcategories like players, sports teams, and the like. The rules remain the same as the others, there are three rounds where the player enters to answer and explains the answers using the D-pad. It features digitized photographs of contestants dressed in sports themes, such as baseball, football, volleyball, and the like, along with authentic digitized studio environments and the long-time Jeopardy image and voice. host, Alex Trebek.

game.name: Jeopardy!
game.desc: Jeopardy! is an American quiz with trivia in history, literature, arts, pop culture, science, sports, geography, wordplay, and more. The show has a unique answer and question format in which the contestants are given clues in the form of answers and have to express their answers in the form of a question.

game.name: Jim Lee's WildC.A.T.S : Covert-Action-Teams
game.desc:
The only thing stopping the immortal Helspont from taking over the land is a group of high-powered heroes known as WILDC.A.T.S! Each team member wields incredible power: when they are united, the results are spectacular! Players take on the roles of: Spartan, Cyborg and team leader, Maul, massive crossover warrior, and Warblade, metamorphosing expert in hand-to-hand combat. If humanity has one hope, it is WILDC.A.T.S!
Based on Jim Lee's best-selling comic book and the sensational Saturday morning cartoon!

game.name: Jim Power : The Lost Dimension in 3D
game.desc: Vaprak, threatens to defeat our world, which is the last planet that stands between it and a dimensional vortex. This vortex leads to a fifth and, until now, lost dimension. If you succeed in defeating us, you will destroy our world, opening a gateway for your species, as well as the strange mutant effect this dimension has on all organic life forms. Their forces are too strong for us to defeat them in a frontal attack, which is why we must send you through their Omni-eye scanners and make an assassination attempt against the greatest evil known to man.

game.name: Jimmy Connors Pro Tennis Tour
game.desc: Using sights, aim your ball to the other side of the court and hope it hits where you want. If you're lucky, you may even get an Ace. If not, you'll need to be ready to return your opponent's return. Run back and forth while trying to keep hitting the ball over the net until your opponent misses, or you do. When hitting the ball, you will want to try to change the direction and speed of the ball to throw your opponent off balance. This is the real challenge of any tennis game.

game.name: Jimmy Houston's Bass Tournament U.S.A.
game.desc: Jimmy Houston Bass Tournament U.S.A. It's a fishing game. After choosing between training or tournament mode, you select a fishing lake and take your boat to the place where you want to fish. Cast your rod and wait for the fish to bite. Unlike almost all other games in the genre, the view does not show the fish, the camera remains fixed behind the fisherman.

game.name: Joe & Mac 2 : Lost in the Tropics
game.desc: Improving on the original cooperative platform/brawler gameplay, this game adds adventure and role-playing elements that create a more immersive experience compared to the first game. You can now collect coins in levels to purchase Tiki Village items, such as meat to replenish your health, or even remodel your cabin in your home village. The game also uses a password system to track your progress. The game also switches to an overview map so you can wander to the level you want and return to completed levels to earn more money or power-ups.

game.name: Joe & Mac
game.desc: A long time ago, two troglodytes named Joe and Mac lived in a small village. Whether it was demolishing dinosaurs or hang gliding with therodactyls, life for these guys was pretty easy, until a tribe of Neanderthals, while they were out hunting, destroyed their village and kidnapped all the babies and all the women from their caves. These two troglodytes will have to fight through different levels with the help of boomerangs, bones, knives, etc. With the objective of rescuing the women who were kidnapped, at the end of each level we will have to face a dinosaur and defeat it to be able to move on to the next level. The game has two game modes, individual or in pairs, it must be taken into account that in pair mode the two troglodytes can harm each other.

game.name: John Madden Football '93
game.desc: Madden American football series update. What's new are new and improved graphics and animations, including the draw animation and some of the players. There are 28 teams from the '92-'93 season, two All Madden teams and 8 Greatest Ever teams. The game modes are pre-season, regular season, sudden death and playoffs. A special playoff mode for the top 8 teams is also available.

game.name: John Madden Football
game.desc: American Football game. Game modes include regular season, playoffs and sudden death. The game features 16 regular teams plus an All-Madden team, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Different weather conditions come into play when the course is wet, snowy or muddy.

game.name: Judge Dredd
game.desc: Judge Dredd is an action platform game based on the British comic book character of the same name and the 1995 film that tarnished that name. The game was a multi-system release, so it sticks to the standard console jump/shoot/duck formula, although it adds some unique twists, such as wounding enemies so they surrender and can be arrested.

game.name: Jungle Strike
game.desc: Some time after Operation Desert Strike, Ibn Kilbaba, son of Kilbaba S.R, threatens to annihilate the United States. After his father was killed, the people under his control sent his son to flee, along with his father's money and the nuclear weapons program. Kilbaba, more ruthless than his father, longs for revenge for his father's death and decides to spill the blood of those who killed him, the Americans. Kilbaba is now armed and hires Carlos Ortega to help him establish his nuclear weapons program deep in South America. Carlos Ortega, the world's most notorious drug trafficker, also longs for revenge. With his own private army, armed with the most high-tech weapons, he is ready to fight the United States at all costs.

game.name: Jurassic Park Part 2 : The Chaos Continues
game.desc:
A year has passed. No one has set foot in Jurassic Park...until now. As Dr. Grant, you'll venture back to the island, where more dinosaurs than you can imagine await your return, including new species.
It's a totally different game this time. You will realize it once the exciting sounds and graphics grab you. Go solo or team up for terrifying 2-player action. Only you have the power to send these prehistoric monsters back to where they came from. Only you can close the doors in Jurassic Park... for another 65 million years!

game.name: Jurassic Park
game.desc:
HUNT AND YOU WILL BE HUNTED!
If the movie thrilled you, Ocean's REAL 3-D graphics will blow you away.
This is in your face, eye-to-eyeball, full 3-D motion. We'll get you closer to top attractions than ever before. So close, that when you find yourself staring into the nostrils of a hungry bird of prey, you can almost smell its breath.
Play the best game of all time: Jurassic Park in 3-D.
Enjoy your stay!

game.name: Justice League Task Force
game.desc: Batman vs. Superman! Wonder Woman vs. TheFlash! Aquaman vs. Green Arrow! Are you reading this right? For the first time, DC superheroes fight head to head! Become your favorite Justice League superhero or choose evil villains Darkseid, Cheetah or Despero! Test your hero's special powers and awesome signature moves against any character you choose...even Superman vs Superman! Battle from the ends of the earth to Metropolis, Gotham City, Apokolips and more! Incredible, pulse-pounding one-on-one fighting action and super sound FX put this game in a league of its own!

game.name: Ka-blooey
game.desc: Little Bombuzal has to blow up bombs on small islands in this puzzle game. To advance to the next level, all bombs need to detonate. There are various sizes of pumps. The larger ones have such a large explosion radius that Bombuzal cannot shoot them directly, but instead has to explode smaller bombs first and cause a chain reaction. Just as one might imagine, later levels turn into loud explosions that need to be carefully planned. Additionally, later levels introduce all sorts of additional threats and tricks, such as ice floors, moving bombs, disappearing dirt tiles, and much more. Nobody said being a pyromaniac is easy.

game.name: Kawasaki Caribbean Challenge
game.desc: Racing with a Kawasaki Ninja motorcycle or a Jet Ski on three different islands in the Caribbean. When you're ready, take the challenge to see how good you really are! Look down on your vehicle from a bird's eye view and cross bridges, make sharp turns, knock another opponent off the road (or the ocean) and get first place, if you can! You can choose from a selection of 3 motorcycles and 3 Jet Skis when you compete. You must complete 5 laps in each level and try to get first place!

game.name: Kawasaki Superbike Challenge
game.desc:
Kawasaki Superbike Challenge is a motorcycle racing game that uses the same engine as F1. Includes 14 standard-length race tracks, plus the Suzuka 8-hour endurance race, available in both training and championship modes. The game is unlicensed (except by Kawasaki), so all riders and teams are fictional.
The game now has more polygonal objects on the road than F1, and there is still a Turbo mode, which allows for faster racing at the expense of some details. It has the ability to turn the weather on or off (during rainy days, the graphics are darker and the bike has less traction). The number of laps on each course can be 5, 10 or 15, and there are 4 skill levels. Some changes have been made to vehicle handling, to emphasize the shift from cars to bicycles.

game.path: ./Ken Griffey Jr. Presents Major League Baseball (USA).zip
game.name: Ken Griffey Jr. Presents Major League Baseball
game.desc: Ken Griffey Jr. Presents Major League Baseball is a "Nintendo Owned" baseball simulation featuring Ken Griffey Jr. of the Seattle Mariners. This licensed game allows you to play with all 28 Major League teams in their own stadiums and over 700 player names (not similarities). You control your pitcher or batter, as well as your fielders. The game allows you to play and save a game season of 26, 78 or 162.
game.image: ./media/images/Ken Griffey Jr. Presents Major League Baseball (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Ken Griffey Jr. Presents Major League Baseball (USA).png

game.name: Ken Griffey Jr.'s Winning Run
game.desc:
Ken Griffey Jr.'s Winning Run is a licensed arcade baseball game featuring MLB's own Ken Griffey Jr. Released in 1996, it contains all 28 MLB teams and logos from that era, with rosters containing fictitious names for the players (Ken Griffey Jr is the only real player in the game).
Along with exhibition games, there are different game modes to compete in. In the MLB Challenge, players start with a weak team and face all of the major MLB clubs to climb the rankings. There is also a full World Series, All-Star games and the MLB League. In league modes, up to eight players can choose a team and play a season of 26, 52, or 162 games. Between matches, players can change the lineup and rotation, and swap players.

game.name: Kendo Rage
game.desc: Join Jo on the world's strangest summer vacation. Jo is into Kendo, Japanese fencing, so her parents sent her to Japan to study under sensei Osaki. Osaki is the greatest swordmaster ever, but he looks like a green-haired cyberpunk. To add to the strangeness, Osaki gives you a talisman that transforms you into a 1970s superhero. You've never seen such crazy or fun action. Kendo Rage is the fury.

game.name: Kevin Keegan's Player Manager
game.desc: Kevin Keegan's Player Manager combines a football management simulator with the Kick Off football game. Kick Off game includes multiple skill levels, Challenge Cup and practice options. The Manager offers three levels of managerial skills, three divisional leagues and two Cup competitions. Options to play on the field or watch and get predictable results by computer.

game.name: Kick Off 3 : European Challenge
game.desc: The third title in the Kick Off series is the first to offer an isometric view instead of the old top-down view. There are four competitions in the game (World Cup Finals, League, Elimination Cup and Challenge). There are several options for game speed and ball control to suit novices and experienced players alike. Each of the game's 32 teams has a different style of play, so no two games are the same. Each team also has "key players", such as "Liberos" and "Wingers", who play a fundamental role in that team's style of play. Kick Off 3 offers two styles of play: Arcade and Simulation. The difference is that in Arcade mode you can disable rules to focus purely on reflexes.

game.name: Kick Off
game.desc: Kick Off is an improved version of the very popular soccer game developed by Dino Dini for consoles. Includes 40 teams (16 national and 24 clubs), with the ability to edit team names and jerseys and player names and appearance. Game modes include friendlies, national championship and Cup (composed of eight English teams), the European League (16 European teams) and the International Cup (eight teams). Training allows you to practice free kicks, passing, shooting and dribbling without opposition. Players can compete 1v1, or play cooperatively against the computer on the same team. Other playing options include player speed, wind and grass cut, depending on average typical length, offside rules, extra time and difficulty level.

game.name: Kid Klown in Crazy Chase
game.desc:
Play as a clown, trying to finish the level while avoiding Blackjack booby traps.
To successfully finish each level, you will have to defeat the fuse. What is the fuse? At the beginning of each level, there is a bomb fuse in the same place as you, you must get to the end of the level faster than it does to prevent the big bomb from going off. Additionally, you will also need to find all 4 card symbols before you can finish. If you don't, you'll reach the beginning of the level and have another chance.

game.name: Killer Instinct
game.desc: Don't wait in endless arcade queues to play: Killer Instinct comes to Super NES with action, graphics and sound that annihilates all other combat games. Fulgore, Jago, B.Orchid, Spinal and all your favorite warriors compete in the Ultratech KI Tournament. Each combatant engages in the Combo KI Theory of connected moves and finishing tactics to destroy their opponents. With incredible displays of eyelasers, ice spearers, wind kicks, and laser lasers, these fearless fighters demonstrate their prowess in battle. But remember, if you lose, it's a zero hero!

game.name: King Arthur & The Knights of Justice
game.desc: Based on the cartoon series of the same name, King Arthur and the knights of Camelot have been locked inside glass by Morgana Le Faye. Only the Spell of Spells could free them. Merlin, knowing that the world would be ruined without King Arthur using his magic to search all of space and time for replacements. Finding the New York Knights football team and their quarterback, Arthur King, Merlin transports them back to Camelot and gives them magical armor. Transformed into; Sir Arthur, Sir Breeze, Sir Brick, Sir Darren, Sir Gallop, Sir Lancelot, Sir Lug, Sir Phil, Sir Tone, Sir Trunk, Sir Wally and Sir Zeke must rescue the real Knights of the Round Table. To do so, Arthur must retrieve the 12 keys to truth from Morgana's lieutenants, each of which can only be touched by a specific knight. However, in order to defeat them, Arthur must first recover Excalibur and overcome other tasks.

game.name: King Arthur's World
game.desc:
This is a 2D side scrolling strategy game. You take the role of King Arthur and lead your army into battle against evil. You will travel to many worlds, including fighting dark knights, underworld orcs and cloud giants. One of the few games that is compatible with the Super NES Mouse.
They give you a certain amount of troops in each level. Passwords are used to save your progress between levels. Levels have enemies you must thwart, traps you must avoid, and gold to earn.

game.name: King of Dragons
game.desc: We can choose from a total of five different characters, which are the elf, the sorcerer, the fighter, the cleric and the dwarf. Each of them will have their pros and cons, and so for example the elf is the fastest of all and capable of attacking from a distance, while the fighter is stronger and more resistant. By choosing one of the characters, or two if we play two-player mode, we will start playing. In each of the levels we will advance and face different types of enemies to finally face a final boss, like in any other beat'em up. In addition to the ability to attack and jump, we also have magic. The levels are usually quite short, but in exchange we have a good number of them.

game.name: King of the Monsters 2
game.desc: As in the original, in this version in the normal story mode we can only choose three of the monsters (who have the role of heroes). The style of play changes radically with respect to the first part or the Mega Drive port, because before the combats themselves we will have a small beat'em up section in which we will have to advance with the monster of our choice while we kill different enemies and destroy buildings and military vehicles to obtain items. The boss fights are similar to those in the first part, which almost looks like a WWF game, as opposed to the Mega Drive port, which has movements and a way of playing more typical of a Street Fighter-style fighting game.

game.name: King of the Monsters
game.desc: The city is gradually destroyed as the two creatures fight. Players can also interact with the landscape by picking up canisters and such, to use as weapons against the other player.

game.name: Kirby Super Star
game.desc:
Dream Land is under siege again! Our hero, Kirby, returns to instigate a rescue. King Dedede is taking away Dream Land's food supply, but he's not the only one! Dyna Blade, Meta Knight, and a bunch of other evil baddies are on the loose and wreaking havoc across the land.
Use any of Kirby's amazing powers to create a "helper" to help you in battle. Or have a friend join you for two-player action by taking control of Kirby's helper. Help Kirby work his way through EIGHT challenging games packed with action and adventure. Enter the fray in Spring Breeze, enter a foot race against King Dedede in Gourmet Race, and take on a winged warrior in Dyna Blade. Upgrade your reaction skills in Megaton Punch and Samurai Kirby, then fight your way through Great Cave Offensive, Revenge of Meta Knight, and Milky Way Wishes. Every game is different AND extra special surprises await you!

game.name: Kirby's Avalanche
game.desc: King Dedede has challenged Kirby and other members of Dream Land to an Avalanche Competition at the Fountain of Dreams. Taking on the challenge, Kirby has decided to make his way through the forest to the Fountain of Dreams to win King Dedede's Avalanche Cup.

game.name: Kirby's Dream Course
game.desc:
Scan the course and see the obstacles ahead. Get ready for the most amazing gameplay imaginable in Kirby's battle against King Dedede!
This onboard challenge brings outrageous dangers and strange surfaces. Warp panels instantly transport you to new and exciting challenges. Operator belts provide higher levels of adventure. Turntables take the action in a whole new direction.
Gordo, Kracko, Whispy Woods and a cast of wacky characters await you. Gain special power-ups including Fireball, Freeze, Spark and Parasol.
