Transform your enemies into stars, revealing eight hidden cups of each wildly different course. Control the strength and angle of your shot and sink Kirby into a hole in one!

game.name: Kirby's Dream Land 3
game.desc:
That means old King Dedede is at it again! He's causing his mischief and Dreamland is in trouble! Kirby, Dreamland's resident hero, sets out to teach Dedede a lesson, this time with the help of many of his good friends!
But wait! Something is wrong! Dedede doesn't seem to be himself...
Looks like Kirby has to stop Dedede and find out what's wrong with him! It almost seems like something is controlling it...

game.name: Knights of the Round
game.desc: Arthur, who had trained to be a great knight, took out the holy sword Excalibur from the rock. After taking it out, Arthur realized that his destiny was to become the first king of the Britons. Merlin then sends Arthur and his two closest companions, Lancelot and Perceval, to overthrow the evil King Garibaldi and unite England.

game.name: Krusty's Super Fun House
game.desc:
Krusty the Clown's Fun House has been invaded by rats. You must help him lock the rats in trap machines to eliminate them. To do this, Krusty must manipulate his environment to set up routes for the rats to head in the right direction. The objects Krusty moves with include blocks, fans, and pieces of pipe.
The traps are operated by other recognizable Simpsons characters: Bart, Homer, Sideshow Mel and Corporal Punishment.

game.name: Kyle Petty's No Fear Racing
game.desc: Kyle Petty's No Fear Racing allows the player to compete on 28 different stock car tracks and choose from a group of customizable cars, each with their own appearances, strengths, and weaknesses. There are three different modes to play. An individual race where the player can choose a car and a track and compete once against a large number of computer opponents. The season allows the player to compete in a full season on all tracks, earning prize money to purchase parts to upgrade their car. They can change parts to maximize performance or even modify the car, such as changing the gear ratio, spoiler height, tire pressure, etc.

game.name: Lagoon
game.desc: In the faraway world of Lakeland, all was peaceful. This was until an evil known as Zerah came and contaminated all the water, making the people sick. You play as Nasir, 'The Champion of Light', and are sent out into the world to destroy demons that seem to be linked to the muddy waters. In his search for good, he will meet people in need and help them. You are able to attack, jump and cast magic on your adventure. You will eventually face Zerah at the end.

game.name: Lamborghini American Challenge
game.desc:
Starting with just a basic Lamborghini and $6000, your goal is to reach the top of all 4 racing divisions through success on 60 circuits in the United States. In each division there are 20 rival racers, up to 3 of whom compete in each race at a time.
The races also feature many local drivers (who can take crucial positions away from you and the other drivers in the championship), normal-speed Sunday drivers, and police officers. Before each race you will be briefed on the quality of the locals and the likelihood of police presence.

game.name: Last Action Hero
game.desc: Danny Madigan is watching a preview of his favorite hero Jack Slater's latest movie when he is mysteriously catapulted onto the screen; now standing next to his favorite idol. You are Jack Slater, an action movie hero, who faces off against the ax maniac "The Ripper", who is holding a school under siege, and Benedict, a villain who wants to use Danny's ticket to bring terror to the real world.

game.name: Legend
game.desc: The action doesn't stop, the villains are gruesome, the weapons are wicked and the graphics are sensational. Travel back to medieval times when your sword was the only law. Where the rich and powerful reigned over the land with an iron fist of terror. Only you can free the people of Sellech and prevent Clovis from resurrecting the evil power and curses of Beldor. Enter the Black Temple and fight your way through worlds of wizards and fire-breathing dragons. Conquer the baddest boss monsters ever and fight your way through the unexplored world of Legend.

game.name: Lemmings 2 : The Tribes
game.desc: As was already the case in the first part, the primary mission of each level is to get a certain number of lemmings from one point to another, losing as few of them as possible. To do this, we must use the different skills that lemmings have such as digging, climbing, using an umbrella to fall more slowly or building stairs. As a novelty, many more new skills are included, apart from the eight that were already in the first part, although basically the game continues to maintain the same style.

game.name: Lemmings
game.desc: Lemmings is divided into several levels, grouped into four difficulty levels. Each level comprises both destructible landscape elements such as rocks, indestructible sections such as steel plates, and numerous obstacles such as chasms, high walls, large drops, pools of water or lava, and booby traps. Each level also includes one or more entry points and one or more exits. The goal is to guide a certain percentage of blue-haired, blue-shirted lemmings from the entrance to the exit, clearing or creating a safe passage through the landscape for the lemmings to use.

game.name: Lester the Unlikely
game.desc:
One day Lester was walking through the loading docks of Seaport City reading the new issue of his favorite comic, "Super Duper Hero Squad." Feeling a little tired from playing video games the night before, he looked for a comfortable place to finish his comic.
Just before reaching the beach, Lester passed out from sheer exhaustion. Now, your real adventure begins... It's up to you to help Lester get home.

game.name: Lethal Enforcers
game.desc:
Grab your gun and be the cop you need to rid the streets of criminals and make your day hell. Aim wisely and quickly, otherwise your lives will be quickly lost in this first-person arcade shooter, clearing the streets. The higher the difficulty level, the more crimes there will be to eliminate, but be careful with the other weapons that can help you along the way.
Go straight into the chaos, practice at target range, or have a friend back you up in two-player mode. Use a gun accessory or play with the gamepad.

game.name: Lethal Weapon
game.desc: In the game we can control both Agent Riggs and Murtaugh, each with their own attributes. While Riggs has a better shot, Murtaugh has a longer jump. With any of the characters we have to carry out a series of missions, which we can choose from the beginning, and among them is rescuing Leo Getz, defusing a bomb in a shopping center or simply ending a terrorist gang. Once we complete all the missions, we will access the last level of the game. In each of the missions we have to control the chosen character through a specific scenario, killing the enemies that bother us with shots or blows, overcoming obstacles, climbing stairs or jumping from platforms to platforms.

game.name: Liberty or Death
game.desc: The European Wars against Spain and France have been costly for the British Empire. In order to raise additional funds for the war effort, the Crown collects taxes from the unrepresented New World colonies. This act forces the colonies of the New World to protest and boycott British rule. In 1775, the Crown, alarmed by protests, boycotts, and political instability in the New World, sends troops to subdue any rebellious efforts by New World colonists. This threatening approach causes the Thirteen Colonies to rebel. Thus begins the War of Independence in the New World (American Revolutionary War).

game.name: Lock On
game.desc: Super Air Diver is an aviation simulator for Super Nintendo. At the command of one of the two originally proposed combatants, you must defend your base and eliminate enemies. You will participate in a variety of missions against air and ground forces and can fly four different aircraft (the British Tornado, the Japanese FSX, the A-10 Warthog and the F-14 Tomcat) with their powerful weaponry such as Vulcan cannons and missiles that seek out fighters, tanks and other enemies, detecting heat.

game.name: Looney Tunes B-Ball
game.desc:
Looney Tunes B-Ball is a 2-on-2 basketball game, similar to the more well-known NBA Jam. However, Looney Tunes is much more casual and silly, although this level of silliness is set by the player via the Wackiness meter in the main menu. Players choose their teams from the likes of: Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Elmer Fudd, Wile E. Coyote, Tasmanian Devil, Sylvester, Yosemite Sam and Marvin Martian. Each player has unique stats for their shooting, three-pointers, defense, stamina, and speed.
Once on the court, the player can pass the ball, shoot the ball, take a burst of speed, or unleash a special defensive ability or special offensive ability. These abilities include cream pies, time bombs, sticks of dynamite and other fun toys. from ACME Corporation.

game.name: Lord of Darkness
game.desc: Nobunaga's Ambition 2: Lord of Darkness is the fourth game in the Nobunaga series (but only the third has been localized in English). Nobunaga's story takes place during the Japanese civil war of the 16th century. In a war strategy game, 15 different warlords are represented in various territories. One to eight human players can play, controlling different leaders and factions. Gameplay takes place in one of two scenarios; the beginning of the civil war in 1555 or Nobunaga surrounded by his enemies in 1571. Managing the population, supplies and army are the gameplay and successfully manipulating these numbers in the right combination to attack and defend against hostile intentions is what will bring your forces to victory.

game.name: Lost Vikings 2
game.desc: The lost boys are back: Erik the Swift, Baelog the Fierce and Olaf the Stout. This action strategy is not for the brain blade. In their latest adventure, the trio was trying to escape the evil alien captor Tomator. Now that they're coming to Tomator, they're going to be back home. The vikes escape together or not at all. Therefore, it is your challenge to complete each of the levels with all three characters alive, a kick'n! Plug it in, start up and fight! Norse by Norsewest.

game.name: Lucky Luke
game.desc: In the game, as Lucky Luke you have to arrest four Dalton brothers: Averell, William, Jack and Joe. In your mission you will progress from level to level shooting the evil cowboys, the jail breakers and the bad Indians with your revolver; collecting bullets, dynamite, sheriff's stars and other useful items; run, jump, crouch and climb. Locations range from Fortresses, Cities and Prisons to Mines, Trains and Ghost Rooms. In each level, you must complete different presentations to progress, whether it is to free a Bank Director, or to collect Three Nuggets for Miner to obtain a Nitroglycerin, or to build a Totem for Apaches, etc. At the end of some levels he faces the Big Boss, often Dalton's.

game.name: Lufia & the Fortress of Doom
game.desc: The Sinsitrals, four masters of Doom, came to this land on their floating island 100 years ago. You will begin your quest by traveling back in time to join in a tremendous battle against them, and you will determine the outcome. When you return to the present day, you and Lufia, your companion, must join forces with two others to prevent the Sinistrals from regaining control of your world. It will be a long and difficult task: this land is larger than most RPGs. And in the end, the balance of destiny will be overturned in a contest of love and betrayal that could destroy them all.

game.name: Lufia II : Rise of the Sinistrals
game.desc: This exciting sequel to the Lufian legend pits monster hunter Maxim and six fellow adventurers against the sinister sinisters. The story unfolds in a complex maze, challenging you with great battles, puzzles and many surprises. You can even grow your own monsters! You will enjoy countless hours on a fantastic journey in the world of Lufia!

game.name: Madden NFL '94
game.desc: Madden NFL '94 is the third in the Madden series of football games for the SNES. It features 80 teams: 28 teams from the 1993 season, 38 Super Bowl teams from 1966-1991, 12 All Star franchise teams from 1950, and two "All-Madden" teams: one for the 1993 season and one for the 20-year time span. You can play these teams in a regular exhibition game or a sudden death game, or take the teams from 1993 for an entire season. You can also enter the playoffs with the 1993 teams, the Super Bowl champions, or the All Star franchise teams. Unlike many other sports games, saving a season is done by password instead of storing the data in a saved game.

game.name: Madden NFL 95
game.desc:
John Madden has returned in the 1995 version of Madden NFL. Play in the exhibition, Super Bowl, playoffs or full season with any of the 1994 teams or all Madden teams.
This time around, you can select whether or not to include weather conditions, new player animations (high steppin', QB slides), a larger field, and over 100 injuries.
It also includes windowless passing, all new Madden-designed strategies, and team matchup that shows how your players compare to the other team at their position.

game.name: Madden NFL 96
game.desc: Madden NFL '96 is a football video game designed for the 1995 NFL season, licensed by the NFL. Features John Madden on the cover. The AI ​​has been boosted and can now rush through two-minute drill situations, spike the ball, and cover receivers more effectively. Among the innovations in Madden 96, the Create-a-Player feature was added, which included many position-specific mini-games that would determine the player's ability. The game was also the first in the Madden series to feature secret "classic" teams, which were unlocked by playing any of the 28 pre-expansion NFL franchises in the playoffs and winning Super Bowl XXX with that team. The 28 pre-expansion teams were represented by a classic equivalent of the era, spanning from 1960 (Philadelphia Eagles) to 1986 (New York Giants), although all players were identified as number only.

game.name: Madden NFL 97
game.desc: Welcome to Madden NFL 97, the game that captures the excitement of a 30-yard touchdown pass, the strategy of a well-executed scoring drive, and the atmosphere of a crisp fall afternoon at the stadium. Madden NFL 97 offers state-of-the-art graphics and sound, and with modem and network support, it's ready to test your competitive skills.

game.name: Madden NFL 98
game.desc:
Gameplay expert John Madden relicenses Electronic Arts' flagship football simulation. New features for 1998 include more advanced Quarterback features, such as the ability to play lob passes and adjust timing patterns, and more instinctive AI features to adjust as the game progresses. Squad features have also been advanced, with the opportunity to create plays and change them.
The gameplay is very similar to the other editions, with the full season on offer, as well as the playoffs and the Superbowl. Everything is presented TV style, with analysis and play-by-play reporting. Contemporary NFL teams are joined by great squads from the past.

game.name: Magic Boy
game.desc: Join Magic Boy as he tries to become a master magician, and he does this by shooting enemies, putting them in a bag, and throwing them away. You must also go through four areas: Sand Land, Wet World, Plastic Plaza, and Future Zone. There are also several power-ups to help you in your quest.

game.name: Magic Sword
game.desc:
As a hero, you must climb a tower full of monsters to defeat Drokkmar, master of the Blackorb. To do this, you must defeat his army that stands in your way with whatever weapons you carry. Health decreases through contact with various monsters, attacks, traps, and the passage of time. It increases when finding food. Every few points, a "Food Fairy" appears and also leaves food.
Throughout your journey, you can smash open chests to find treasure and artifacts. Some of these artifacts can be recovered and game-altering, such as providing more damage or increasing magic power. Also along your journey, you can collect keys, which are used to free imprisoned allies, which not only help you defeat the monsters, but also leave you an item that will help you on your quest. Only one person can join you at a time.

game.name: Manchester United Championship Soccer
game.desc: All teams from the 1994-95 FA Premier League are represented. Also included are star teams and several European clubs that participated in the European competitions of the 1994/95 season. During gameplay, the player can choose two types of views: top-down and isometric view of the field.

game.name: Mario Is Missing!
game.desc: Don't look now, but Bowser is back, and this time he's in your world! But where is that genius of reptilian problems doing his cowardly actions? And what has he done with Mario? Welcome to missing Mario! Take a hike with your travel agent, Luigi, and see the world! Locate problem turtles. Find out where in the world you are and what happened to Mario. If your understanding of geography is good enough, you'll get the goods, step on the hoods, and get Mario out of Bowser's horrible boarding house. A learning adventure that the whole family can share! This isn't Koopa mayhem. It's a fun way to learn about our world!

game.name: Mario Paint
game.desc: Mario Paint allows you to draw, paint, animate and compose music! Creation! Your imagination is your only limit with an incredible variety of drawing tools. Animation! Add an exciting dimension by creating moving animations with up to 9 frame sequences. Orchestration! Compose your own songs by selecting from more than 15 different musical sounds and the entire scale of notes. Coordination! Increase your prowess with the Super NES Mouse by playing Gnat Attack, the clever fly swatter game included inside.

game.name: Mario's Early Years : Fun with Letters
game.desc: In FUN WITH LETTERS, children are introduced to the fundamentals of letters and sounds through numerous learning worlds: alphabet, vowel, first letter, missing letter, construction, sound, sentence and more. Your child simply guides Mario, selecting objects on the screen that Mario flinches and bounces off of, frequently affirming your child's correct choice. Moms and dads can interact and play too. Mario invites you to join in the fun and watch your children as they become fully engaged in the learning process. Through the MARIO'S EARLY YEARS series, children will discover the world around them by exploring the elements of that world. The MARIO'S EARLY YEARS series covers a multitude of topics, helping children gain valuable skills and develop a rich, active imagination.

game.name: Mario's Early Years : Fun with Numbers
game.desc:
In FUN WITH NUMBERS, children are introduced to the basics of mathematics through shape, number, same and different, counting, comparison, number and pattern of worlds.
Children simply guide Mario, selecting objects on the screen, which playfully illustrate number concepts. Moms and dads can interact and play too. Mario invites you to join in the fun and watch your children as they become fully engaged in the learning process. Through the MARIO'S EARLY YEARS series, children will discover the world around them by exploring the elements of that world. The MARIO'S EARLY YEARS series covers a multitude of topics, helping children gain valuable skills and develop a rich, active imagination.

game.name: Mario's Early Years : Preschool Fun
game.desc:
In PRESCHOOL FUN, children develop concepts through the exploration of shapes, colors, sounds, opposites and numbers. With Mario's help, your child learns to define and identify these topics without pressure. His son simply guides Mario, selecting objects on the screen that Mario flinches and bounces off of, frequently affirming his son's correct choice. With Mario, Luigi, Princess Toadstool, and all their friends as classmates, your child can take the biggest step since he learned to walk.
That's because MARIO'S EARLY YEARS is about learning to think in a way that doesn't feel like learning, but more like playing. Moms and dads can interact and play too. Mario invites you to join in the fun and watch your children as they become fully engaged in the learning process.

game.name: Mario's Time Machine
game.desc: Bowser is at it again! He is using a time machine, called the Timulator, to loot historical artifacts from the past, in order to supply his museum. He plans to destroy the time machine afterwards, and thus change the course of history forever. It's up to Mario to stop Bowser and return all the stolen artifacts to their rightful place in history!

game.name: Mark Davis' The Fishing Master
game.desc:
In Mark Davis' The Fishing Master, the player can take control of fishing legend Mark Davis and fish in five different lakes and even compete in a fishing tournament to win a trophy.
The gameplay is reminiscent of Super Black Bass. The player chooses a spot to fish using an overhead map where the player is taken to a perspective behind the person to cast their reel. Once the player casts their line, the view will change to a split screen with the original view on top with an underwater view on the bottom to see the bait and an approaching fish.

game.name: Marko's Magic Football
game.desc: Welcome to Marko's world, a world of cartoon madness. Experience the addictive mix of soccer skills and platform action that combine to create a magnificent gaming experience. Add in the most incredible graphics you've ever seen and the result is Marko's Magic Football. It's like playing a cartoon.

game.path: ./Marvel Super Heroes - War of the Gems (USA).zip
game.name: Marvel Super Heroes in War of the Gems
game.desc: The most powerful collection of MARVEL SUPER HEROES now unites to fight the treacherous mobs of Super-Villians! A mysterious enemy has launched his plan to rule the world by collecting the Infinity Stones. While each gem controls a force of nature, combined they control unlimited power. The fate of the entire world depends on your ability to defeat this sinister plan before the gems combine. Master the brute force of your favorite hero to face this life or death challenge. You choose the hero that best suits each mission and control all the action, like breaking barriers with the Incredible Hulk or facing challenges with Spider-Man's webs and climbing ability. It's an incredible action-adventure that requires skill, cunning and reflexes to defeat a diabolical plot and the most incredible array of corrupt Super Villains ever assembled.
game.image: ./media/images/Marvel Super Heroes - War of the Gems (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Marvel Super Heroes - War of the Gems (USA).png

game.name: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein
game.desc:
Based on the 1994 remake film Frankenstein, the player is the artificial man created by Victor Frankenstein. After Victor rejects his creation due to its hideous appearance, the creation flees from Victor and swears revenge on him.
The player goes through a series of levels, fighting anything that attacks with a wooden stick. It is possible to put the tip of the stick in the fire, swinging it on the fire torches located on the walls. The player can also use a special attack: a blue ball that comes out of the creation's hands, taking away some of the player's life. There are also some simple puzzles to be solved in order to get through the levels.

game.name: Math Blaster : Episode 1
game.desc: A sequel to the original Math Blaster! games, Math Blaster: In Search of Spot is an educational title with arcade elements designed to help students learn mathematics while having fun. The game allows students to practice basic addition, subtraction, multiplication and division skills as well as fractions, decimals, percentages, estimation and number patterns. Subjects can be practiced separately or together in review. Six difficulty levels are provided.

game.name: Maui Mallard in Cold Shadow
game.desc: Detective Maui Mallard is looking to get away from his job and enjoy some relaxation and peace on a seemingly quiet tropical island, but what he didn't know is that his dream of lying on the beach sipping cocktails was going to collapse like a house of cards. As soon as you set your palmiped feet on the island, Maui finds the place plunged into chaos. Apparently the reason for all the fuss is the disappearance of an ancient idol called Shabuhm Shabuhm, which according to the islanders protects this entire beautiful tropical paradise. And what's worse, if this idol is not recovered, the entire island will explode into pieces! Maui seems to be the only one capable of finding the idol, or at least he thinks so, since the natives don't seem to trust his abilities too much. If you want to recover your dream of enjoying a peaceful vacation, you will have no choice but to get going and recover that idol. But it's not going to be an easy mission, so he may soon have to resort to his secret identity known as Cold Shadow.

game.name: Mecarobot Golf
game.desc:
In Mecarobot Golf, a mechanical golfer by the name of Eagle was banned from competing in professional human tournaments when it was determined that his mechanical brain that can determine right angles was an unfair advantage. Instead, the engineers who built Eagle have built their own course and the player has taken the challenge against the mechanical golfer.
The player does not get to play as the robot, but instead attempts to hit the robot in a standard 18 rounds of regular golf, including weather conditions and obstacles such as sand traps, bunkers, water hazards and trees. Players can also practice their swing at the Driving Range to learn the fundamentals of the game.

game.name: MechWarrior 3050
game.desc: MechWarrior 3050 is Activision's second Battletech-based game for the Super NES. This time around he is seen in an isometric view as opposed to the first person view from the previous game. The game also features a unique 2-player mode where one player controls the lower half of the mech to navigate the map while the second player controls the upper torso which moves independently.

game.name: MechWarrior
game.desc: In 3017, when Herras Ragen was 12 years old, his father, Colonel Joseph T. Ragen, a soldier in the House Davion army, was working to infiltrate and destroy a renegade mercenary cartel called Dark Wing Lance. However, he was discovered and the Dark Wing took their revenge: somehow, they had discovered the location of the Ragen family residence. Under the cover of night, they attacked and killed everyone. Only young Herras, who was at a friend's house at the time of the massacre, survived. Unknown to him, the dark wing made an agreement that after the strike, they would separate for ten years and maintain an absolute code of secrecy before regrouping again to continue their nefarious operations. Now, in 3027, that time is up. Now a young man, Herras has waited the last decade for his chance at revenge.

game.name: Mega Man 7
game.desc:
Dr. Wily's quest to rule the world ends abruptly at the hands of Mega Man, so what's a villain to do? Create a distraction and get out of prison! Mega Man has his hands full as 4 gigantic machines leave Dr. Wily's laboratory to lay waste to the city, but... who is behind this new plot as Wily sits behind bars?
Dr. Wily knew that his diabolical acts would end in failure one day. Then, as the robots in his mind attack by remote control, the sinister doctor breaks out of prison and flies away in his spaceship. Titan Titan is fooled!
With the help of Rush, Roll, and Dr. Light, can Mega Man put the slippery Dr. Wily back in the prison where he belongs? The future of the world depends on Megaman's every move.

game.name: Mega Man Soccer
game.desc:
Dr. Wily will stop at nothing to take over the world and who would have thought his next move would be to attack the world's most popular sport? Dr. Light is ready and is preparing Mega Man for a new type of battle.
As the two best soccer teams in the nation took the field for the championship, suddenly the stadium was attacked with bursts of fire and the field was engulfed in smoke. The smoke cleared and some very familiar robots replaced the players on the field. Dr. Wily had sent his best robot creations, such as Skull Man, Cut Man, Wood Man, Needle Man and Pharaoh Man to rule the world of football.
But Dr. Light was prepared for this new tactic. Almost instantly, a reserve of Mega Man robots appeared to take on the forces of evil in the strangest football game ever seen.

game.name: Mega Man X
game.desc:
Near the end of his life, Dr. Light manages to create the first of a new series of robots that will change the world. Capable of thinking and making decisions, this new robot presents great danger as well as great possibilities. Fearful of the possible consequences of unleashing his creation on the world, Dr. Light decides to seal him in a capsule and test his systems until they are completely reliable. The future will have to decide its destiny...
Released from the capsule by Dr. Cain, "X" is born in the future world where robot rebellions are a thing of the past. But when Dr. Cain attempts to implement Dr. Light's designs into a new series of Reploids, something goes horribly wrong. Now the future is on the brink of destruction and a new Mega Man must emerge to confront Sigma and his forces before the human race is wiped out from the planet!

game.name: Mega Man X2
game.desc:
Just when Mega Man While 8 all-new X-Hunters occupy Mega Man X, a triple threat plots to resurrect an all-too-familiar secret weapon!
The good Dr. Light supplies Mega Man X with incredible new abilities hidden in capsules buried deep beneath the surface. And with new vehicles like the mobile attack cycle and the powers he gains from the X-Hunters, Mega Man X will be ready to face his destiny as Maverick Hunter. Now it's all or Zero for Mega Man

game.name: Mega Man X3
game.desc:
Mega Man X and his faithful companion Zero have a new force to be reckoned with. Who or what has caused a Maverick revolt in the experimental utopia known as Doppler Town?
Named after the reploid scientist, Doppler Town was supposed to be a place where humans and reploids could live in harmony. After discovering a virus that was turning reploids into Mavericks, Doppler's antivirus was a huge success. But Doppler became infected with the virus and assembled a team to eliminate the Maverick Hunter Units. The Doppler effect is about to unfold, with Mega Man X and Zero the only cure for the deadly virus!

game.name: Mega-Lo-Mania
game.desc: Mega-Lo-Mania is a God Simulation like no other. It's unbridled tumult as men from all walks of historical life fight each other to control a planet.

game.name: Metal Combat : Falcon's Revenge
game.desc:
Following the events of Battle Clash, the Battle Game Bosses had been defeated. But the world did not return to peace and instead new Chiefs and new machines rose to rule the world. As before, the Bosses use giant robots known as Standing Tanks (STs). Seeing the world in trouble, the hero pilots who had defeated the Battle Bosses decided to re-enter the Battle Game using an upgraded version of their ST, the Falcon. The truth behind the Battle Game will take the Falcon deep into space...
Metal Combat: Falcon's Revenge is a first-person shooter designed for the Super Scope Light Gun. The gameplay is identical to Battle Clash. The player takes the role of the giant robot gunner, movement is handled automatically by the game, scrolling the screen.

game.name: Metal Marines
game.desc: Metal Marines is an isometric strategy game. Zorgeuf and his lieutenants. Controlling one side of a conflict. The player controls the logistics of the base to guarantee the assets necessary to wage war. On each map, the player places underground command bases; If they are all destroyed, the battle is lost. The player must manage his money resources to build new buildings or upgrade existing facilities on the map. Different buildings include power plants, factories, economic centers, radar systems, anti-aircraft missiles, fake buildings and fake HQ bases, minefields, gun pods, missile launchers, naval metal hooks and even ICBMs. At any time, the player can order an attack and choose which assets to fire at the opponent. Missiles, Metal Marines and ICBMs use different levels of fuel. Metal Marines will soon be deployed in the near future.

game.name: Metal Morph
game.desc: In the year 2214, Earth has made contact with another dimension, known as Otherside. As their ambassador, they choose to send the Metal Morph, a being made of living metal, as it is the only being that can survive inter-dimensional travel. The people of Earth have created a Hypergate, which links the two galaxies. Upon arriving at the alien destination, the Metal Morph is quickly ambushed and taken to a foreign laboratory for study so they can travel through the Hypergate itself. The Metal Morph quickly escapes and begins to return to his sabotaged ship...

game.name: Metal Warriors
game.desc:
The year is 2102 and the Dark Axis Forces, an intergalactic army that threatens to enslave Earth, are knocking on your door with a plasma greeting. You have at your disposal a robotic armor with three tons of lightsaber, energy cannon, jet-powered robotic armor.
What are you going to do?

game.name: Michael Andretti's IndyCar Challenge
game.desc:
Indy Car Challenge allows the player to get behind the car of some of the fastest racing cars on Earth. The player gets to compete at 16 different Indy tracks across the US, with some tracks also in Canada and Australia. The game view is set behind the back of the car and there are three different camera angles during replay races along with a "handheld" camera that allows the player to rotate around the car in 360 degrees.
There is also an option for two friends to compete head to head with split screen. The game also features the likeness of Indy car legend, Michael Andretti, who gives the player advice before each race.

game.path: ./Michael Jordan - Chaos in the Windy City (USA).zip
game.name: Michael Jordan : Chaos in the Windy City
game.desc:
This is not a pick up game...
It's a twisted adventure created by the vengeful angry scientist Dr. Skull Max! He has kidnapped an entire basketball team. And they are locked in every corner of their dark and dangerous lair under the Chicago street. Control Michael Jordan's every move as he takes on the evil Dr. Max Cranium to rescue his teammates.
game.image: ./media/images/Michael Jordan - Chaos in the Windy City (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Michael Jordan - Chaos in the Windy City (USA).png

game.path: ./Mickey Mania - The Timeless Adventures of Mickey Mouse (USA).zip
game.name: Mickey Mania : The Timeless Adventures of Mickey Mouse
game.desc:
Mickey Mouse has the opportunity to go down memory lane and walk through the timeless adventures he has had. Mickey Mania is a platform game where all levels are based on the most famous Mickey cartoons. The levels range from around 75, starting with "Steamboat Willie" and going all the way to "The Prince and the Pauper".
The gameplay consists mainly of jumping and marble throwing against enemies, with an occasional puzzle element.
game.image: ./media/images/Mickey Mania - The Timeless Adventures of Mickey Mouse (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Mickey Mania - The Timeless Adventures of Mickey Mouse (USA).png

game.path: ./Mickey's Playtown Adventure - A Day of Discovery! (USA) (Proto).zip
game.name: Mickey's Playtown Adventure : A Day of Discovery!
game.desc: This game has never been released, as it remained in prototype status. In any case, it is for children from 3 to 8 years old. In fact, we can't really lose because our young player will simply perform a series of everyday life actions, such as getting dressed, making breakfast, watering the plants, feeding Pluto, repairing pipes, etc. . One can interact with many elements of the environment, even if the purpose of this or that action is just to make one laugh (toast being toasted, which is the log, Mickey being watered, etc.).
game.image: ./media/images/Mickey's Playtown Adventure - A Day of Discovery! (USA) (Proto).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Mickey's Playtown Adventure - A Day of Discovery! (USA) (Proto).png

game.name: Mickey's Ultimate Challenge
game.desc:
One night, as Mickey (or Minnie) lay in bed reading a book of fairy tales, he began to wonder what it would be like to live in a far away land, in a magical castle. When he fell asleep, he woke up in the Kingdom of Beanwick, constantly tormented by earthquakes. He then offers his help to solve the mystery behind those earthquakes.
Mickey Ultimate Challenge is a puzzle game where the player chooses Mickey or Minnie to play. They will find five characters from the Disney universe in the kingdom, and they will be asked to help them with various tasks.
Each task is a different puzzle, given by a specific character. Daisy, for example, will ask for help to clean the castle paintings hanging on a wall. The task is, in fact, a memory game, where Mickey or Minnie must clear matching pairs of images. After completing a task, they will receive a gift.
After completing all the tasks, Mickey or Minnie must exchange the gifts they won with the correct characters. For example, after finishing Goofy's task, you will receive your hammer. The player must then guess who among the other characters would like to receive that hammer.
Giving the right items to the right characters will allow Mickey or Minnie to access the ultimate puzzle and character.

game.name: Micro Machines 2 : Turbo Tournament
game.desc: The second game in the Micro Machines series. As in its predecessor, you are behind the wheel of an extremely small car. You run around interesting places, such as a table, a tree house and many more. Controlling the cars is sometimes quite difficult, especially if you don't know the tracks (the top-down view is not very clear). The CD-ROM version also features CD-Audio music and a track editor.

game.name: Micro Machines
game.desc:
If you're bored of racing Formula 1 cars, rally cars or MotoGP bikes in their natural habitats, the Micro Machines series might be for you. These are racing miniatures that represent particular types of vehicles on a particular terrain around the house. Sports car racing on the desk, 4x4s in the sandbox, Formula 1 cars on a pool table, and more.
These levels were full of variation. The Snooker tables have a painted track, although it is open to drift (as are most levels), and it had you running through the pockets and over the edge of the table. Tanks also ran, with the ability to shoot your opponent if they got directly in front of you. Desktop levels include folders to jump, pencil sharpeners to avoid, and plenty of sight gags in the open task.

game.path: ./Might and Magic II - Gates to Another World (Europe).zip
game.name: Might and Magic II
game.desc:
The sequel to the successful Might and Magic I, which boasted better graphics, a larger world, but still pretty much the same game engine and presentation. Embark on a glorious journey and save the world from CRON and yourself.
A balanced party is a necessity in this game. There are several locations and items that are restricted to certain genders, alignments, or races. A party made up of good human men won't get you very far. Time plays an important role in this game. Time travel is a part of it, but on a more basic level, you will find that the characters age as the game continues. If you wait too long, your characters' stats will change to reflect their aging.
game.image: ./media/images/Might and Magic II - Gates to Another World (Europe).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Might and Magic II - Gates to Another World (Europe).png

game.path: ./Might and Magic III - Isles of Terra (USA).zip
game.name: Might and Magic III : Isles of Terra
game.desc:
The third installment of the role-playing series, with a multifaceted plot full of twists and turns. Ease of use was key to the gameplay and interface, and the plot included tons of new twists and turns.
Lead a group of adventurers to rendezvous with the legendary wizard Corak. From dark dungeons, hallways of carved stone and wood to the high frozen peaks of Terra, you will uncover the mysteries surrounding the exotic islands of the Great Sea.
game.image: ./media/images/Might and Magic III - Isles of Terra (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Might and Magic III - Isles of Terra (USA).png

game.path: ./Mighty Morphin Power Rangers - The Fighting Edition (USA).zip
game.name: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers : The Fighting Edition
game.desc: Get ready to rock your world with the Mighty Morphin Power Rangers Fighting Edition. A game of three modes, smash, smash, monster and no holds barred. This two-player simultaneous fighting game features your favorite Power Zord and a series of evil intentions. The Thunder Megazord, Shogun Megazord, Ninja Megazord, Lord Zedd, Goldar and many more compete for total galactic supremacy in the mother of all battles. When the dust clears, only one will remain standing, who will be crowned the most powerful and morphological warrior in the universe?
game.image: ./media/images/Mighty Morphin Power Rangers - The Fighting Edition (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Mighty Morphin Power Rangers - The Fighting Edition (USA).png

game.name: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers : The Movie
game.desc: Were the Power Rangers stripped of their powerful morphological powers and forced to flee the earth? Are Rita Repsula and Lord Zedd overwhelmed by an evil far greater than their combined evil? The Command Center completely destroyed and Zordon on the verge of death? The fate of the world in the slimy hands of Ivan Ooze, the most sinister monster the universe has ever seen? Could this be a bad dream? Don't count on it, it all happens in Morphinominal Mighty Morphin Power Rangers the Movie! And now, you can take on Ivan Ooze, the vile villain in Nintendo history, and a host of his evil minions in this hyper action, seven-level, no-holds-barred brawl with the dazzling graphics and sounds of the Super NES. So, take action and lead the Power Rangers to their greatest victory.

game.name: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers
game.desc:
Don't look now, because her Spell has returned and she is uglier and uglier than ever. This time Rita Repulsa wants to pulverize the Power Rangers once and for all and she's brought all her nasty friends to do her dirty work. But, Jason, Trinl, Billy, Kimberly and Zack are at their best with the awesome power of the Super NES machine on their side. Incredible graphics, incredible sound, and unbeatable action make this battle of good and evil an instant SNES classic.
The game features seven challenging levels of play that end with stunning battles against Rita's most fearsome henchmen, including Bones, Eye Guy, and many more. Only the power of the Super NES puts all the characters and excitement of the hit television series at your fingertips. So, what are you waiting for? Get into the action now with Mighty Morphin Power Rangers?.

game.name: MLBPA Baseball
game.desc: Baseball strategy meets fast-paced arcade gameplay in MLBPA Baseball from Electronic Arts. Details designed to appeal to the die-hard fan include: real players with statistics based on the 1993 season; A full 162-game season mode; Stadium music; animated dashboards; Defensive alignments; cutting games; Decays; And even the double switch. Features designed to appeal to the casual fan include: large colorful arcade graphics; A stadium with lively crowds; A simplified pitching interface that allows players to direct the ball; And a batting interface that relies on timing instead of pointing cursors. The power up game's secret modes await so step up to the plate and take some hacks! Season play can be continued using the passwords provided at the end of each game.

game.name: Mohawk & Headphone Jack
game.desc:
Protea the platform hero with the attitude (well, with the sunglasses) rocks out in this novel but forgotten would be Sonic-killer, collecting CDs (this is pre-Napster, remember) and avoiding segmented slinkies and nasty robot bugs in 7 mazes with no constant "down".
The boneless wonder and his Walkman pour into cracks, splatter against walls, coil into a defensive porcupine-koosh hybrid, always land on his feet (growing feet where his hands were!) and shoot apart into little jelly gibs as a special offensive attack. Rough. And as if a radical surferpunk made of snot wasn't cool enough to boot, a power-up gives him a chopper wheel instead of feet. The guy is the hood ornament on his own bike!
One or two players (not simultaneous)..

game.name: Monopoly
game.desc:
In Monopoly play as an aspiring businessman as you try to get as many properties as possible, making deals and earning money (from each other) to gain a monopoly on the market.
The version of this classic board game for SNES is nice and has an excellent soundtrack.

game.name: Mortal Kombat II
game.desc: Following his failure to defeat Liu Kang in the first Mortal Kombat game, the evil sorcerer Shang Tsung begs his master, Shao Kahn, to spare his life. He tells Shao Kahn that the invitation to Mortal Kombat cannot be refused, and if they have him in Outworld, the Earthrealm warriors must attend. Kahn agrees to this plan and even restores Tsung's youth. He then extends the invitation to Raiden, who gathers his warriors and takes them to Outworld. The new tournament is much more dangerous, as Shao Kahn has home-field advantage, and a victory for Outworld will allow him to subdue Earthrealm.

game.name: Mortal Kombat III
game.desc:
Shao Kahn has won. The kingdom of Earth is no more. To revive his Queen Sindel, Emperor Shao Kahn used Mortal Kombat 2's Outworld Tournament as a diversion while his Shadow Priests revived his fallen Queen on Earth. Once enacted, the dimensional bridge between the two realms connects, allowing Kahn's extermination squads to invade and destroy Earth, and enslave the souls of the population.
A small team of Raiden's "Chosen Warriors" survive the attack: Mortal Kombat champion Liu Kang and his ally Kung Lao, Special Forces agents Sonya Blade and Jax, shaman Nightwolf, riot policeman Stryker, nomad Kabal, and former Lin Kuei warrior Sub-Zero, who has strayed from his clan. Facing the warriors are the mercenary Kano, cyber-ninjas Smoke, Sektor and Cyrax, Sheeva, a Shokan woman, the sorcerer Shang Tsung, and Queen Sindel herself.

game.name: Mortal Kombat
game.desc: Five hundred years ago, an ancient and respected Shaolin fighting tournament, held every 50 years, was corrupted by an evil old sorcerer by the name of Shang Tsung. Shang was accompanied by Prince Goro, a warrior of the Shokan race (a four-armed half-human/half-dragon). Knowing that if ten consecutive championships were won by the Outworld champion, the Earth kingdom would be conquered by evil and fall into darkness, Shang entered Goro into the tournament and had him defeat the great Kung Lao. Goro has been reigning as supreme undefeated fighting champion for five hundred years. As the final tournament approaches, Raiden, God of Thunder and protector of the Earth Kingdom, enacts a plan to tip the balance in favor of humans. Seven combatants enter the arena of the mysterious island of Shang Tsung: the Shaolin warrior Liu Kang, Sonya Blade, the mercenary hooligan Kano, the famous actor Johnny Cage, the ice Lin Kuei warrior, Sub-Zero, and his adversary Scorpion, and Raiden himself.

game.name: Mr. Bloopy : Saves the World
game.desc:
In 1995, Rare Compedia decided to combine puzzle-based platforming and a message of saving the environment to create a unique and challenging children's game for the Super Nintendo. Unfortunately, the game was never released during the life of the Snes, but in 2008 the game was leaked online and proved to be a fascinating and colorful sprite pack, which would have sold due to its simplicity, message and target audience.
The game was made for children; However, the game has a steep learning curve and the difficulty increases markedly after the first few initial levels. That's not to say that this is a difficult game, but given the original target audience, it's clear that the target audience is younger, more casual gamers. The game is a pick-up-and-play game and the main menu reflects this with a password system.

game.name: Mr. Do!
game.desc: You control Mr. Do as he tries to harvest all the cherries on the screen. However, there are many bad ones to get it! Mr. Do can defend himself against the badguys in two ways: first he can push the apples located along the playing field on top of the enemies and crush them. Secondly, Mr. Do is armed with a power ball. This can be thrown to destroy an enemy. However, Mr. Do only has one power ball, so he will have to wait for it to return to him before it can be used again. From time to time an alpha monster will appear on the screen with one of the letters in EXTRA. If you use the power ball to destroy an alpha monster, you will gain that card; When you have earned the full EXTRA word you receive an additional life. When you successfully collect all the cherries, you will move on to the next, more difficult level.

game.name: Mr. Nutz
game.desc:
You are the cool squirrel of the title, and you must defeat the evil Yeti before he freezes the entire world. Your quest will make you explore many areas such as a forest, a witch house, a volcano, clouds, a circus...
Mr. Nutz is a platform game, in which Nutz must jump on enemies to kill them. Its tail can also be controlled. You move through levels using ledges, ladders, bridges and platforms. There are some simple puzzles that involve manipulation of the object.

game.name: Ms. Pac-Man
game.desc:
In 1982, a sequel to the incredibly popular Pac-Man was introduced in the form of his girlfriend, Mrs. Pac-Man. This sequel continued the "eat the dots/avoid the ghosts" gameplay of the original game, but added new features to keep the title fresh.
Like her boyfriend, Ms. Pac-Man attempts to clear four different and challenging mazes filled with constantly moving dots and fruits, while avoiding Inky, Blinky, Pinky and Sue, each with their own personalities and tactics. A touch from any of these ghosts means a loss of life for Ms. Pac-Man.
Ms. Pac-Man can turn the reins on her pursuers by eating one of the four energizers located inside the maze. During this time, the ghosts turn blue, and Ms. Pac-Man can eat them for bonus points.

game.name: Musya : The Classic Japanese Tale of Horror
game.desc:
Shizuka holds a talisman that has locked the Evil One in the Abyss. Recently, an evil guard took Shizuka away from her village along with her talisman. Now it's up to the idiot, Imoto, to save her and seal the Evil One.
In the game, Imoto goes through various stages defeating enemies and stage bosses with his spear. Imoto can push and swing his spear to attack enemies. You can also use 5 different magic spells, such as Thunder and Flame, which kill all enemies on the screen. Imoto can contain up to four scrolls of each of the five spells. Used spells can be replenished by finding items in each stage.

game.name: Natsume Championship Wrestling
game.desc:
Over 50 different moves: Cobra Twist, Pyle Driver, Backdrop, Brain Buster, DDT, Kitchen Sink, Rally Art, Avalance Hold, Gillotine Drop, Shoulder Through, Sleeper Hold, Kneedrop, Reverse Shrimp Hold, Powerbomb and much more...
5 Game Selections: Championship Tournament, Round Robin, Tag Championship Match, Exhibition Match, Round Robin Tag Match

game.name: NBA All-Star Challenge
game.desc: NBA All-Star Challenge offers individual basketball with NBA players from the 1991-1992 season. Five different game modes are available: a single one-on-one match, a free throw competition, a 3-point shootout, a H.O.R.S.E. And a one-on-one tournament. You can choose from 27 players (one from each NBA team), including Michael Jordan, Larry Bird, Patrick Ewing, Karl Malone and David Robinson. Each mode can also be played by two players.

game.name: NBA Give 'n Go
game.desc: NBA Give 'n Go is a port of the arcade version of the basketball game. The game is different from the usual basketball games of the time because it is played in a vertical view. Most basketball games previously had a side-scrolling or isometric view. Based on this technique, the game features large player sprites and graphics. The game features the 1995 NBA roster complete with player rankings. The gameplay consists of true 5-on-5 basketball, but in a more arcade style with alley-oops and flying dunks. The audio includes action-oriented commentary, NBA Jam style.

game.name: NBA Hang Time
game.desc: NBA Hang Time is a 2 on 2 arcade basketball action game following in the footsteps of NBA Jam. All NBA teams, each with 4 players to choose from, are included along with fast-paced, over-the-top basketball, disregarding the normal rules of the game, but including fouls and out of bounds. You can also create your own player, with a collection of body parts and clothing to choose from.

game.name: NBA Jam Tournament Edition
game.desc: NBA JAM Tournament Edition brings you more exciting slam dunking excitement than ever before! More than double the NBA Superstars, more than double the secret characters, Hot Spots, Super Jam Power-Ups, battery backup and - OH MY - nine brand new slam dunks and all the original jams! NBA JAM Tournament Edition...is on FIRE!

game.name: NBA Jam
game.desc: NBA Jam, which featured 2-on-2 basketball, was one of the first real playable basketball games, and was also one of the first sports games to feature licensed NBA teams and players, and their true digitalized images. A key feature of NBA Jam was the exaggerated nature of the game: players jumped above their own height many times, making dunks that defied human capabilities and the laws of physics. There were no fouls, free throws or violations except goal and 24 second violations. This meant that the player was able to push or push away his opponent with no obstacles out of the way. Additionally, the game had an "on fire" feature, where if a player made three baskets in a row, they would go "on fire" and have unlimited turbo, no aim, and increased shooting ability, until the other team scored (or the player had scored four consecutive baskets while being "on fire").

game.name: NBA Live 95
game.desc:
NBA Live 95, the first of the NBA Live titles on the PC, includes all basketball players from the '94 - '95 season, as well as the East and West All-Star teams.
Manage over 300 players with the General Manager feature, new in this edition. Statistics for each player and team are saved. View players and teams side by side to compare statistics and other information. You can trade any player in the league.
Multiple in-game settings allow you to choose the game mode, style, and even the length of a room or session. Motion videos bring your works to life on the screen. Hear the roar of the crowd, the noises of the court and rim, and the voices of the players. There is also a modern music soundtrack.

game.name: NBA Live 96
game.desc: As with all live NBA series games you will play draft, sign and edit. Play a full season, or just show the playoffs. 96 includes 29 teams, including expansion teams Toronto and Vancouver.

game.name: NBA Live 97
game.desc: NBA Live 97 is a basketball game with an emphasis on realism. You can choose from all the NBA teams, create a team with players you create yourself, or choose a team made up of players from the Eastern Stars or the West Coast. When you create a player yourself you can customize the player to a high degree. There are over 60 offensive and 10 defensive setups. Comparison options include an exhibition game, the entire season or playoffs.

game.name: NBA Live 98
game.desc: NBA Live 98 offers the player all the teams, players and stadiums from the 1998 NBA season. More than 350 scanned faces were obtained to improve realism. Also some new moves like crossfade and gold prizes are implemented. You can play individual games, entire seasons, playoffs or new things like the 3-point gold keeper shootout race in the style of one of the game's stars.

game.name: NBA Showdown
game.desc:
The latest installment in Electronic Arts' basketball series based on the old NBA playoffs engine before the NBA Live series took over.
For the first time, the game features all 27 NBA teams since the 1993-94 season. Now it can play a full season with 82 games, plus playoffs and exhibition games.
Returning to the old versions are instant replays of signature moves (some of them new) and a T-meter free throw. The speed of the game has been accelerated.

game.name: NCAA Basketball
game.desc:
NCCAA Basketball has a unique perspective on its shoulder that puts you in the game like never before!
Pick your team from five of the top NCAA basketball conferences and lead them through the sold-out tournament to a Final Four berth and a national championship! Or challenge a friend to a head-to-head exhibition game. NCAA Basketball offers much more than a super-realistic view of the action. Call the game, sub in your best players and take your best shot! Hear the crowd go crazy with every shot you fire. All the ecstasy of victory and the agony of unique defeat of college hoops is here at NCAA Basketball.

game.name: NCAA Final Four Basketball
game.desc:
NCAA Final Four Basketball is a standard basketball simulator with a full NCAA license featuring 64 of the top Division 1-A teams, including North Carolina, Florida State, Boston College, and Maryland, to name a few.
There are three game modes to choose from: two practice modes, one that shows the player the basic inputs and outputs of the game and another for free kick, Exhibition and Tournament. Along with these modes are the ability to change the options for playing a game to the player's liking, including changing the length of the game. A backup battery allows the player to save their games, statistics and lists.

game.name: NCAA Football
game.desc: NCAA Football allows you to play as one of sixteen college football teams in an exhibition game or in a tournament. The tournament pits you against all the teams who must win in order to proceed; The game will automatically save after each game won so you can pick up the tournament where you left off. Team rosters are just that you can choose players from different decades from the 60s to the 90s, and you can mix players from different decades if you want.

game.name: Network Q Rally
game.desc: This rally game was canceled in the middle of development and never went out. The rom available on the net is, however, perfectly playable and seems to offer an almost complete game, even if we feel that it is missing many things that are normally found in this type of software (car settings, choice between automatic and manual gearbox... etc...). In the state, the game still allows us to play a championship on 4 different courts.

game.name: Newman Haas IndyCar featuring Nigel Mansell
game.desc:
It is Newman Haas Indy Car, as its name suggests, a racing game approved by the CART racing team of the name Sami and its main driver at the time, the Englishman Nigel Mansell.
The player has the option of driving a single race (where is the practice option hidden) or going for the crown against 12 other drivers on 15 tracks (with some variety, not just ovals) across North America, with the season opening in Queensland, Australia. It is possible to play solo, with a friend in split screen or split screen with against the computer, and whether music or engine sounds are played in the race. A key possibility in the game is to select the Arcade and Simulation mode Between - in the afternoon, the car can take much less damage before giving up, tuning must be carried out by the driver and to execute the rules, under the risk of a disqualification.

game.name: NFL Football
game.desc:
A football game that features both an exhibition mode and a postseason mode. The game features all the royal names and logos of the era.
Exposure mode allows the player to select a team and play with another player or the computer. The player can also select a demo mode where two computer-controlled teams will face each other. Playoff mode features 12 teams competing for a chance to win the Super Bowl.
During play, the field is primarily viewed from a horizontal perspective. Players select their plays (pass, run or kick) and try to beat their opponents before time runs out. After each quarter, the game updates the player to the current game statistics.

game.name: NFL Quarterback Club 96
game.desc:
This game is the update of the next generation of NFL Club.
Every team from the 1996 NFL season is shown here, with actual player numbers and statistics. 32 offensive and 16 defensive plays are available as you play. Options include setting quarter lengths, from one to 15 minutes, and selecting your play style: Preseason Playoffs, full season gold, which is played in 18 games critical toward the Super Bowl goal.

game.name: NFL Quarterback Club
game.desc:
One of the first in the series featuring all 28 NFL teams, including their respective nicknames and logos, and many of the top players of the day, including John Elway, Joe Montana, Brett Farve, and Troy Aikman, to name a few.
There are a variety of game modes to choose from including NFL Play which includes preseason, season and playoff modes along with Simulation Mode which allows players to relive past moments from NFL history and allows the player to recreate these moments or change history all together.
Also included is the Quarterback Challenge, which would become a staple of the series. In the QB Challenge, the player chooses from one of nineteen NFL quarterbacks to compete in a series of challenges that will test their accuracy, speed, power and knowledge. Players can also create their own custom quarterback and throw them into the competition.

game.name: NHL '94
game.desc: In addition to the licenses, the gameplay of this edition sees for the first time the inclusion of the devastating single-shot hit, but to keep forwards (literally) in check, defenders also feature tougher body controls, with new animations. For an added challenge, players can also choose to control the goalkeeper manually. A popular feature in previous editions, fighting is completely removed from the game. Game modes include exhibition games (or "regular season" in the game), playoffs (best of one or best of seven), and a new shoot-out mode. The main options remain basically the same since the series was established: period length (5, 10 or 20 minutes), line changes (off, manual or the new automatic mode) and penalties. (off, on, on but not offsides).

game.name: NHL 95
game.desc: NHL '95 was the third ice hockey game licensed by EA Sports, promising the series' fastest action to date. The action is viewed top-down and can be played with or without realistic penalties. There is a full season mode, which allows you to guide a team through all 84 matches, with the option of injuries potentially ruling players out of a sequence of matches. You have full control over trading and creating players for your squad. New moves in the game include simulated shooting and lying down blocks.

game.name: NHL 96
game.desc: NHL 96 was the first EA Sports game to feature Virtual Stadium technology, which resulted in a three-dimensional feel and multiple camera angles. The NHL license ensures that real teams and players from the era are included, with a complete league and playoff system. Many game options can be toggled: the infamous scramble is an option, as are penalties and offsides. The control system makes it possible to execute one-touch passes and various special trick moves to quickly advance the ball. As a bonus feature, it included 'Hockey Card' profiles of each player on CD and interviews with the stars of the game.

game.name: NHL 97
game.desc:
1997 edition of EA's NHL sports simulation series. The improvements in this edition come mainly in the graphical field, with a refined version of the "virtual stadium" system that adds new camera angles (including the classic top-down one strangely absent from NHL 96) and polygonal players in place of the bitmap. based on motion captured animations.
Other extras include multiplayer support for up to 8 players via the network or Gravis' GrIP system, the option to create new players and switch them, and the usual amount of EA Sports-licensed multimedia flair, including an interesting "Goalkeeper Mask Viewer" that lets you see the elaborately decorated helmets of 30 goalkeepers.

game.name: NHL 98
game.desc: NHL 98 features much faster and more refined gameplay (it now uses four action keys instead of two, eliminating the need to double-tap to perform some actions), along with other new features such as "on the fly" tactics developed by Marc Crawford, then manager of the Colorado Avalanche, and new commentary lines from Jim Hughson and Darryl Reaugh and a redesigned interface. The graphics have been improved compared to the previous version, since the players are less angular and thanks to 3Dfx support, with fewer pixels in the textures. The in-game presentation follows a TV-style script, zooming in on players while stats are displayed during clock interruptions.

game.name: NHL Stanley Cup
game.desc: Hockey video game for Snes in 3 dimensions. Play with up to 26 NHL teams each with different strengths and weaknesses. Choose your favorite team, the tactic that best suits you and lead them throughout the regular season in the Stanley Cup until victory. You can play exhibition mode, season mode or best of seven series. You have endless actions at your disposal, shoot, pass the puck or return the puck, perform hip, shoulder and push controls. And you can even fake a shot and aim the puck at a particular corner of the net!

game.name: NHLPA Hockey 93
game.desc:
The second part of the Electronic Arts hockey series. It is NHLPA licensed (so it has real player names), but not NHL licensed (so it doesn't have NHL team names).
The gameplay is altered only slightly from the predecessor. Regular Season and Playoff modes are available. Goalkeepers have improved AI, there are more foul play options, and the game now features detailed statistics.

game.name: Nickelodeon GUTS
game.desc:
Nickelodeon GUTS is based on the late '90s Nickelodeon TV show that's basically American Gladiators for the kids. The events in the game are based off of the actual events of the game show with the main objective being to score as many points as possible while trying to beat the clock.
In the elastic sport, the player is strapped to a long pull cord and thrown around. There are three events: Slam Dunk is a basketball game, Attack is lacrosse, and Spiral where the goal is to throw a soccer ball through a hanging tire.

game.name: Nigel Mansell's World Championship Racing
game.desc:
Timing smiled in Gremlin with this licensed Formula 1 simulation, as Nigel's long quest for a championship had finally been good. The game launched somewhere between a full simulation like F1 GP and action games like Continental Circus. In each race, only 12 cars could last between 3 and 20 laps.
Before each race you can customize wing downforce, gear ratio, tire selection and fuel loading options?? Pitstops are a standard feature of longer races. The 16-bit versions include an 'Improve With Mansell' mode, in which a digitized version of Nigel's head appears in the top corner of the screen, offering instructions and praise.

game.name: Nightmare Busters
game.desc: Synchronized with the wavelength of dreams, the miserable tyrant has discovered a way to enter them and convolve what children see, hear and feel while they sleep, all for the benefit of his twisted amusement. Enter Flynn and his twin brother Floyd, two virtuous elves who refuse to sit idly while the tyrant weaves his gruesome illusions. Get going, gentlemen! There is no time to waste!

game.name: Ninja Gaiden Trilogy
game.desc:
Here it is! The complete NINJA GAIDEN TRILOGY you requested. Enjoy all 3 classic Nintendo Ninja Gaiden games in a Super NES Game Pak. Follow the adventures of Ryu as he fights against the ancient forces of darkness with his Ninjutsu powers. Use strategy, cunning and deception to acquire the special ninja weapons necessary to succeed in this epic adventure.
The Ninja Gaiden series tells its story through Tecmo's unique cinema screen animation. This one is not to be missed!

game.name: Ninjawarriors
game.desc:
The land is under the grip of a tyrant named Benglar, who is capable of brainwashing those he captures. Using this ability he has taken on military forces and now seems unstoppable. However, the resistance forces led by Mulk have been developing a new weapon: the cybernetic Special Forces with the ability to think, dubbed the Ninja Warriors. Untested, these machines are ordered to assassinate Benglar...
Ninja Warriors plays as a side-scrolling beat 'em up, and is a single-player adaptation of the Ninja Warriors arcade game. Players can choose between 3 different Ninja Warriors: Ninja, Kunoichi or Kamaitachi. Characters play differently, but share some common controls. Each can attack, jump, grab the enemy, block attacks or unleash a special attack across the entire screen. This special attack charges gradually and can be reset by being knocked to the ground.

game.name: No Escape
game.desc: Based on the Hollywood action thriller, NO ESCAPE puts you in the shoes of Robbins, an inmate at the Absolom Island penal colony. Free to travel anywhere on the island, except outside! - You will come face to face with ultra-realistic rotoscoped characters from real actors and face countless deadly traps. You will be forced to fight or outwit bands of savage outsiders. Only the Insider's camp provides you with a place to rest, exchange information, and exchange items necessary for your escape. A detailed Guardian Overview Map allows players to choose which part of the island they explore next. If you collect the right pieces as you go, you'll eventually be faced with the final choice... to boldly free yourself in the prison helicopter or stealthily escape in a specially designed stealth boat. Unlike the movie, the ending of this story is up to you.

game.name: Nobunaga's Ambition
game.desc:
In the 16th century, Japan's Sengoku period divided the nation into many feudal states, each ruled by a daimyo. Many dreamed of conquering the country, becoming Shogun and ruling the entire country. One of these daimyos was the ambitious Nobunaga Oda, a ruthless ruler and renowned strategist. Players take on the role of Nobunaga Oda or one of the many other daimyos as they attempt to conquer Japan.
Nobunaga's Ambition is a turn-based strategy game that can be played in several different modes. Players begin by selecting a 17-region scenario or a larger 50-region scenario. Next, the player must choose a daimyo, whose attributes are rated in several categories: age, health, ambition, luck, charm, and IQ. As the game progresses, these values ​​change based on the events of the game.

game.name: Nolan Ryan's Baseball
game.desc: Nolan Ryan's Baseball is a baseball video game based on retired baseball player Nolan Ryan. The game is not licensed by Major League Baseball and the Major League Baseball Players Association; Which means Nolan Ryan is the only non-fictional baseball player in the entire game. All of the other players' opinions have names that appear to be given first names, while Nolan Ryan uses his last name. This game was reviewed in the January 1992 (32nd) issue of Nintendo Power.

game.name: Nosferatu
game.desc: It's a time race. Kyle must save his fair maid Erin before Nosferatu's evil slashes can influence her destiny forever! Dungeons and cemeteries are just a few obstacles in your path, riddled with traps and beasts of an indescribable nature. Join Kyle's journey into darkness to return his love before his soul is lost for eternity!

game.name: Obitus
game.desc:
Wil Mason has been transported to the fantasy world of Middlemere, which is ruled by four rival brothers. How to get to where you are?
The game is a combination of arcade and first-person view elements. One of the most notable features is in first person mode, instead of only having 4 face to face and as you move between them there are 8 directions and the view pans smoothly as you turn. This smooth scrolling continues as you progress, giving the game a more three-dimensional feel.
The arcade elements consist of horizontally scrolling areas where you fight with your bow while avoiding their attacks. 4 directional movement

game.path: ./Ogre Battle - The March of the Black Queen (USA).zip
game.name: Ogre Battle : The March of the Black Queen
game.desc: Lead the rebellion and lead your army to take back your land from the evil Zenobian Empire in this real-time strategy game. Liberate cities and collect items and tarot cards to increase your strength, as well as recruit allies to join you on your crusade. But when you finally win the day, will you be a benevolent leader, or will you become an evil despot yourself? You must decide.
game.image: ./media/images/Ogre Battle - The March of the Black Queen (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Ogre Battle - The March of the Black Queen (USA).png

game.name: Olympic Summer Games
game.desc: Olympic Summer Games is the official 16-bit video game of the 1996 Olympic Games held in Atlanta, the third and final official IOC title to be released on the console. A typical button masher includes 10 events (100m sprint, 110m hurdles, pole vault, long jump, or just triple jump, javelin, high jump, discus, skeet and archery) and 32 countries around the world compete in custom or full Olympics. practice. Two players can compete head-to-head in the sprint events, and a total of eight can play in the same game. Three difficulty levels allow for competitive events for both newcomers and veterans of the genre.

game.name: On the Ball
game.desc: There's a kind of knick-knack you might find in dusty arcades, a maze through which you navigate a marble by subtly tilting the board, dancing with gravity and momentum, deftly rolling your sphere off dead ends and around obstacles posed by holes in the board. Marble Madness explores this theme in a three-dimensional perspective, Cloud Kingdoms in a 2-D plane - both by the direct influence of the ball's actions. The game takes a different approach towards a similar end; Instead of moving the ball around the board, you move the board around the ball.

game.name: Operation Europe : Path to Victory 1939-45
game.desc: Operation Europe: Path to Victory 1939-45 is a strategy game set during World War II. Choose one of the six proposed scenarios, which correspond to six major battles of this terrible war, to relive the events or change them. It is possible to embody the choice of allies or the axis. Note that the title also offers a spectator mode where you can watch the battles without touching the controller.

game.name: Operation Logic Bomb : The Ultimate Search & Destroy
game.desc: An action game where you have to shoot everything that moves (and even what doesn't move). Experience in a top-secret laboratory, the Subspace Particle Transfer Project Facility, goes wrong. An army of monsters and robots from a virtual reality take over the laboratory. Hiro (Logan), a bionic soldier's mission is to save the science laboratory and find the origin of the incident.

game.name: Operation Starfi5h
game.desc: Unlike the first game in the series, which was a mission-based game, and the second, where the only character has skills such as observing the entire level and growing to unlimited height, "James Pond 3" is your typical platform game. Pond can run very quickly (by holding the A button) through levels, which often contain steep mountain slopes and difficult areas. Once again, he has to oppose the evil scientist Maybe and his subordinates.

game.name: Operation Thunderbolt
game.desc: Operation Thunderbolt is the sequel to the exciting Operation Wolf. A plane is hijacked by terrorists en route from Paris to Boston, who threaten to kill all the hostages on board if their companions are not released from prison. Instead of reaching ICT's destination, the plane makes a landing in Kalubya, Africa, and all the hostages are hidden in various locations. The authorities have asked the hero of Operation Wolf to rescue the hostages, only this time, the hero brings his friend along for the ride.

game.name: Oscar
game.desc:
His name is Oscar. You have to run and jump through 7 levels in Hollywood style (Science Fiction, Western, Horror, Cartoons, Dino, the Detective and the Game Show) to find Oscar (yes, the Academy Award??!).
If you have enough Oscar to solve the level. You can choose the levels in any order you want. In the levels you must jump on the platforms to discover the level.
You kill enemies by jumping on them. Some of them release a power such as being invulnerable or super jumping.

game.name: Out of This World
game.desc:
From Lester Knight Chaykin's diary:
I take advantage of this short break to write down some useful information, in the notebook that has survived my last adventures. I have separated from my companion; Without their help, he would still be trapped. I hope to find it. I owe him my life. Now I find myself lost in a maze of underground corridors. I don't know how long I've been wandering. And I constantly encounter currents that threaten to flood these corridors at any moment. Fortunately I have found a weapon that can punch a hole in almost anything it finds. It has saved my life countless times. There are many guards in these corridors. I have to move before...

game.name: Out to Lunch
game.desc: Enter an extravagant world where elements of international cuisine form a recipe for disaster! The ingredients you need to make delicious dishes are out of control, you have to chase and catch them before they make mincemeat of you! Each of the multiple levels takes place in an exotic location, where you will find a special ingredient, necessary to complete each dish.

game.name: Outlander
game.desc: The gameplay is a split of two genres: Racing and Side Scrolling. In the racing parts you have to destroy enemies like motorcycle gang members, gyro-helicopter captains, red trucks, etc. Your car: It has a machine gun mounted in the front, and if some guy drives next to you, a small window pops up, allowing you to shoot them with your shotgun.

game.name: P.T.O. : Pacific Theater of Operations
game.desc: P.T.O. : Pacific Theater of Operations is a turn-based strategy game. The title offers to recreate some of the greatest battles of World War II, through nine different scenarios. Once you have chosen a scenario, you must manage your various bases, as well as send your units to destroy enemy forces. It also has a two-player mode, as well as a CPU vs CPU mode, which will allow you to learn the different strategies to follow in place to resist in any scenario.

game.name: P.T.O. II : Pacific Theater of Operations
game.desc: P.T.O. II: Pacific Theater of Operations is a turn-based strategy game. The second episode of the series builds on the strengths of the first, adding three new major scenarios and seven shorter ones.
