All battles take place, once again, during the conflict of World War II and, more specifically, in the Pacific Ocean. As in the previous episode, you will have to manage your entire army and annihilate the enemy forces. Note that, once again, you can play with a second player.

game.name: Pac-Attack
game.desc:
Pac-Man debuted in the world of puzzles starring in Pac-Attack, an original and fast-paced game for Super Nintendo where you must keep Pac-Man well fed as you clear the screen of blocks and ghosts in this Tetris-style game.
From time to time, Pac-Man appears and moves across the screen horizontally and vertically, so you have to line up the ghosts so that he can eat them to his heart's content. When it reaches a wall, it stops eating, so you have to plan how to eliminate all the ghosts quickly and efficiently.
The three modes included in the game allow you to face the console, compete against another player or test your skill in puzzle mode.

game.name: Pac-In-Time
game.desc: Pac-in-Time is a platform game that represents the characters from the Pac-Man universe on Super Nintendo. The ghost warlock returns Pac-Man to his childhood. Pac-Boy will have to go through different levels to return to normal times. By jumping through rings of four different colors, he gains special abilities: green allows him to jump higher, yellow allows him to shoot fireballs, red gives him a hammer, and blue allows him to swim underwater.

game.name: Packy & Marlon
game.desc:
Packy & Marlon are two friends who share a problem: they both suffer from diabetes. They know about their illness, and they know how to take care of themselves; So, they have decided to go camping. But when they arrived, an unpleasant surprise awaited them: the mice had invaded everything! Not only food, but also diabetic supplies were in danger, scattered everywhere.
Immediately, the elephants volunteer to fetch the supplies and stop the damn mice. But while you're at it, don't forget to check your blood glucose levels, take insulin, and eat the right food. Good luck, Packy and Marlon!

game.name: Pac-Man 2 : The New Adventures
game.desc: Join Pac-Man in a side-scrolling adventure where you must guide him through Pac-Land, solving puzzles and finding items to defeat the evil ghost witch of Nentor. You don't control Pac-Man, as you must show him where to go and what to look for, while using the slingshot to hit and find objects or open doors and defeat bad guys before Pac-Man runs into them. You can collect the items you find along the paths of Pac-Man's house in the inventory and use them for another day.

game.name: Paladin's Quest
game.desc:
This is the story of Lennus, a utopian world where science and magic exist in a fantastic world. A threat has arisen in the lands of Saskuot with a new leader by the name of Zaygos who has conquered some of the powerful tribes, now aiming to take the lands of Naskuot to the north.
We play a young boy named Chezni, a student at the magic school near Ratsurk, apparently the birthplace of the wisdom taught to the inhabitants of Lennus by three legendary beings named Gabni, Kormu and Sophie. Our young Chezni will mistakenly activate a machine, a terrible calamity that will be the advent of the end of the world if we do not stop it, and thus our great adventure will begin.

game.name: Paperboy 2
game.desc: Paperboy 2 is a video game released in 1991. It is the sequel to the video game Paperboy, which consisted of delivering newspapers from your bicycle while avoiding obstacles on the road, such as dogs, cars, and basically everything you can imagine. Be careful, some people shoot cannonballs at you! And you better be sure to only throw papers in the right houses!

game.name: Parodius
game.desc:
Parodius: It was the first game in the Parodius series created by Konami for the MSX in Japan. It is a parody of the game Gradius and its name is a combination of "Parody" and "Gradius". Some of its characters come from Antarctic Adventure and Twinbee. They have clear Japanese influence.
The game is a parody of classic spaceship games. The player goes through various scenarios, each with its own setting, and has to defeat the final boss of each of these scenarios. But unlike in conventional ship games, the enemies are not other ships, but rather "picturesque" characters, such as penguins, bees, moais, among others. To help him in his mission, the character will be able to collect certain items from several of the eliminated enemies, which will provide him with speed increases, missiles, a shield, etc., as well as bells that change color as they are shot and increase the score or give special powers when collected.

game.name: PGA European Tour
game.desc: European Tour is best considered a remake of the original game, rather than a sequel as such. It features 5 courses from across Europe and 60 top European professionals, rather than the original US lineup. The graphics are much more detailed and colorful, as you would expect considering the intervening years of advancements in programming skill. The control system is the standard three-click method used in most golf games, but now you can define the intended draw/fade levels before playing the shot, so that a perfect aim leads to measured spin and an imperfect one exaggerates the spin. In addition to the Stroke Play games of the original (where you count your total score over the entire 18-hole round, and compare it to your opponent), there are also Match Play (where the goal is to win as many individual holes as possible) and Skins modes (same, but with money).

game.name: PGA Tour 96
game.desc:
This game allows up to 4 players to compete in professional golf tournaments. With 8 tracks and 7 game modes, you will have a considerable amount of options and possibilities at your disposal.
Just the fact of having 10 professional players programmed suggests that this game is technically more complete than it might seem at first glance. The graphics are of very good quality, especially regarding the playing field; The sound effects are very realistic, and leave no doubt about the destination of the ball. With simple controls and quick response, a very good golf game.

game.name: PGA Tour Golf
game.desc:
PGA Tour Golf: golf game that introduced the most used controls in this type of game. The more than proven and useful triple click system: one to start the swing, another to establish the force and a final one for precision.
Some of the holes are diabolical, with bunkers, the dangers of water and trees, and the need to plan strategies to get the best approach to get to the green.
When a tournament is played there are 60 opponents, each representing the best golfers in the United States - ten of them appear with tactical tips for each hole.

game.name: Phalanx
game.desc: A futuristic shooter, Phalanx is the name of the prototype starfighter piloted by Wink Baufield, a genetically enhanced pilot. It is sent to protect and recover Delia IV, a planet in the Andromeda galaxy, which has been colonized by humans for interstellar research purposes. However, an unknown and powerful foreign force has reached the planet, the military defenses have been completely overwhelmed, and all hope rests on Phalanx. Like most shooters, you can upgrade your weapons by collecting bonus items when you destroy enemy ships.

game.name: Phantom 2040
game.desc:
The animated mini-series: Phantom 2040, is here. It is the year 2040 and the city of Metropia is in total chaos.
Crime, smuggling and terrorism are increasing. The company Maximum Inc. has invented biotechnology that threatens to destroy nature - causing the extinction of animals and the adulteration of ecosystems. The company's evil owner, Rebicca Madison, wants to rule Metropia and the world.
Enter, Kit Walker, the 24th Phantom, following in the proud but secret footsteps of his ancestors. This 18-year-old boy will have to fight to try to do things right, or die trying.
The game has many twists and turns in its plot, and a multitude of endings.

game.name: Pieces
game.desc:
Pieces (known in Japan as Jigsaw Party) is a 1994 puzzle game for the Super Nintendo published by Atlus. In the game, the player has to solve puzzles.
The player can face off against the CPU or up to five human players. CPU players come in three levels (easy, normal, or hard) and offer a wide range of opponents, such as a crab and a beautiful mermaid. Some puzzles must be solved before the opponent solves their puzzles. If the player is fast enough, rewards will appear as Items. These can do anything from guiding puzzle pieces to freezing the opponent.

game.name: Pilotwings
game.desc:
We welcome you to the Pilotwings aeroclub! Get ready to see your career take off! This Super Nintendo classic adds an original touch to flight simulation.
Take control of several aircraft and rise through the ranks. Glide through floating rings in a biplane; Land with precision on a distant target with a parachute or get carried away by thermal currents with a hang glider. You can even try out a jetpack prototype!
The brightest students will participate in a dangerous rescue mission aboard a helicopter. At Pilotwings, the sky is the limit!

game.name: Pinball Dreams
game.desc: The first in a line of pinball games from 21st Century and Digital Illusions, with four tables covering themes such as the wild west for Steel Wheel, space rockets for Ignition, a haunted graveyard for Nightmare and pop music for Beat Box.

game.name: Pinball Fantasies
game.desc: After the success of Pinball Dreams on various systems, a sequel was created with four new tables. The gameplay is largely the same as the first game, with realistic physics, multiplayer options, and a high score table to aim for. The tables are Partyland, Speed ​​Devils, Billion Dollar Gameshow and Stones 'n' Bones, participating in a funfair, race cars, a sticky game-show, and a graveyard. Each has a range of ramps, combos, light sequences and targets to shoot, as well as general themes that are less influenced by real tables than those of Pinball Dreams.

game.name: Pink Goes to Hollywood
game.desc: The Pink Panther is on his way to Hollywood to audition for a major role. Pursued by his nemesis, Inspector Clouseau, he flees into the MGM studios. From the main entrance, you can enter different movie sets with different areas such as cemeteries, mansions or the jungle. Using a side-scrolling view, Pink Panther can jump, crouch, run, climb, and use a boxing glove to take out enemies. Additionally, there are special tricks and props such as magic carpets, umbrellas and ladders to reach higher areas. Items such as traffic lights, hammers, bowling balls, shields and supergloves give you an advantage in battles.

game.name: Pinocchio
game.desc: Pinocchio, based on his Disney animated film - which in turn was based on a children's novel. Have Pinocchio run, jump and spin through all the familiar locations, including the inside of a whale, and do enough good deeds to become the real human boy he always wanted to be. A standard Disney platformer.

game.name: Pitfall : The Mayan Adventure
game.desc: Pitfall: The Mayan Adventure is a side action game where you play as the adventurer Pitfall Harry Jr in search of his father Pitfall Harry. You battle your way through Mayan jungles, waterfalls, deserted mines. There are 13 levels and the action is fast and exciting. You will have to be attentive and fast. Or prepare to die.

game.name: Pit-Fighter
game.desc: Pit-Fighter is a third-person fighting game that features digitized graphics of real fighters and zoom effects. Players select one of three combatants (Buzz, Ty or Kato) to take on anyone who dares. At the end of each fight, players individually receive a KO bonus, a brutality bonus, and a fight bag. Every third match is a Grudge Match where players test each other's skills. The last man standing is the winner of this three-knockdown match. The players continue their path until they reach the Elimination Match that decides who will have the opportunity to defeat the champion, The Masked Warrior.

game.name: Plok
game.desc: One day, Plok wakes up to discover that his flag has been stolen. He sees her on a neighboring island and travels there to retrieve her. However, when he returns home, he realizes that all the flags on his island have been replaced with flea flags. This is just the beginning of his problems, he has to face many more challenges before the end of the game. Plok has to jump and fight through numerous levels, trying to find the exit or accomplish certain missions such as killing a certain number of fleas. Plok can perform two different jumps, a normal jump and a higher rotation jump. He can attack his enemies by throwing his limbs at them. Collecting gifts will temporarily equip you with different weapons, or transform you into all kinds of vehicles like a helicopter or a U.F.O.

game.name: Pocky & Rocky 2
game.desc: The sequel to Pocky & Rocky brings the SNES cooperative shooter back into action with improved gameplay mechanics. Princess Luna has been kidnapped by a gang of evil demons and Shinto priestess Pocky and her raccoon friend Rocky have to rescue her. Like the previous game, the game involves taking control of any of the characters to clear the stage of enemies in classic top-down shooter fashion, killing with their magic cards or other unique collection powers. New to the sequel is the ability to play with AI-controlled companions who add special moves to defeat certain bosses as well as unique abilities.

game.name: Pocky & Rocky
game.desc: This is a game for one or two simultaneous players. It has a wonderful "Super Deformed" graphic style set in ancient Japan and an above average difficulty. You play as Princess Pocky and her raccoon Rocky. Race through each level defeating enemies and you'll face a bizarre boss at the end. Defeat him and you will go to the next level. You fight and shoot your way through numerous levels based around temples and shrines. Pocky shoots cards and Rocky shoots long-range blades. For short range Pocky uses a staff and Rocky uses his tail. Pocky also has a spin attack and Rocky can turn into an invulnerable statue.

game.name: Pop'n TwinBee : Rainbow Bell Adventures
game.desc:
You play as Twinbee, Gwinbee or Winbee. Cooperative play is also available. In this mode, the second player takes control over one of the two remaining characters. Either way, your task is to find and defeat the evil Dr. Warmon who is trying to enslave the islands of Dunburi.
To deal with the many villains that Dr. Warmon throws at you, you need to collect colorful bells. Depending on the color of the bell you can use different attacks such as a laser (blue bells) or a whip (orange bells). But even without the bells you are not defenseless. His standard attacks include a shockwave and the ability to fly.

game.name: Pop'n TwinBee
game.desc:
Pop'n Twinbee is a new episode of the Twinbee saga that first appeared in 1986 under the name Stinger.
Like the other games in the Pop'n series Twinbee is a vertically scrolling arcade shooter, where you and a friend get behind the controls of the cutest Twinbee and Winbee ever created. Pop'n features a number of additions to the gameplay, including an energy bar, eight difficulty levels, and a handicap feature when playing with a friend (which causes most enemies to lock on to one fighter instead of the other).

game.path: ./Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (Europe).zip
game.name: Populous II : Trials of the Olympian Gods
game.desc: Populous II continues the "god game" genre pioneered by Bullfrog's classic Populous. In PII, you are an untested immortal who must fight your way through an entire pantheon of Greek gods, each with their own strategy and attacks, and eventually enter into a showdown with Zeus himself. The gameplay is similar to Populous, but PII offers a wide range of spells, digitized sound, and high-resolution graphics to give that extra touch to spell effects.
game.image: ./media/images/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (Europe).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (Europe).png

game.name: Populous
game.desc:
You play at being a god, playing against other gods in a celestial game of conquest. To win, you must help your chosen people take over the world and wipe out the vermin that worship that other god.
Each god begins with a single human, thrown into the middle of the desert. Sometimes there is habitable land in sight, sometimes there is not. To achieve victory, you must change the landscape, creating flat land for your followers to build on. The more followers you have, the more powerful you will be, so take care of them. Build as fast as possible, because the other god is doing the same.

game.name: Porky Pig's Haunted Holiday
game.desc: Porky Pig's Haunted Holiday ventures to Gultch Haunted Theme Park and during his stay there, he falls asleep. Wake up in a nightmare, face all the enemies including a diabolical Daffy Duck. Venture through haunted mansions, enchanted forests and a strange world to the music of Terry Gilliam's Brazil.

game.name: Power Drive
game.desc: Power Drive is a rally game for the Super Nintendo. Unlike most car games, the view here is aerial, as if the camera is placed in a helicopter flying above the car you are driving. At first, you only have the choice between two vehicles in the lowest category, but by moving up the stages and increasing performance, you get new cars.

game.name: Power Instinct
game.desc:
The Gouketsuji family is the third most powerful in the world and that is why many want to rise as leader of the clan. To this end, every five years a martial arts tournament is held where all those who are related to the Gouketsuji can opt for the title of clan leader. Oume has held that title for 60 years and has not been defeated yet. Can someone end Oume's reign and take control of the clan?
First game in the saga with graphics of a style similar to that of World Heroes: that is, seriousness with a strange touch of humor.
There are 8 playable characters: Reiji, Keith, Annie, Angela, Saizo, Thin-Nen, White Buffalo and Otane. The final boss is Oume, leader of the Gouketsuji clan, who graphically is nothing more than Otane with a change of color of clothes and much more difficult to defeat.
Its game system is very similar to other games like Street Fighter or Fatal Fury, although double jumps are included (that is, when the character is in the air, he can propel himself and gain more height).
Here we meet for the first time the "transformable characters", in this case represented by the twins Oume and Otane, capable of turning into their respective youthful forms.

game.name: Power Moves
game.desc: You are Joe, a young American who has been secretly trained to become a powerful fighter. One day, he meets an old martial artist who tells him that he should travel around the world to meet other masters and learn from them. During his travels, Joe encounters many fighters, and will have to become more skilled in order to prove that he is the best fighter in the world. Unlike most fighting games, you can only control one character (Joe) in single player mode. In two-player mode, you can choose to fight with any of the seven available fighters, and also choose a stage. The game plays like a standard 2D fighter: you can punch, kick and jump on your opponents.

game.name: Power Piggs of the Dark Age
game.desc: The player takes on the role of Bruno, an anthropomorphic pig who is tasked with defending his land which is currently under siege by wolves. Bruno comes equipped with a sword and the ability to throw donuts found throughout the game's six levels. Bruno also has the ability to jump and break boxes.

game.name: Power Rangers Zeo : Battle Racers
game.desc:
In this racing title based on the Zeo season of the famous Power Rangers television series, players can select between the six Zeo Rangers (Pink, Yellow, Red, Blue, Green, Gold) or their enemies (King Mondo, Cog Soldier) to compete in head-to-head circuit challenges across 16 races divided by 5 tracks.
Each driver has different levels of attributes such as Acceleration, Speed ​​and Grip, providing a more balanced competition. Through various speed boosters scattered throughout the tracks, players can attack opponents by firing Blasters (à la Super Mario Kart) at their adversaries; The limit is 5 Blasters per run except for Cog Soldier's infinite Blaster count.
Along with 1-player game modes (Race, Time Trial and VS CPU), the game also offers 2-player split-screen via Race and 2P VS plus 3 alternative modes: Point Race, where players must race over objects to earn points; Bumper Chase, with the main objective of pushing the opponent out of the circuit; And Blaster Master, a Life Energy based on deathmatch energy.

game.name: PowerMonger
game.desc: Powermonger takes the design and basic concepts of Bullfrog's previous game Populous, and places it in a war context. The game casts the player as a warlord who will have to plunder his way through 195 territories towards conquering the world. Multiple leaders will have the same objective.rnrnThe game world is now made up of polygons, so the view can be rotated and moved more freely than Populous. Trade, diplomacy, inventions, and razing and invading lands play a key role in progressing through the game.

game.name: Prehistorik Man
game.desc: In Prehistorik Man, the player takes control of a Neanderthal who is on an adventure to travel through various levels, collecting food items to supply his people before autumn arrives. Along the way, the player will encounter all manner of enemies ranging from spiders, giant rats and even the mighty T-Rex. There are five levels in total and the player can upgrade their weapons, axes and mallets throughout the game, as well as acquire a hang glider, giving the player the advantage of flight and covering long distances. The main objective of the game is to defeat enemies, collect food and face a boss at the end of each level.

game.name: Primal Rage
game.desc: A meteorite hit the Earth, causing great chaos. Seven ancient gods have awakened and are now attempting to take control of a post-apocalyptic world. Primal Rage is a one-on-one fighting game with dinosaurs and giant apes as combatants. The graphics are made with digitized stop-motion animation. The gameplay is similar to Mortal Kombat playing in a side perspective, and has the possibility of ending fights with "Fatalities" (if you have played Mortal Kombat you will know what that means :)

game.path: ./Prince of Persia 2 - The Shadow & The Flame (USA).zip
game.name: Prince of Persia 2
game.desc: Prince Of Persia 2. Second part of this magnificent game. His identity has been taken over by the evil Grand Vizier Jaffar whom he defeated in the first Prince of Persia. Banished from your palace, you must fight to take back what is yours and save the sultan's lovely daughter.
game.image: ./media/images/Prince of Persia 2 - The Shadow & The Flame (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Prince of Persia 2 - The Shadow & The Flame (USA).png

game.name: Prince of Persia
game.desc: Grand Vizier Jaffar has thrown you into a dark dungeon and plans to marry the girl of your dreams within the hour. You're not going to let that happen, are you? Try to escape from the dungeon, get rid of Jaffar's guards, find your way through the sultan's palace and defeat Jaffar himself. Hurry up!!, you only have 60 minutes!!rnrnPrince of Persia is a 2D platform game where you have to run and jump. Your hero must avoid deadly traps, solve some simple puzzles and engage in sword fights with guards. The player has an infinite number of lives, but has to restart at the beginning of a level each time they die, and must complete the game within one hour. An especially notable aspect of the game is the very fluid animation of your character. The Game Boy Color and SNES versions of the game feature additional levels and new enemies.

game.name: Pro Quarterback
game.desc: Pro Quarterback is an American football game with 27 different teams. Since this game does not have an NFL or NFLPA license, there is no actual NFL team or player here, although the teams included in the game represent the cities of their real-life counterparts in the NFL and also mimics the colors of their team's uniforms. Gameplay options allow the player to choose to play on 6 different field surfaces (grass, mud, dirt, snow, rain, and artificial turf) and choose how long the game will last (2, 5, 10, or 15 minutes). There are no fouls in this game either.rnrnThe gameplay consists of playing both defense and attack. There are 26 different offensive tactics and 18 different defensive tactics to choose from.

game.name: Pro Sport Hockey
game.desc: This hockey game includes 24 NHL teams and 288 NHLPA players. The SNES version has a practice mode and a season mode. The training mode in the SNES version allows you to practice in an exhibition game or compete in a shootaround. The teams chosen to compete in the Super Cup are decided by the season's qualifying teams in the SNES version.rnrnThe game is played with a top-down view of the hockey rink, with the screen scrolling vertically as the player carrying the "puck" heads toward a net.

game.name: Push-Over
game.desc:
You are a little ant willing to help a friend in a rather uncomfortable situation. Apparently, your little dog friend loves to eat cookies that have his picture on the box, and he got so excited eating them that he lost his balance, causing a bag of cookies to fall deep into an anthill. Now, it's your turn to solve puzzles and recover the cookies for your friend.
But this anthill is a little different from the ones you've seen, and especially different from the one you inhabit. Its path is full of rocks and gates. In each different place inside the anthill you will find a small bag of cookies that you will have to take back to your doggie friend.

game.name: Putty Squad
game.desc: Putty Squad is a game programmed by System 3 and published and distributed by Ocean for the Super Nintendo in May 1995 exclusively for the European market. The game was also programmed for Amiga, PC and Mega Drive (whose version was even analyzed in some magazines of the time), but all three versions were finally cancelled. It is an entertaining and original platform game (although aesthetically it is very similar to other similar Ocean games) that turns out to be the sequel to a title known as Putty, also available on Super Nintendo.rnrnThe objective of each level is to rescue a certain number of putties that have been taken prisoner, and to do so we have to explore the scenarios in search of them. Once located, all we have to do is stand on top of them and press down to rescue them. When we have found all the putties we must go to the exit door of the level, whose location is indicated by an arrow that will appear when we have all the putties in our possession. As our protagonist is a creature similar to an amorphous blob, he can perform certain movements such as turning part of his body into a fist that hits enemies (this being his main weapon), absorbing items with different properties (including some that transform us), stretching to climb walls and he can also jump.

game.name: Q*bert 3
game.desc: Q*bert 3 is a game programmed by Realtime Associantes and published and distributed by NTVIC for Super Nintendo, appearing first in the United States in October 1992 and later in Japan on January 29, 1993, although it did not land in Europe. It is a sequel to the Q*bert saga with a style very similar to the original arcade Q*bert, so we are faced with a fun platform with axonometric view with many elements of a puzzle-type game.rnrnThe decorations with axonometric view are presented to us with pyramids formed by blocks through which Q*bert must pass. The idea is that you must go through all of them to change their color, avoiding enemies and falling into the void. Like the Game Boy's Q*bert, the levels are presented to us as larger settings than those that appeared in the arcade and in various ways. Classic enemies from the original game also appear, but new ones like the Frog are included.

game.name: Race Drivin'
game.desc: Race Drivin' is a sequel to Hard Drivin'. It is a game programmed, published and distributed by Atari Games for arcades in 1989, being ported to other systems such as Atari Lynx, Mega Drive or Amiga. The Lynx version was marketed exclusively in the United States, going on sale in 1991 as a very faithful version of the original, so we are faced with an entertaining polygonal driving game, although with imprecise control. Like many other games of this style, the objective of the game is to drive along the road avoiding different obstacles in the form of vehicles and the edges of the road (with which we will have to deal with in the curves) and having to reach the different checkpoints before they stop. time runs out. To differentiate itself a little more from other driving arcades of the time, apart from its visual appearance we have elements such as ramps, knot-shaped acrobatic sections and other traps. Another very innovative aspect of the cartridge is that it incorporates a very realistic manual transmission mode, not limited to pressing the gear shift, but we also have to press the clutch.

game.name: Radical Psycho Machine Racing
game.desc: RPM Racing was preceded by Rareware's R.C. Pro-Am in 1988 and Electronic Art's Racing Destruction Set in 1985, the latter being the biggest influence. It is a precursor to Rock 'n Roll Racing, which was made by the same developer.rnrnCombat, obstacles and traction on tracks that are not flat play an important role. There are 3 types of vehicles to choose from that perform differently on pavement, dirt, ice, flat or bumpy tracks. Cars can be armed with oil, nitro and mines. Additionally, there are 3 levels of tires, engines, shocks and armor. There is a season mode, single race and custom track modes. In 1-player mode, the second player is replaced by one of 8 computer (AI) opponents who are associated with their own vehicle.

game.name: Radical Rex
game.desc: Radical Rex is a 1 or 2-player platform game released in 1994 for North America, Europe, and Australia. It was published by Activision and developed by Australian game studio Beam Software for the Super NES, Genesis and Sega CD. The star is Radical Rex, a fire-breathing skateboarding Tyrannosaurus, who must save his land, and his girlfriend Rexanne, from an evil wizard named Sethron. In his path are dinosaurs, sea creatures, and other monsters.rnrnRex has a few abilities, including a roar that kills or damages all enemies on the screen, a fire breath that can temporarily immobilize enemies, and a bubble spray that he can use while underwater.

game.name: Raiden Trad
game.desc: In the year 2090, Earth has suddenly become the target of crazy aliens known as the Cranassians. After the invasion, the World Military Alliance builds a new cutting-edge weapon, the Raiden Supersonic Attack Fighter. Based on a captured alien ship, it is humanity's only hope for survival.rnrnRaiden consists of eight vertically scrolling missions where the player maneuvers the Raiden ship by dodging and destroying enemy robots, buildings, ground targets and aircraft. There are bombs and missile powerups, as well as collectible medals that add to the score. When the player dies, the fighter's fragments become projectiles that damage enemies. After defeating the Stage 8 boss, the mission is completed, and the player receives 1 million points for each completed loop. Afterwards, you will start back to Stage 1. This time, the enemies will shoot faster and at a faster pace.

game.name: Rampart
game.desc: The Super Nintendo version of Rampart was programmed by Bitmasters and published and distributed by Electronic Arts, coming out exclusively for the North American market in August 1992. We find a good version of the original that does not improve much with respect to conversions of less powerful consoles, but it has some curious effect and in the end it is a fun combination of strategy and action.rnrnThe style of play is the same as in the original or in the previously analyzed Lynx version, so it is a game of castle defense strategy and action with two phases per castle, the attack and counterattack phase and the wall repair phase, although unlike other versions, during the attack there will be scrolling instead of being a single screen, perhaps due to the resolution of Super Nintendo.

game.name: Ranma 1/2 : Hard Battle
game.desc: Ranma 1/2: Hard Battle is a fighting game based on the popular Japanese manga and animation series in which we can choose between several of its protagonists, each of whom has their own fighting style and custom special blows. We have three game modes. On the one hand we have the typical tournament, on the other hand the classic two-player combats and finally a mode for two players that consists of a duel between teams of five fighters. If we manage to be the tournament champion, Pantyhose will become a selectable character.

game.name: Rap Jam : Volume One
game.desc: This game combines basketball with some of the most popular rappers of the time as players to choose from. Some of the artists included are: Public Enemy, LL Cool J, Naughty By Nature, Queen Latifah (!), Yo-Yo, House of Pain, Onyx, Warren G. and Coolio. The game is based on the fast-paced NBA Jam and takes place in various outdoor courts in 5 different cities in the United States. Up to four players can compete, and the "Xtra" button works similarly to the turbo. There is a shot meter that allows you to make impossible dunks and burn the rim. There are no 3-point shots and there are no fouls in the game.

game.name: Realm
game.desc: Realm is a game programmed by Titus Software and published and distributed by Flair Software for Super Nintendo in 1996, reaching the European market in January 1997. It is a quite entertaining run'n gun-style frenetic action and platform game whose gameplay reminds me personally a little more of Turrican than a counter. forward as in a classic Contra. That is why the character has to explore each scenario in search of the level's exit, which will be guarded by a dangerous end-of-phase boss. Along the way to this inevitable confrontation, we will encounter a multitude of varied enemies who will have to be shot down. It is not as fast-paced a game as Contra or Turrican itself, but we will still have to face numerous types of enemies in each level. Naturally we can acquire weapons of all types, but except for the one we have at the beginning, they all have limited ammunition.

game.name: Redline F-1 Racer
game.desc:
Compete in a Formula 1 race that allows you to configure practically all the parts of your vehicle, adapting it to different types of track and weather.
This is a fairly fast and challenging game, which requires good reflexes and the right equipment for each race. Although it takes some time to get used to operating the controls accurately, they respond quite well, especially in a well-configured vehicle.

game.name: Relief Pitcher
game.desc: This baseball game has the following game modes: Starting Pitcher - 9 Inning Game for one or two players, Relief Pitcher - 12 Season Game for one player, and Relief Pitcher - Best of 7 Series for two players. Start Pitcher mode allows the player to play a 9 inning baseball game. Players choose one of four fictional teams, each with their own specialty, such as being a power hitting team or a good fielding team. Players then select their pitcher's special pitch type (knuckleball, rising fastball, screwball, or sinker), whether to throw left or right, and whether to throw overhand or sidearm. In the field, pitching and batting are done from behind the batsman's sight. When throwing, a timing meter determines the thrower's grip. The maximum power of the pitch, or whether the pitcher intentionally walks the batter. While at bat, players have to time their swing to hit the pitch. Hitters can swing both high and low, swing normally or with power, and bunt. On offense, if the player has runners on base, the player may choose to have the baserunners carry off the base, steal, or hit and run.rn

game.name: Revolution X
game.desc:
Revolution X is about 'Rock & Roll.
There is an evil nation that subjugates the youth and bans our beloved rock music. Who are you going to call? Aerosmith! With the help of Aerosmith, the player must shoot his way through enemy-infested levels, setting guns ablaze, collecting power-ups and freeing hostages.

game.name: Rex Ronan : Experimental Surgeon
game.desc: Rex Ronan: Experimental Surgeon teaches players about the dangers of smoking tobacco cigarettes. The player enters a man (named Jake Westboro); is dying of lung cancer while undergoing emergency surgery. He has a wife, a child, a house in the suburbs and a job with the Blackburn Tobacco Company that he had since he was 15. Now the man is dying for the cigarettes he once sold; The player must go inside his body and defeat the evil tar and nicotine that is preventing man from talking to the world about the dangers of tobacco. If the player is killed by robots sent by the tobacco company, so is the patient.

game.name: RHI Roller Hockey '95
game.desc: Motion captured graphics made their first appearance in a hockey game with this license from Brett Hull. Al Michaels provides full commentary, while a mode is also included that allows the player to improve their game with the help of Brett. The game is viewed isometrically, with all realistic fouls and game situations included. Full pre-match analysis and forecasts are provided, as are post-match statistics.

game.name: Riddick Bowe Boxing
game.desc: Chavez is a boxing game aimed at the Mexican public, in honor of the until then undefeated boxer Julio César Chávez, 5-time world champion.

game.name: Riddick Bowe Boxing
game.desc: Chavez is a boxing game aimed at the Mexican public, in honor of the until then undefeated boxer Julio César Chávez, 5-time world champion.

game.name: Rise of the Phoenix
game.desc: Play as one of two powerful warriors engaged in a bitter rivalry for control of China in its founding years, beginning in 206 BC. Battle alongside your opponent in open fields or outside city walls. Launch attacks against your enemies' strongholds using arrows, catapults and battering rams. You can send units on secret night raids, order ambushes, and dam rivers in hopes of flooding enemy strongholds. Challenge your opponents to one-on-one duels on horseback, and go head-to-head with the computer or challenge a friend in hopes of controlling all 39 cities.

game.name: Rise of the Robots
game.desc: This is a 1 vs. fighting game. 1 of a fairly traditional nature, although with the exception that instead of having more or less human characters, this time they are fights between robots. The game has two game modes, story mode and versus mode. In story mode we can only control a robot that must defeat the rest of the available characters using fairly useless attacks that only consist of punches and kicks, without any type of combo or special attack, while the rest of the characters have more strength, more range of their attacks and even special attacks. The other game mode is for two players, but someone had the great idea that the first player can only control the robot protagonist of the story mode while the second can control any of the robots, giving a clear advantage to the second player.

game.name: Rival Turf!
game.desc:
Rival Turf! is a beat'em up in the Final Fight line that, without being as good as this one, is still capable of offering hours of fun, especially in two-player mode.
We can control two different characters, Jack Flak and "Oozie" Nelson, and with one of them or with both if we play with a friend we have to advance through various scenarios while we fight with punches and kicks all the enemies that come our way, until we reach a confrontation against a final boss of the phase. We can use various types of attacks, such as simple punches, jumping and attacking or different ways of grabbing the opponent, as well as different types of weapons. In addition to the normal mode where we go phase by phase following a predetermined story, we also have the versus mode, in which the player who achieves two victories in three rounds wins the fight.

game.name: Road Riot 4WD
game.desc:
A game that offers four-wheel drive racing with the addition of vehicle combat.
The game has 3 difficulty levels (novice, intermediate and professional). Players start on a simple beginner track and after completing that, they get to compete on 11 different tracks in different locations to win the series championship. Some locations are located in the United States such as New Jersey and Las Vegas, while other tracks are located on other continents such as Africa, Australia and even Antarctica. Each of these tracks has a host whose team of 3 vehicles the player must defeat.
Players' vehicle is equipped with an unlimited number of missiles that can be used to fire at opposing vehicles to slow them down.

game.name: Road Runner's Death Valley Rally
game.desc:
Road Runner's Death Valley Rally is a game programmed and distributed by Sunsoft for Super Nintendo at the end of 1992, although its sale in Spain would be delayed until February 1994. It is a fun platformer starring the road runner.
The objective of each level that makes up the game will be to escape from the hungry coyote that is on our heels and that will prepare ingenious traps to finish us off. To escape we have our incredible speed, which will even allow us to run up walls, in the purest style of one of its chapters. To defend itself, the roadrunner will rely on its beak. Although the first level is not excessively difficult, you only have to move forward, avoiding the coyote and the different animals on the way until you reach the end, with the fun final animation, the game will gain in difficulty, until reaching limits that many find excessive.

game.name: RoboCop 3
game.desc: RoboCop 3 is a side-scrolling platform shooter. You have missions (like rescuing your friends who are being held hostage), which are divided into several smaller levels. The levels usually consist of several platforms, and are heavily populated by enemies that shoot at you. You can collect special respawn kits, which will be used to restore your health after you have completed a level. "RoboCop 3" is more of a shooter than its predecessors, having more and tougher enemies.

game.name: RoboCop versus The Terminator
game.desc:
Save the future of humanity and stop the mechanical rebellion in this unusual side-scrolling action-shooter game for the Super Nintendo, based on Dark Horse's legendary comic book miniseries. The plot remains more faithful to the source material than other versions: when Flo, a resistance soldier, travels back in time to destroy RoboCop after discovering that his neural technology will give life to Skynet, Alex Murphy decides to rebel against his programming and fight the machines on his own.
The gameplay deploys a less frenetic "Run and Gun" rhythm and more focused on precision platforming, replacing explicit blood with explosions of sparks and fire. Explore interactive levels by arming RoboCop with rocket launchers, plasma rifles and heavy lasers. The title requires extreme precision when dealing with an erratic impact system and the infinite respawn of enemies on the screen.

game.name: Robotrek
game.desc: Robotrek, known as Slap Stick in Japan, is a game programmed by Quintet and Ancient and published and distributed by Enix for Super Nintendo in 1994, and although it reached the American market in October of the same year, unfortunately it never did so in the European market. It is a great RPG set in a fantastic world but with science fiction involved, plus it has a good sense of humor. The perspective, as in most games of this genre at that time, will be top-down, and in each scenario the protagonist will be able to move freely. Furthermore, instead of having random encounters with enemies, they will be visible from a moment, so we can avoid them or choose to confront them. The combat system is turn-based, but with a real-time system similar to that used in the Final Fantasy saga, but with the big difference that we can move around the combat area during our turn. The great novelty of this cartridge is that the protagonists will not fight directly, but rather the robots that we create throughout the adventure. We can only use one at a time, but we can trade them in a similar way to Pokemon. Furthermore, if we manage to accumulate money and experience, which in this adventure is called Megs of Data, in addition to program points, we can customize our robots, adding new weapons, greater resistance or increasing their vitality.

game.name: Rock n' Roll Racing
game.desc: Rock n' Roll Racing is a racing and vehicle combat game from Blizzard that came out for both Super Nintendo and Mega Drive, being very similar titles but with some technical differences, less evident in the graphics, but much more palpable in the sound aspect. And the Super Nintendo version had melodies with a much better sound quality, with a much more successful recreation of the instruments. That is why, although the Mega Drive version has a couple more circuits and an exclusive melody (which also gives the impression that it is the best-sounding of this version, perhaps because it was created for this version), the Super Nintendo version is better for many more, since this is a game where music plays a fundamental role, since the soundtrack is made up of classic rock songs. These include "Born to Be Wild," "Bad to the Bone," "The Peter Gunn Theme," "Highway Star" and "Paranoid."

game.name: Rocko's Modern Life : Spunky's Dangerous Day
game.desc: Rocko's Modern Life is a side-scrolling adventure where the player takes control of the Nickelodeon character, Rocko, as they travel through three different stages (Rock-O-Whey Beach, Hill-O-Stench Garbage Dump, and Laundryland) trying to protect his beloved dog Spunky from the various dangers throughout the stages. As Rocko travels across the stage, he has to perform various tasks to keep Spunky out of harm's way, such as throwing him over safer platforms, moving objects to stop his fall, or fighting off various enemies who want to harm him. There is no time limit and it starts with lives, with a health bar for Spunky while the player character, Rocko, cannot be hurt. The story is told through comic-style panels and features classic characters such as Hefer, The Bigheads, and Earl the Experimental Dog.

game.name: Rocky Rodent
game.desc:
Rocky Rodent, known in Japan as Nitro Punks: Might Heads, is a game programmed, published and distributed by Irem for the Super Nintendo in 1993, going on sale that year for both Japan and the United States, although it never reached Europe. It is a fun, fast and varied platform game starring a very particular and charismatic character
In the game we control a rodent named Rocky who must make his way through various scenarios, eliminating enemies and jumping from platform to platform as is typical in the genre, with the aim of reaching the end of the level or facing an end-of-phase boss. It must also be said that the game is quite varied, and some of the levels are very fast, and at times it seems like a cross between Super Mario Bros. and Sonic The Hedgehog. To advance in the game, Rokcy is able to run, jump, and use various types of hairstyles that provide him with special abilities.

game.name: Roger Clemens' MVP Baseball
game.desc: Roger Clemens is known by some as the greatest pitcher in baseball history. In Roger Clemens MVP Baseball you can play a standard 9-inning baseball game in exhibition mode and you can play a full regular season, including the World Championship Playoffs in regular season mode. While playing in Regular Season mode, the player can view the progress of their chosen team using the in-game calendar that displays all games.

game.name: Romance of the Three Kingdoms II
game.desc: The sequel to Romance of the Three Kingdoms. The concept of the game remains the same, although they improved many of the features that one may consider "disturbing" from RTK I (e.g. Generals dying easily due to illness, etc.). RTK can be said to be much more "stable" where players no longer have to worry much about in-game timing, as the game takes a slower pace of time to allow players to build up their forces without much interference. The RTK II gameplay and interface is very similar to Nobunaga's Ambition II.

game.path: ./Romance of the Three Kingdoms III - Dragon of Destiny (USA).zip
game.name: Romance of the Three Kingdoms III : Dragon of Destiny
game.desc:
Romance of the Three Kingdoms III: Dragon of Destiny is another strategy game from Koei. The concept is the same here as in other Koei wargames: conquer as much as you can!
In this case the historical setting is ancient China. The country is under the control of an emperor, but all the faction leaders want to be the emperor himself. You start with one territory and must conquer more to win the game.
game.image: ./media/images/Romance of the Three Kingdoms III - Dragon of Destiny (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Romance of the Three Kingdoms III - Dragon of Destiny (USA).png

game.path: ./Romance of the Three Kingdoms IV - Wall of Fire (USA).zip
game.name: Romance of the Three Kingdoms IV : Wall of Fire
game.desc: Romance of the Three Kingdoms IV: Chinese history is the setting for this strategic war game. Select one of 38 leaders and guide your people to power by military or diplomatic means in a world viewed isometrically. Military tactics such as well-placed provocations and deliberate confusion of the enemy are available. Weaponry includes catapults and self-firing crossbows.
game.image: ./media/images/Romance of the Three Kingdoms IV - Wall of Fire (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Romance of the Three Kingdoms IV - Wall of Fire (USA).png

game.name: R-Type III
game.desc: R-Type III: The Third Lighting is a game programmed, published and distributed by Irem originally for the Super Nintendo in 1993, with a version later programmed for the Game Boy Advance. The Super Nintendo version reached the European market in 1994 as a spectacular and very entertaining shoot'em up that solves all the defects of Super R-Type, especially in things like slowdowns.rnrnThe style of play is very similar to the rest of the installments in the saga, and in general to other games of the same genre. The ship we drive will have to advance through varied scenarios infested with enemies that we will have to destroy with the weapons available to face the boss at the end of the corresponding phase. To achieve this, our ship has two types of fire. With one our ship will fire continuously, while if we hold down the other attack button the ship will accumulate energy to finally launch a much more powerful shot. We also have an auxiliary ship that we choose at the beginning of the game, although we have to locate it first. She will shoot at the same time as us and we can let her go at her own pace or attach her to our ship, both in front and behind, which is very useful for attacking enemies that approach us from behind.

game.name: Run Saber
game.desc: Run Saber is a game programmed by Horisoft and published and distributed by Atlus for the Super Nintendo in 1993, coming out that same year in both the United States and Europe. It is a very good run'n gun with a style very similar to Strider, so much so that it is evident that the game's programmers based their adventure on the great Capcom classic.

game.name: S.O.S : Sink or Swim
game.desc: This time you are going to hit rock bottom! The SS Lucifer is sinking after hitting an iceberg. Full of panicked passengers waiting for their hero, Kevin Codner, to come to the rescue. Playing the role of Kevin, you have to guide the passengers through the worst dangers before time runs out and the compartments flood.

game.name: Sailormoon
game.desc: The game is based on the popular manga/animation series of the same name. The heroine of the series is a 14-year-old girl named Serena (Usagi in the Japanese version). One day she meets a magical talking cat named Luna, who tells her that she has been chosen to be a Sailor Moon fighter, to find the lost Princess of the Moon Kingdom and fight the forces of darkness led by the evil Queen Beryl. This story adaptation is a beat-'em-up game. You can control Serena or one of her Sailor Moon companions. Each girl has different strengths and special attacks. Advance through the game by moving on a platform and defeating the enemies you encounter. You can't move forward if you haven't defeated all the enemies that keep attacking you.

game.name: Samurai Shodown
game.desc: A samurai fears nothing. Fight to triumph over evil. And he lives for one purpose: Destroy all his enemies! 12 warriors fight in a tournament whose objective is to prove who is the strongest in the world. But the initial objective takes a new turn when a powerful demon known as Amakusa is awakened: now, whoever turns out to be the strongest of them all will have the responsibility of eliminating him, and neutralizing his threat.

game.name: Saturday Night Slam Masters
game.desc: It's Saturday night and the Slam Masters have arrived! Ten of the biggest and strongest fighters to ever step foot in the ring have come together for a tournament where THERE ARE NO RULES! Enter the ring and prepare for wrestling inside the ring, crush your opponents against the ropes, or dare to fight outside the ring, where fights with tables, chairs and bottles are part of the action. And just when you think you've had enough, grab a multiplayer adapter and try up to four Battle Royal players, where only the last Slam Master will survive.

game.name: Scooby-Doo Mystery
game.desc: Scooby, Shaggy, and the whole gang are at it again! This time with the case of the ghosts that terrorize the Drabwell ranch and the crazy pirate of Deadman's Cove. You have to find all the spooky clues to solve these amazing mysteries. With classic sound effects from the Scooby series, Hanna-Barbera cartoon characters, and hidden surprises, Scooby-Doo Mystery will make you scream.

game.name: SeaQuest DSV
game.desc: SeaQuest DSV, the largest and most powerful submarine of the future, under your command. Sail through the pirate-infested waters and face many challenges. To succeed, you must take control of all of the Seaquest's weapons and navigation systems. Explore the depths, respond to distress calls, and use the Whisker system to locate missions. You can choose between the Hyper-Reality Probe, the Darwin Dolphin, or four different launch vehicles to complete your missions. You will have to carry out dangerous rescues, recover sunken treasures and, above all, keep peace in an underwater world with too many problems. The bridge is yours, captain.

game.name: Secret of Evermore
game.desc: In Dr. Sidney Ruffleberg's old, decaying mansion, a boy and his dog stumble upon a mysterious machine. By pure accident they are sent to Evermore, a utopia that has now become a confusing and deadly world. A world of prehistoric jungles, ancient civilizations, medieval kingdoms and futuristic cities. During his odyssey, the boy must master a variety of weapons, learn to harness the forces of alchemy, and make powerful allies to fight the diabolical monsters of Evermore. With the help of their dog, who masters shapeshifting and with enough skill and courage they can uncover the mysterious clues, they can only find their way home by discovering the secret of Evermore.

game.name: Secret of Mana
game.desc: There is a force in the universe that keeps good and evil in perfect balance. It is called the Mana tree. But a magical sword has tricked a young warrior into disturbing the balance, spreading evil across the land. For this reason, the warrior must undertake a dangerous journey to find the seeds of the Mana tree, which have been hidden for centuries, only then can you restore harmony in the universe. In this incredible adventure, things are not as they seem. The world is changing and you must help the warrior set it right. And the only way to succeed is to solve the secret of Mana.

game.name: Shadowrun
game.desc: Year 2050. Mega complexes are monsters that cast long shadows. When you become a Shadowrunner, that's where you live... in the cracks between immense corporate structures. Megacorporations are powerful in an age where power means information...computational information flowing in the global network called MATRIX. Disoriented and confused, you are forced into a race against time and technology. Moving in the shadows, survival depends on your wits, your weapons and your companions. Immerse yourself in the dark side of the future, where technology and magic come together, where destruction is a way of life. Dive into Shadowrun.

game.name: Shanghai II : Dragon's Eye
game.desc: The ancient fascination with Mah-Jongg meets modern video games in this strategy game to challenge the Western world - Shanghai II: Dragon's Eye. Think carefully about every movement! Become a master of the game, and then face the final challenge: The Dragon Eye!

game.name: Shaq-Fu
game.desc: As Shaq, use your lightning-fast shuriken and other martial arts techniques to defeat 6 other evil warriors in the fight for justice. Or choose one of the 7 fighters and go head to head with another. Conjure Voodo's bone-shattering earthquake, rebound with Rajah's shock sword, or tear your enemies apart with Sett the mummy's embrace. And, of course, discover the secret moves and powers until you master them all. Tournament, Duel and Story Mode.

game.name: Shien's Revenge
game.desc: Enjoy a stunning weekend with us in Greece in the year 500 AD. Shien's Revenge takes you through time to places like 21st century South America and 13th century Mongolia. Sounds like a vacation from hell. The only one who could put problems in your travel plans is Saw Tooth, master of evil ninja techniques, with a tendency to destroy everything that comes into his sight. Oh, and watch out for the hanging snakes that live in the treetops, they are usually hungry. And we don't forget to mention the Undertaker.

game.name: Sid Meier's Civilization
game.desc: Civilization is a turn-based strategy game. The game begins in the year 4000 BC. The player plays the role of the leader of a civilization, starting with a single colonization unit and a warrior, and attempts to build an empire in competition with between one and eleven other civilizations. The game requires quite a bit of micromanagement. In addition to the broader tasks of exploration, warfare, and diplomacy, the player must make decisions about where to build new cities, what upgrades or units to build in each city, what knowledge advancements to research, and how to transform the terrain surrounding the cities for maximum benefit. From time to time, the player's cities may be harassed by barbarians, units with no specific nationality and no named leader. These threats come only from undiscovered lands or seas.

game.name: Side Pocket
game.desc: Put chalk on the cue and place all the balls. Get ready, start the game by breaking with a good shot! The balls are scattered, the game has begun. It's the Finals of the Data East Pool Tournament, and you're losing! You will need a steady hand and a good eye to reach the top of the tournament. It's a green felt jungle!

game.name: Sim Ant: The Electronic Ant Colony
game.desc: Experience life as an ant: defend the queen and the colony, face hungry spiders and fight hordes of enemy ants, eat delicious caterpillars and chase those disgusting humans out of your house. Based on real ants. SimAnt is the closest you'll get to being an ant, without growing more legs, without shrinking your brain, and without living in a hole in the ground.

game.name: SimCity 2000 : The Ultimate City Simulator
game.desc: SimCity 2000 puts an entire city in the palm of your hand. SimCity 2000 allows you to create, build and manage your own city. Take on the role of mayor and govern the city head on. It will have to keep housing, industries, public transportation and commerce up to date to attract new citizens. And just when you think you have everything under control, a natural disaster or an alien invasion can happen to complicate things. However, if you are able to overcome all these problems, you will be able to turn a small town into a thriving metropolis.

game.name: SimCity
game.desc: Start with a small town (name it whatever you want) and build it into a metropolis. Or, take on the challenge of rescuing a city overwhelmed with problems. Either way, taxes, urban planning, crime, transportation, education, fire control and other critical issues are in your hands. Time passes, and every decision you make has a future consequence. Your assistant, Dr. Wright, can help you make the right decisions. Just ask! Unexpected catastrophes also threaten your thriving city: fires, earthquakes, plane crashes, even a giant monster that likes industrial pollution. Will you build the ideal city? Or will the disgruntled citizens leave you alone in a ghost town?

game.name: SimEarth : The Living Planet
game.desc: In Sim Earth you have to control the evolutionary processes of different planets. By regulating factors such as climate and earth temperature, you must ensure that your planet prospers, is habitable and reaches a level of population and evolution sufficient to satisfy the requirements of each level.

game.name: Skuljagger : Revolt of the Westicans
game.desc: The pirate Sküljagger and his gang have taken over the island of Westica. Forcing the people who live there to be his slaves, Sküljagger dictates the rules with an iron fist. A brave sailor named Storm Jaxon decides to rebel and steal Sküljagger's magic sword. Now he must fight for his life and ultimately free the people of Westica.

game.name: Skyblazer
game.desc: Ashura, Lord of War, has conquered the Kingdom and only SkyBlazer has the power to save the world from eternal evil. As SkyBlazer, son of the great sorcerer SKyLord, you have the incredible ability to transform into many different beings and summon the powers of nature at will. Experience revolutionary action with dangerous journeys through strange lands, where water jets rise like towers, sands move like oceans, and enemies fall from trees and emerge from molten lava. The incredible collection of diabolical bosses can only be defeated by harnessing SkyBlazer's incredible strength and resources. Fight on land, climb into the clouds, swim through underwater caverns, explore strange ruins, and climb steep cliffs, until you reach the tower of the Tarolisk. Your last challenge awaits you here, defeating Ashura.

game.name: Smart Ball
game.desc: Once upon a time there was a far away country where everything was peaceful. Two brothers ruled together. But Prince Jerry and Emi were getting married, and his brother, Prince Tom, was jealous. A mysterious sorcerer approached Prince Tom to tempt him, telling him: "If you expel Jerry, you can rule this place alone!" After saying this, the sorcerer turned Jerry into a blue jelly. Everyone considers him missing, so he must do something to prevent Tom from keeping Emi and the throne.

game.name: Smash Tennis
game.desc: Known in Japan as Super Family Tennis, this game is a fun success oriented more towards playability than simulation. It has players with very diverse skills who will multiply the possibilities of each match, balancing strength, precision and speed.

game.name: Snow White in Happily Ever After
game.desc: The classic fairy tale is back! ...with all its charm and a new twist in the story!!! Snow White's beloved prince has been captured by the evil Lord Maliss, the evil brother of Snow White's equally evil stepmother, the wicked queen. Helping Snow White rescue the prince you will have the Seven Dwarfs, the cousins ​​of the original seven dwarfs. Guide Snow White along her dangerous journey through Lord Maliss' sinister kingdom to save the prince.

game.name: Soldiers of Fortune
game.desc: In the last century, an inventor experimented with time, space and the first computers, creating a strange machine. This inventor was Baron Fortesque. The machine was The Engine of Chaos. Although primitive, the machine became incredibly powerful and ran amok, turning ordinary humans into killing machines, destructive monsters and automatons appeared everywhere, and even prehistoric beasts were resurrected and destroyed order in the world. But 6 brave mercenaries are willing to restore peace and tranquility to the world.

game.name: Sonic Blast Man II
game.desc: The legions of terror arrived without any warning. They are the legions of Yafu, a being who possesses amazing mental powers. For Yafu, people are like insects; parasites that infect the Earth. The eradication campaign has begun. Once again, three superheroes are called to save the planet: Captain Choyear, Sonia and Sonic Blast Man!!!

game.name: Sonic Blast Man
game.desc: Sonic Blast Man is highly trained in any form of hand-to-hand combat. With his explosive punches, kicks, judo holds and other fighting techniques, he uses his body to sweep enemies off the screen. As you travel across Earth to the space station, you will be assaulted by hundreds of human, robot, and alien enemies. Blast Man faces adventures that will put him to the limits of his possibilities...And beyond!

game.name: SOS
game.desc: Known in Japan as 'Septentrion', this game offers us an epic survival adventure in which we will fight to escape from the ship before it sinks. We can choose between four different characters at the beginning, and each one will live the adventure in a different way. Along the way we will meet other survivors, and depending on who we save, the adventure will end in one way or another thanks to its different possible endings. But don't fall asleep on the way, because we only have one hour to get off the boat. Or we will go down with him!

game.name: Soul Blazer
game.desc: Money... origin of all evil. Obsessed with the desire for wealth, King Magridd made a wicked deal with the devil. Now the Freil Empire is in ruins and you are the one chosen to save it. Free the captive souls of the kingdom and rescue a beautiful maiden. Boldly navigate the six stages in this action-RPG game. Different weapons, armor and magic are at your disposal. After saving the kingdom, you will face Deathtoll, make him pay.

game.name: Space Ace
game.desc: The evil Commander Borf has kidnapped Ace's girlfriend, the beautiful Kimberly, and plans to enslave the Earth using his dreaded "Infant Ray", a weapon that turns anyone into a helpless baby. Armed with only a laser weapon, Ace must find and destroy the Child Ray, rescue Kimberly, and save the Earth. Normal day at work for a superhero, right?

game.name: Space Football : One on One
game.desc: Futuristic sport in which two spaceships fight for a sphere, with the intention of taking the ball to the rival points zone. The playing field is divided in two, and is full of pinball-style obstacles. Matches last five minutes. You can fire projectiles at your opponent, reducing their effectiveness.

game.name: Space Invaders
game.desc: Since its release in 1978, Space Invaders has amazed and entertained millions of people with a game that simply cannot be stopped playing. Protect the Earth, destroy the elusive UFO and discover the hidden secrets of the game that conquered the world!
game.genre: Shots / Type Space Invaders-Shoot'em Up / Vertical-Shoot'em Up-Shots

game.name: Space Megaforce
game.desc: In Space Megaforce the exciting speed of the game is its most attractive feature, the movements of the enemies are fast, your shots and the shots of the enemies are fast, so you absolutely have to move fast. The action fills the screen, the battle brims with high-speed shooting enthusiasm. Additionally, there is the fire control system operated with the "R" button. You can attack the enemy in various ways with your weapon using this system. Naturally, the features of the SNES are squeezed to the maximum in this exciting game!

game.name: Spanky's Quest
game.desc: One day, while Spanky was walking carefree through the woods, he was attacked by a witch. Our hero understood little about modern constructions, but the truth is that he found himself trapped in a strange place full of walls, doors, and... evil living fruits. The witch was determined to keep Spanky, but he, of course, has other plans. With the help of an unlimited supply of magic bubbles, your mission will be to help Spanky get out of this crazy place, and in the process, teach the witch a good lesson.

game.name: Sparkster
game.desc: THE ROCKET KNIGHT RETURNS! Sparkster finds himself in serious trouble. From the disorder caused by the destruction of "Pigstar", the spaceship of the Devotindos empire, another witchy and evil Empire has emerged. Once again, Sparkster has to fight against the evil ones with the sole desire to regain peace, let the adventure begin!

game.name: Spectre
game.desc: Specter is a one or two player game, played in a virtual world, it puts the player in a futuristic combat tank, fighting to survive in a cybernet world. Sit back and take control of your fully adaptable Battlecraft, armed and armored with all-new features. In the powerful Cyber ​​Arena you will fight against enemy robots, whose combat tactics unit is controlled by artificial intelligence in real time. While stalking the enemy you must collect all the flags to advance to the next level. Replenishing energy and ammunition is the key to success as you race against the clock, fighting harder and harder against the unknown.

game.path: ./Speed Racer in My Most Dangerous Adventures (USA).zip
game.name: Speed Racer in My Most Dangerous Adventures
game.desc:
Get ready for adventure, racing fans! Speed ​​Racer and his powerful Mach 5 are back! Speed ​​is a teenager born into the world of high-tech mechanics. His brother Spridle, his girlfriend Trixie, and the rest of the GO team accompany him on his races around the world, as they fight evil wherever they go.
As Speed ​​Racer, you'll drive the world's fastest and most advanced vehicle, the Mach 5. You'll reach speeds of over 200 MPH as you compete on six hostile courses including the Great Alpine Race and the Mythical Islands Tour. The legendary special features of the Mach 5 will help you escape danger, adapting to the treacherous and changing tracks of the World Racing Circuit.
game.image: ./media/images/Speed Racer in My Most Dangerous Adventures (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Speed Racer in My Most Dangerous Adventures (USA).png

game.name: Speedy Gonzales : Los Gatos Bandidos
game.desc: It's time to party in a small town in Mexico. All the happy little mice were having a great time! Until... The Bandit Cats arrived, and kidnapped everyone. As excited as they were, planning to have a great time with the little mice, the Cats didn't notice that one of them, Slowpoke Rodriguez, had escaped. There was only one thing he could do: call the fastest mouse in all of Mexico, Speedy Gonzales! After being informed that the mice had been taken to different parts of the country, Speedy must dedicate himself to the task of finding them and freeing them all.

game.name: Spider-Man & Venom : Maximum Carnage
game.desc: Following the story of the original comic step by step, guide Spider-Man and Venom as they try to catch Carnage, who has escaped from prison and gathered a large number of dangerous allies, in order to achieve revenge. With intermission scenes taken directly from the pages of the comic, this is a game with quite attractive graphics and large, well-animated characters. It also has a wide variety of movements, and many secondary heroes and villains that complement the story. Very fun and challenging.

game.name: Spider-Man & X-Men : Arcade's Revenge
game.desc: Spider-Man and his mutant friends need your help to escape from the evil Arcade amusement park: fighting against killer clowns, hungry piranhas, death balls, and robot replicas of super villains like Carnage and Juggernaut! Will Spider's web, Wolverine's claws, Gambit's energy cards, Storm's lightning bolts, and Cyclops' optic blasts be enough to defeat Arcade? That's up to you!!

game.name: Spider-Man
game.desc: Spider-Man's past comes back to haunt him when the most ruthless madmen you can imagine escape from prison and band together to settle scores with him. Only his spider sense, his ability to climb walls, his acrobatic maneuvers while holding on to the spider's web and the help of the Fantastic Four will give him any chance. The hunt is on... but who is the prey?

game.name: Spindizzy Worlds
game.desc: Spindizzy World: A complicated and exciting action game. Overcome intricate traps and tons of enemies while controlling GERALD (Gyroscopic Exploration Landing Device). Nearly 100 levels, full of steep slopes and jumps. Complete all levels and conquer all stars!

game.name: Spirou
game.desc: Just as he is about to present his inventions at a scientific research symposium in New York, Count Champignac is kidnapped by Cyanure. The evil robot has only one goal, to rule the world. There is not a moment to lose, Spirou will have to navigate the streets, subways and skyscrapers of New York and fly to Palombia, a swampy jungle full of surprises.

game.name: Sports Illustrated Championship Football & Baseball
game.desc: Sports Illustrated brings you two popular sporting events in one realistic game. The excitement and non-stop action of professional American football or leading a baseball club to the major league championship. It's up to you to make the right decisions to lead your team to sporting success. Both sports feature good graphics, digitized voices, and great animated sequences. You will feel like you are really in the stadium experiencing the excitement of the match.

game.name: Star Fox : Super Weekend
game.desc: The Super Star Fox Weekend game presents us with a modification of the original Star Fox game used in competitions, plus an exclusive stage for this game! Every time you play, your total score is displayed at the end of your mission. We hope you enjoy playing this special game!

game.name: Star Fox
game.desc: In the distant Lylat star system, imagine yourself in command of the futuristic and heavily armed Arwing warship. You lead the counterattack against the invasion of hundreds of alien tanks, warships, laser firing platforms and super battleships. Maneuver at incredible speeds through fog-shrouded canyons, dense asteroid belts, and waves of the most sophisticated enemy defensive operations. You will have to use all your skill and cunning to take the fight to the enemy terrain, the planet Venom, and destroy the Central Brain to obtain victory.

game.path: ./Star Trek - Starfleet Academy - Starship Bridge Simulator (USA).zip
game.name: Star Trek : Starfleet Academy - Starship Bridge Simulator
game.desc: High tension in the Klingon Neutral Zone. You must overcome the blockade and deliver supplies to Federation colonists on a planet claimed by the Klingon Empire. One wrong move could lead to a war with millions of victims. Your reputation at the Academy is at stake. More than 15 missions in the last frontier. Control five different ships, from scientific vessels to heavy cruisers, on missions ranging from scientific research, diplomacy and battle. Star Trek: Starfleet Academy-The Bridge Simulator puts you on the bridge of Starfleet's best ships.
game.image: ./media/images/Star Trek - Starfleet Academy - Starship Bridge Simulator (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Star Trek - Starfleet Academy - Starship Bridge Simulator (USA).png

game.path: ./Star Trek - The Next Generation - Future's Past (USA).zip
game.name: Star Trek : The Next Generation - Future's Past
game.desc: The mission: uncover the mysteries of the most powerful device in the galaxy, the Derandomizer. Long considered a myth, the Derandomizer returns from the past to threaten the future of the Federation. But, the Federation is not the only one interested. The Romulans have crossed the Neutral Zone...and the mysterious alien Chodak fleets join them. From the Bridge, chart a course toward a strange new world. Together with the crew of Star Trek: The Next Generation you must pass the tests established by the Arbiter, the force that controls the powers of the Derandmizer. Captain Picard will offer guidance, but it's up to you who performs each mission. Will you need Worf's strength? Or Geordi's special vision? All systems are ready, Commander.
game.image: ./media/images/Star Trek - The Next Generation - Future's Past (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Star Trek - The Next Generation - Future's Past (USA).png

game.path: ./Star Trek - Deep Space Nine - Crossroads of Time (USA).zip
game.name: Star Trek, Deep Space Nine : Crossroads of Time
game.desc: Join the crew of the most famous space station in the galaxy! Adventure awaits as you guide Commander Sisko through a series of mysterious events that affect life on the station. Use all resources to ensure the stability of the Deep Space Nine Space Station!
game.image: ./media/images/Star Trek - Deep Space Nine - Crossroads of Time (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Star Trek - Deep Space Nine - Crossroads of Time (USA).png

game.name: Stargate
game.desc: In this title, based on the film of the same name, a mystical portal called "Stargate" has been discovered. By attempting to access the secrets it hides, its power is unlocked, creating a passage to a parallel world called Abydos. A special forces team is sent to the new world to investigate but they are soon ambushed and their supplies are taken, including a powerful nuclear bomb. Colonel O'Neil, leading the elite team, must accomplish a series of objectives beginning with recovering supplies and finding other teammates, such as archaeologist Daniel Jackson. With the entire team regrouped, O'Neil must lead the attack on the god Ra and return to Earth before the power of the nuclear bomb can be unleashed on this new world. The game is a platform adventure where the player controls O'Neil with the mission of accomplishing a series of objectives and is equipped with weapons such as a rifle and grenades. This adventure will guide this squad through the desert, caves and nomadic villages until they reach the palace of Ra.

game.name: Steel Talons
game.desc: Many pilots dream of becoming elite members of the Steel Talons, the air force equivalent of the Green Berets on the ground and the Marines of the Armed Forces at sea, but only the best will have that opportunity. Now it's your turn to demonstrate your supremacy in the sky by piloting the most advanced helicopter equipped with laser-guided missiles and a cannon with the latest advances in technology. You will have to face a wide variety of enemies, including tanks, helicopters, missiles or jet fighters that will increase in number and difficulty as you try to earn your place in Steel Talons. There are 14 combat missions that will test your flying skills, bravery and intelligence, so get ready for the fight of your life.

game.name: Sterling Sharpe : End 2 End
