game.desc: Sterling Sharpe was one of the greatest receivers in NFL history until injuries forced him to retire. But he has gathered all his skill and talent into his own video game. Choose your team from 30 NFL teams and get ready to compete with the strongest rivals. You'll have complete control of your team, from choosing your own quarterback to scheduling your own tactical talks. There are three game modes, End 2 End, Playoffs, and All-Star.

game.name: Stone Protectors
game.desc:
Like all good beat'em it is a "me against the neighborhood" with deep scenarios. Before starting to play we can choose one of 5 different characters (or two if we play with a friend), which have their own attributes and weapons.
The game has a total of 10 wide and varied phases in which the five furry protagonists will have to fight the Predators to get Zok's crystal and take it back to the kingdom. To achieve this, we have a series of objects that will be very useful to us throughout each of the levels, being especially relevant those that make us recover the life bar and the different weapons. In each phase we will have to advance until the enemies start to appear, at which point we will not be able to continue advancing until we defeat them all. To fight enemies we have a wide range of attacks that include punches, kicks, grabs, jumps, a special movement that consumes life and a weapon, with each character having a specific weapon. Of course, at the end of each route a dangerous end-of-phase boss will await us. Apart from the one or two player mode, we have two more, which are being accompanied by another character controlled by the machine and the tournament mode, which are battles against a second player.

game.name: Street Combat
game.desc: Street Combat is a 2D fighting game in which martial arts masters, military men and crime fighters from around the world decide to compete against each other in a street fighting tournament with the goal of achieving global fame and glory. The single player mode allows you to choose between two versions of the main character (Steven) with the aim of being the best in 7 battles in which the best of 3 rounds will win in each one. There is also a combat mode available between 2 players in which you can freely select any of the characters without restrictions. The gameplay is similar to other beat em ups, in which you control the movements of your characters trying to defeat your opponent with special moves and dodging their attacks.

game.name: Street Fighter Alpha 2
game.desc: Another Street Fighter sequel that adds even more power to this fighting classic. New characters in this version include Gen (a wise kung-fu master), Rolento (who will remind you of another character from a Capcom classic, Final Fight) and Sakura, a young schoolgirl who follows her hero Ryu so closely that she has learned the same type of moves. Dhalsim and Zangief also return to the scene with some new and improved moves. The other big difference is the loss of chain combos to the detriment of a custom combo system. Once you reach the required level (level 1 at least) you can execute a custom combo by combining any of the buttons (which are 6 in total) or any of the special attacks (fireballs, acrobatic kicks, etc.)

game.name: Street Fighter II Turbo
game.desc: Street Fighter II Turbo includes some changes to the first title in the series. The four main characters (M. Bison, Vega, Sagat and Balrog) were made playable. Players can choose the same character to fight against each other, using different colors to differentiate the second player. Each player's wallpapers were re-colored. The ''Turbo'' update introduced faster gameplay. The default turbo level was 3 but it can be selected up to level 10 using a special code. Many characters included new moves and some of the existing ones could now be performed in the air.

game.name: Street Fighter II
game.desc: Street Fighter II is globally recognized as the leading fighting game of its time, due to its unprecedented balance of gameplay with regard to the timing of attacks and blocks, and "special moves" with which players can execute complex fighting moves by moving the joystick and using combinations by pressing buttons. Players choose one of eight existing characters to fight: Ryu, Ken, Blanka, E. Honda, Zangief, Chun Li, Guile and Dhalsim. They must then use their combat forces to defeat the other seven combatants followed by four other main characters: M. Bison, Vega, Sagat and Balrog. Each character represents a certain country, has their own combat techniques and has their own reasons for wanting to win against others.

game.name: Street Racer
game.desc: Street Racer is a kart racing game similar to Super Mario Kart. Up to four players can play with split screen. If there are no human rivals, the player can drive against seven machine-controlled opponents in three leagues. If the player wins the first league he can access the second and by winning this he can access the third. The game has eight different vehicles with different abilities in speed, turbo or resistance. There are also some items on the tracks like bombs, nitro or health packs.

game.name: Street Sports : Jammit
game.desc: Jammit contains seven different modes for you to play basketball. If you feel like being more daring or applying more pressure, you can bet on the games and win money to buy different clothes and other items. Different camera angles give you great views of the action and there are different difficulties so everyone can get a challenge from the game. If you like basketball, you'll love this.

game.name: Street Sports : Street Hockey '95
game.desc: Street Hockey '95 takes skating sports to a whole new level with 24 megabytes of digitized graphics and sounds to transport you to the action of Roller Hockey in urban environments. You can choose from 9 skaters and compete in 5 different game modes in 6 scenarios ranging from an empty pool to a construction zone. Possibility of 4 players at the same time.

game.name: Strike Gunner S.T.G
game.desc: Allied nations are trying to establish global peace by destroying nuclear weapons and reducing weapons. But Sovinia, an independent military country is planning a massive invasion of the planet... prepare to defend Earth by piloting the latest fighter jet, the modified F-14 Strike Gunner, "PROJECT EARTH", the last hope of the human race is about to take off...

game.name: Stunt Race FX
game.desc: FX Stunt Race is a 3D racing game. Three vehicles are available, each with its own characteristics regarding speed, acceleration and power. In addition to racing against three other competitors, where you have to finish first, two other modes are available. In Stunt Trax, you must collect all the stars in the allotted time, while Battle Trax is a duel between two players where you have to finish the race before the other.

game.name: Sunset Riders
game.desc: In the Old West... In an age where manhood is measured by how quickly you pull the trigger, there are basically two types of gunfighters: those motivated by pure evil, and those motivated by a genuine sense of justice. Standing out among the latter, four friends have become famous throughout this entire region. Few manage to match his skills; The names of Steve, Billy, Bob and Cormano are widely known and respected. Grouped under the name of Sunset Riders, these brave men have dedicated their lives to capturing all kinds of dangerous bandits and criminal bosses, always motivated by their great love... of money. Eventually, they will track down Sir Richard Rose, one of the greatest leaders of the underworld. The challenge is definitely tempting... but the great reward offered is only comparable to the dangers they must face to reach it.

game.name: Super 3D Noah's Ark
game.desc: It's been a long journey. In just a few days, the doors of the ark will open and Noah, his family and the animals will return to dry land. But the animals have become a little restless and are out of their cages. Camels, giraffes, monkeys, kangaroos and more stroll along the ark's corridors. As Noah, it's your job to restore order and get the animals to sleep until you leave the ark. You are the only person to accomplish this with the food you brought aboard the ark.

game.name: Super Adventure Island II
game.desc: After a glorious wedding, Master Higgins and his wife Tina were on their way to their honeymoon. But, coming out of nowhere, a tropical storm crossed the sea and separated the happy couple. Tina survived, but woke up with all her memories erased, on Waku-waku Island. On another island, Master Higgins also woke up without memory; but like a good warrior, he decides that he must recover his past. Tina had stayed to live in Waku-waku. The king of the island soon fell in love with her, and they decided to marry. But just when the king was going to put on the engagement ring, a gigantic bird came down from the sky and kidnapped Tina. Master Higgins, who was passing by the castle, heard her cries for help, although without recognizing who it was... after being recruited by the king, Master Higgins begins a new adventure to rescue Tina, although he does not remember who she is!

game.name: Super Adventure Island
game.desc: In his first 16-bit adventure, Master Higgins goes on the trail of an evil sorcerer who has turned Tina, his girlfriend, into stone. Your mission is clear: you must begin a journey through the most diverse scenarios, looking for a way to undo the spell and recover Tina.

game.name: Super Alfred Chicken
game.desc: Alfred Chicken is a platform game where Alfred, a friendly chicken, must navigate strange scenarios with the goal of hitting all the balloons in each of them with his beak. It is a game with simple gameplay but high difficulty. Alfred can move and jump across stages to move, and also dive to hit enemies and activate switches. Throughout the scenarios we find objects that we can collect to earn points and advantages. The objective of each scenario is to find and hit a series of balloons with your pickaxe.

game.name: Super Baseball 2020
game.desc: The game follows the basic rules of baseball, but there are several improvements since the game takes place in the year 2020. The most obvious difference from real baseball is that some of the characters in this game are robots. All human characters are equipped with powerful armor, computer sensors, and jet-packs to enhance offensive and defensive abilities.

game.name: Super Baseball Simulator 1.000
game.desc: This is the ultimate baseball game! An accurate pitch, on-target hitting, and an impressive catch! Everything is under your control with simple and very sophisticated gameplay. With a lot of features. You will be an All Star! The baseball simulator you were dreaming of.

game.name: Super Bases Loaded 2
game.desc: Improving the experience offered by its predecessor, Super Bases Loaded 2 has simplified its gameplay, increasing the possibilities for fun. You'll be able to choose from 14 "real" teams named after the city they represent, plus four teams that you can create to your liking and include in the competition. The main mode allows you to choose how many games the season will consist of, from 13 to 162.

game.name: Super Bases Loaded 3 : License to Steal
game.desc: Play a full season with your favorite Major League Baseball players, licensed by the MLBPA, you will have 700 Major League Baseball players to choose from. By tracking a wealth of statistical data from STATS Inc., one of the most respected sports statistics companies, you'll know how your players perform over an entire season or during a game.

game.name: Super Bases Loaded
game.desc: Super Bases Loaded is the first installment for SNES of the famous series of baseball games from Jaleco, known in Japan as Super Professional Baseball. The game uses an unusual perspective for batting and pitching, and employs much more realistic players.

game.name: Super Batter Up
game.desc: All the excitement of the Major League! 3 stadiums, 26 teams and real Major League players to choose from. Choose your favorite team and play against a friend or play alone in season mode. Perfect game control puts you in the batter's box, on the pitcher's mound and anywhere on the baseball field.

game.name: Super Battleship
game.desc: Discover the thrill of leading your own naval fleet of warships with this new take on the classic sink the fleet game. Super Battleship gives you all the tough challenges of the original, plus a new arsenal of weapons and features. Travel on the high seas with graphics so realistic that newbies may get motion sickness. Fire your torpedoes, aim your cannons while listening to the roar of battle. A challenging campaign setting will test your skills in naval warfare strategy. Look for your hidden enemy before he finds you, but hide your fleet well, or it will end up sinking to the bottom of the sea!

game.name: Super Battletank 2
game.desc: Early in the morning, elements of the 24th Mechanized Infantry Battalion were ambushed and overwhelmed by a combined air and ground force, attacking in territory defined as neutral according to the recent ceasefire treaty. The data regarding the nationality of origin of the aggressor units is confusing; but it seems that these units are part of a new aggression by our former adversary. Your job will be to interrupt this escalation before the scope of hostilities expands. The peace and future of this region are in your capable hands. The armed command of our allies expects every man to do his duty.

game.name: Super Black Bass
game.desc: Compete in four exciting tournaments against the best anglers for the celebrated title of Super Bass Champion.

game.name: Super Bomberman 2
game.desc: Aliens, out to take over the world, have sent a team of evil cyborgs to take on the mighty Bomberman! Our hero fights valiantly in vain as the cyborgs, known as the Five Bad Bombers, manage to capture him. With Bomberman trapped in an underground prison, the aliens are free to carry out their evil plans without any opposition. But wait! Bomberman escapes and a gleam of hope shines for the universe! Bomberman must face hordes of enemies and countless traps scattered throughout the huge alien base. The future of the world is in your hands!

game.name: Super Bomberman 3
game.desc: The game, like the previous installments, is about making way, to defeat enemies by locking them in with Bombs. It was the first in the Saga to allow 5 Simultaneous Players in Battle. It can be mounted on a pet which can be found in eggs, its ability will depend on the color.

game.name: Super Bomberman
game.desc: Far north of Peace Town, Bomberman's home, lies Diamond City, a modern metropolis. There, the evil Carat Diamond and his accomplice, Dr. Mook, organize a Robot Tournament, using robots specially designed to have offensive and combat abilities. Diamond wishes to possess Bomberman's advanced combat capabilities; To this end, he designed a fake Bomberman, sending him to Peace Town to kidnap the real one. But Black Bomberman received information about Diamond's plans, and decided to face the imposter in an individual duel. Unfortunately, Black Bomberman was defeated, and his castle was destroyed. Somehow, Black Bomberman was able to escape; He quickly sought help from White Bomberman, informing him of Diamond's evil plans. Soon, countless waves of enemy robots began their advance towards Peace Town; Now our heroes must join forces in a desperate fight against the forces of evil.

game.name: Super Bonk
game.desc: The evil King Drool is back! After spending some time inactive, this villain has returned with new plans to dominate the world. Their hordes of fearsome monsters have invaded the entire planet, and this time, they have also occupied the moon! Bonk will have the responsibility on his shoulders... or on his head... to stop the invaders, and put an end to King Drool's lust for power.

game.name: Super Bowling
game.desc: Super Bowling offers the excitement of throwing the ball to knock down the pins, 4 characters available and each one has its own characteristics. Before launching, choose the weight of the ball, position the player and aim. In addition to the tournament mode, a "golf" mode is available. In the latter you have to knock down the pins with the fewest number of throws.

game.name: Super Buster Bros.
game.desc: Surely, as a child you always liked to pop bubbles or balloons of any size. Now you can do it again with Super Buster Bros., one of the most fun titles on the SNES! You will need a lot of skill and concentration to move your character between bubbles that will knock you out of combat just by touching you; You must eliminate them little by little until the screen is empty, and continue popping balloons as before. You have two game modes, Tour Mode and Panic Mode. In Tour Mode you must go from country to country, continent to continent, eliminating balloons; The difficulty will increase as you progress. How is that possible? There will be more and more platforms that prevent you from firing your harpoon, making your task more difficult; and more larger balloons, which when hit will divide into increasingly smaller ones, until they fill the screen. Panic Mode is really difficult and fun; As you pop more balloons you will increase the difficulty level. But keep in mind that the balloons won't stop falling, causing you to "Panic!" Here, items will be restricted to double shooting, stopping time, and a very helpful gold star. Remember that if you get Game Over the game ends, and you cannot continue; You must get lives by increasing your score.

game.name: Super Caesars Palace
game.desc: With over twelve games to choose from, you will experience the excitement, tension and nerves of casino gaming at the world famous CAESARS PALACE, without leaving home!

game.name: Super Castlevania IV
game.desc: Every 100 years, the forces of good mysteriously weaken. During this period, Dracula's power begins to resurface, becoming stronger and stronger. Dracula has been revived many times; However, his sinister actions have been constantly stopped by the Belmont family. 100 years have passed since the last confrontation, and now, the serenity of Transylvania is once again threatened by dark forces... It is the year 1691. On a dark and gloomy night, Dracula rose again from his grave, plunging the lands of Europe into a state of total darkness. The Count's legions grew like a plague, infesting the land like a disease wherever they went. Simon Belmont, great-grandson of Christopher Belmont, was the one who heard the people's cries; Armed with the legendary Vampire Killer whip, you will begin a journey towards Castlevania, the ancestral home of the Prince of Darkness. His mission is clear: send the Count back to his dark grave, in order to save the world from his torment.

game.name: Super Chase H.Q.
game.desc: Based on the classic Chase H. Q., you will experience police chases in an urban environment; Unlike other conversions, this game will place you inside the vehicle, in a perspective and gameplay taken from Super Chase: Criminal Termination. Basically, you must race against time to catch the criminal on duty, hitting his car with yours until one of you has to stop.

game.name: Super Conflict
game.desc: Super Conflict presents a Middle East theater of operations on various terrains in a war strategy game. Super Conflict places strategic control of ground, naval and air forces in the player's hands. There are 16 exciting scenarios in 2-player mode and 55 scenarios in 1-player mode. The 1-player mode also challenges you to 5 different levels of difficulty.

game.name: Super Copa
game.desc: All the excitement of fans who experience the intensity of football, in this title that uses the revolutionary Mode 7 graphics that give incredible rotation effects. Choose from 35 American and world teams in this game that combines action and game control. Pass, dribble, shoot... get your adrenaline running all over the field. But be careful with the defenders! They can go in hard. Center the ball for a header or a spectacular chilenita goal... and now your opponent has the ball: appease his fury, come in strong if necessary but regain possession of the ball. It's all here: the excitement, the energy, the roar of the crowd.

game.name: Super Dany
game.desc: Super Dany is a video game for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System that was released in 1994 exclusively in Europe. The game features Dany, a mascot of the food company Danone. It is a 2D platform game where the player controls Dany. He has to navigate through a medieval castle to defeat the villains. Finally, you enter a television station where the final stages of the game take place. The player can be hit three times before losing a life. The game is very basic with a score displayed and no time limit.

game.name: Super Double Dragon
game.desc: The two greatest martial arts heroes of all time have returned, in SUPER DOUBLE DRAGON, an all-new adventure with impressive new moves, new missions and a tough new cast of enemies! Marian, a beautiful policewoman, is a Kung Fu student and part-time assistant instructor at the martial arts school run by Billy and Jimmy Lee. The narcotics investigator has disappeared while trying to infiltrate a mafia gang known as the Black Shadow Warriors. You will need all your skill and wisdom to find and rescue Marian. Alone, or with the help of your brother, you must face the fearsome attack of the Shadow Warriors with the legendary power and ferocity of the DOUBLE DRAGON!

game.name: Super Ghouls'n Ghosts
game.desc:
All hail the great Arthur, the brave knight!
Years ago, you managed to exterminate the terrifying ghosts of the Ghoul Kingdom that had invaded the earth, and you rescued Princess Guinevere. Since then, you have traveled the length and breadth of this world, searching for powerful weapons imbued with White Magic.
But now, the kingdom has been engulfed in a chilling spell. Sardius, the Evil Emperor, has kidnapped Princess Guinevere, taking her to the musty crypts of the Phantom Zone. The Ghoul Kingdom has revived, and Undead Creatures ravage the land.
Once again, you must survive a dangerous journey into the depths of the Ghoul Realm. You will battle horrible ectoplasms and specters whose touch is deadly. Vampires will swarm around your head. You will be attacked by voracious plants, hungry for bones to crush. The earth will creak, the seas will churn, and you will find yourself surrounded by monsters of darkness.
Your courage and skill will allow you to continue advancing through unspeakable horrors. And along the way, a powerful weapon - Magic - awaits you!
Draw your sword, Arthur. It's time to start the mission!

game.name: Super Goal! 2
game.desc: Super Goal 2 is a soccer game with two game modes: Tournament and Exhibition, it has 20 international teams to choose from, including Germany, Brazil, Argentina and the USA just to name a few, plus players modeled after their real-life counterparts. Players can customize each match to their liking, including rule settings, stadiums, team formations, and even the design of the soccer ball. It features the rules and real soccer moves, including bikes and slides.

game.name: Super Godzilla
game.desc: In Super Godzilla, you control Godzilla with all his enormous power and ferocity and enjoy huge battles between monsters with deafening battle cries. The game has two modes: In motion mode, Godzilla moves destroying cities and crushing mountains. In battle mode, you fight one-on-one with enemy monsters. This game introduces a new combat system, as Godzilla attacks while watching the level of his and his enemy's fighting spirit. When Godzilla releases one of his main techniques, such as fire breath, the screen changes to a powerful animation.

game.name: Super High Impact
game.desc: This is not just American football, it's SUPER HIGH IMPACT! Super High Impact was one of the toughest American football games before the creation of the NFL Blitz series, with 18 teams and more than 30 plays per team. The console versions are based on Midway's arcade series of the same name. The game has a Hit-O-Meter that often leads to massive fights.

game.name: Super Ice Hockey
game.desc: This unofficially licensed ice hockey title allows up to 4 players to compete with country teams in tournaments or the Olympic Games. This title has the particularity of offering multiple points of view more or less distant from the action and available at any time by pressing the L button.

game.name: Super International Cricket
game.desc: From the swing of the cricket bat to the cheering crowd, this game has it all, even seagulls! Super International Cricket offers full selection of players and team positions on the field, a wide variety of batting and bowling styles, and a wide variety of playing options.

game.name: Super James Pond
game.desc: Fishy's dangerous plans for world domination continue... In a miserable attempt to sabotage the world's largest toy factories, he has planted penguin bombs in toy factories at the North Pole! James Pond bubbles to the rescue on another great ocean adventure!

game.name: Super Mario All-Stars + Super Mario World
game.desc: Mario's All-Star Magic Continues Relive the magic and fun of the classic Super Mario Bros. series on your Super NES! Play through Super Mario World, plus all the great Super Mario Bros. games for the NES have been enhanced with 16-bit graphics and sound and brought together in one super game pak. As an added bonus the previously unreleased "Lost Levels" are included. These super challenging courses have never been available in this country until now!
game.genre: Compilation-Platforms-Platforms / Run and Jump with scrolling

game.name: Super Mario All-Stars
game.desc: The playability of the games contained in this cartridge is maintained compared to the original versions, but in return they improve in the technical section, perhaps the one that has the least changes is Super Mario Bros 3, perhaps because the NES version already had a very good technical section. The one that includes the most innovations is Super Mario Bros 2, which included colored and animated introductions at the beginning of each level, an improved slot machine and of course the sound aspect. The most interesting title that the cartridge presents is undoubtedly Super Mario Bros: The Lost Levels as it is a game that never left Japan and which is the real Super Mario Bros 2, not the one that finally reached us in Europe and which has nothing to do with the style of play of the rest of the installments of the trilogy.

game.name: Super Mario Kart
game.desc:
Start your engines with the one and only Super Mario Kart, the fantastic game that started the saga that continues to rock!
Choose from eight characters from the Mushroom Kingdom, from the usual Mario and Bowser to others that appear exclusively like Donkey Kong Jr. Burn the asphalt on familiar circuits such as Mario Circuit, Bowser's Castle, Koopa Beach and the dreaded Rainbow Trail!
Race alone or with a friend, or challenge him in the original Battle mode, the two-player favorite.

game.path: ./Super Mario RPG - Legend of the Seven Stars (USA).zip
game.name: Super Mario RPG : Legend of the Seven Stars
game.desc:
The Mushroom Kingdom faces a new threat when a giant sword falls from the sky and wreaks havoc on the place. Mario must assemble a team of unexpected allies to take on the infamous Smithy Gang!
Before Paper Mario and Mario & Luigi, the first RPG featuring Mario was this celebrated collaboration between Nintendo and Final Fantasy creators Squaresoft (now Square Enix). Many players have fond memories of his witty dialogue and colorful characters like Mallow and Geno.
game.image: ./media/images/Super Mario RPG - Legend of the Seven Stars (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Super Mario RPG - Legend of the Seven Stars (USA).png

game.name: Super Mario World 2 : Yoshi's Island
game.desc: Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island is a game programmed and distributed by Nintendo for the Super Nintendo in 1995. The European version came out in October of that same year. Like the previous title, it is an excellent platformer from the same time, but with many modifications. The first of them is that in this title Mario is not the protagonist, but the dinosaur Yoshi. Also, we're not actually talking about a sequel, but rather we go back several years in the past, to when Mario is just a baby. The mechanics consist of Yoshi transporting baby Mario on his back through the different scenarios and preventing the child from ending up in the clutches of the bad guys. When we receive a hit, Mario will be thrown out in a kind of bubble and we will have time to pick him up. If we run out of time, they take it and we lose a life.

game.name: Super Mario World
game.desc: After saving the Mushroom Kingdom, Mario and Luigi go on vacation to Dinosaur Land, but Princess Toadstool disappears. They find a giant egg from which Yoshi hatches, who explains that his dinosaur friends are trapped by Bowser's evil turtles and his children, the Koopalings. Together they rescue Yoshi's friends, defeat the Koopalings and finally Bowser, saving the Princess and restoring peace to Dinosaur Land.

game.name: Super Metroid
game.desc: In the game we control Samus, with whom we will have to run through the different scenarios and kill the enemies. It also has a significant degree of exploration, because the settings are huge and labyrinthine, and we have to look for some objects that will provide us with important abilities that will allow us to continue advancing. Samus's initial abilities are limited to walking, shooting, jumping and running, but we can find others, such as turning into a ball and rolling on the floor, useful for passing through narrow corridors. In order not to get lost in each of the areas that we can travel, we have a useful map of the area, which we can consult at any time and that will mark the areas that we have already visited, and hiding the unpublished parts. Samus' suit has a series of slots where the objects that allow her to transform will be installed, which we will have to find in the scenarios.

game.name: Super Morph
game.desc: Before playing a scene of a boy outside his uncle's house takes place. Once the boy enters the house, a scientist allows the boy to test out his new machine that can allow him to change states. The machine works but something goes wrong and the machine explodes sending most of its parts everywhere. The boy must now use his new skills to go around all areas of his uncle's property and find all the missing teeth. When the game starts, the player has a choice of which area to start. The options are: Laboratory, Garden, Sewer or Factory. There are 9 levels in each stage, each one gets more difficult as you progress. There are also dangers to each of the ways it changes: the rubber ball will deflate when it touches the spikes, the rubber ball will burn when exposed to fire, the water droplet will sink into the liquid, and the cloud can be absorbed by amateurs. The objective for each level is to find a tooth that is hidden somewhere in the level. Once he has found all 36 teeth, Uncle can fix the machine and Morph can return to his normal form, a child.

game.name: Super Ninja Boy
game.desc: Super Ninja Boy combines classic role-playing game elements with action game elements. The player controls the main character Jack (or two players can control Jack and Ryu) and randomly encounters enemies on the world map and in dungeons. In side-scrolling battles, the player can jump, punch, throw enemies, use items like shurikens or techniques like the super jump or fireball. Battles take place in a beat'em up style and end after a specified number of enemies die (no matter how many remain on the screen). Boss battles are fought in a turn-based RPG style, using the same items and abilities as normally.

game.name: Super Nova
game.desc: The game follows the general trend of the saga by being a lateral martian killer that stands out for being able to choose between different paths and for its fish-shaped final bosses. But it also has some differences with respect to what was normal or usual in the series, one of the most important being the fact that we can choose between three different ships, one of them being the one that appeared in the first Darius, another of them the one that appeared in Darius II and the last a new ship that only exists in this game. Also the mapping to choose the route of the levels is very different from other games in the series. This map contains 15 phases, but we can only take the path up or forward until the player reaches level L, N or R. Each of these phases has its own final boss and its end, thus having three different endings.

game.name: Super Off Road : The Baja
game.desc: At all times we will see the car we are driving from the rear, and our objective will be to reach the finish line in the best possible position, if it is the first, the better. The game also shares with the first part that the circuits are tracks full of potholes, which will make our car bounce and jump without stopping, so it is advisable to control the car well so that it does not leave the track and does not collide with the elements of the road, which will lower the life bar of the vehicle. We also have the possibility of making our car run more with the help of the turbo.

game.name: Super Off Road
game.desc: We are faced with a driving game in isometric view where we already see the entire circuit, so there will be no scrolling of any kind. Our task will be to drive one of the four trucks participating in the race with the clear objective of reaching the finish line first on the last lap. The circuits will be full of potholes and ramps, and the more victories we have, the more money we will earn that we can spend on improving the truck, in addition to points that allow us to continue in the championship. While the original game has 8 circuits, this Super Nintendo version has 16.

game.name: Super Pinball : Behind the Mask
game.desc: The game presents us with three different tables, which we are going to see tilted in 3D, so that they fit on the entire screen, so it is not one of those Pnball-type games for a console with scrolling. As is usually the case, the tables are themed, with one based on clowns called "Jolly Joker", another on pirates known as "Blackbeard and Ironmen" and the third is based on sword and sorcery stories, called on this occasion "Wizard". The game, instead of being based on more modern pinball games, has a gameplay that seems to be based more on older pinball machines, being less imaginative, but no less fun.

game.name: Super Play Action Football
game.desc:
The objective of the game is to obtain the ball and reach the other end of the field to score a touchdown, while avoiding opposing players who may crowd the character possessing the ball.
If the opposing players manage to stack on the character holding the ball, the play stops and the team returns to the previous line. A quirk in the game allows the defensive player to get an easy sack if they dive with the nose tackle at the precise moment the ball breaks.

game.name: Super Probotector : Alien Rebels
game.desc: Super Probotector: The Alien Rebels is the third Super Nintendo episode of the Contra saga. The Red Falcon, who had been defeated in previous episodes by Bill & Lance's commandos, returns to take revenge by attempting to exterminate the human race. Two new "Terminators", RD008 and RC011, will do everything in their power to prevent this. You have a rifle with ammunition that changes depending on the bonuses collected and a special attack that destroys all enemies on the screen.

game.name: Super Punch-Out!!
game.desc:
Put on your gloves! Super-Punch Out!!, the Super Nintendo version of the classic boxing simulator, is here.
You will face your favorite rivals from the NES versions and arcade machines, and also many new opponents who stand in your way to become number 1 in the WVBA (World Video Boxing Association) rankings.
In championship mode you will fight against 16 rivals. To defeat them, you must learn their techniques and know their weak points. In addition, you can practice your skills by fighting against another fighter in time trial mode.
Its colorful graphics and engaging sound effects will leave you out of combat... Don't miss it!

game.name: Super Putty
game.desc: As in the sequel, our mission is to rescue a certain number of putties by controlling an amorphous mass capable of transforming into different things that will give us special abilities, all within a limited time. In addition to this ability of the protagonist, he can also generate a fist with which to hit the different enemies in his path, in addition to having the ability to jump, a basic ability in any good platform worth its salt.

game.name: Super R.B.I. Baseball
game.desc: Super RBI Baseball is a traditional baseball simulation game. The game is officially licensed by the Major League Baseball Players Association, featuring 700 baseball players from the 1994 Major League Baseball season plus 28 teams.

game.name: Super R-Type
game.desc:
In this Super Nintendo sequel to the R-Type arcade, you are the R-9 ship, the most advanced form of defense of the earth against the evil empire BYDO.
There are 7 levels that you must complete, acquiring power ups to defeat the bosses of each stage that have returned from the arcade versions of R-Type and R-type II.
Your R9 ship can also be linked with "FORCE", which are invincible units that surround your ship to protect you and also boost your attack.

game.name: Super Scope 6
game.desc: Super Scope 6 is a game pack for the Super Scope peripheral. The Super Scope 6 game's emphasis is on first-person shooting, using the Super Scope accessory required for aiming. It has a total of six game modes, classified as Blastris or LaserBlazer.

game.name: Super Shadow of the Beast
game.desc: The beast is among us! This is it - a new dimension in computer games! Loaded with incredible features: 50 frames per second with arcade-quality scrolling, 350 screens, 132 unique monsters, 13 parallax scrolling levels, 900K of emotional music and 2 MB of graphics compressed on two discs. A truly massive game!

game.name: Super Slam Dunk
game.desc: The game features 28 fictional teams; 27 of them are based on real cities, while the 28th. It's an all-star team. There is an exhibition and playoff mode. The exhibition is the usual game between two teams, while the playoff mode has eight teams competing to win the championship.

game.name: Super Slap Shot
game.desc: Super Shot Slap is an ice hockey game for the Super Nintendo. Two teams of five players compete, all sponsored by Gordie Howe. 32 international teams are available in exhibition or tournament mode. Sanctions are present, like small fights between players. Several statistics pages are available during matches.

game.name: Super Smash T.V.
game.desc: Each phase of the game consists of several static screens in which our hero, or our heroes if we play doubles, must destroy all the waves of enemies that enter through one of the four doors on each screen. Once we have eliminated everyone and obtained all the items we can, the protagonists will cross the door that takes them to the next room, where they will have to repeat the same mechanics until they reach a confrontation against the respective end-of-phase boss with a pattern that must be followed in order to destroy it. To do this, the game's protagonists are able to shoot in any direction thanks to their ability to rotate circularly.

game.name: Super Soccer Champ
game.desc: Conversion of a Taito arcade game that was released to coincide with the 1992 European Championship. The game scrolls horizontally at a slight angle. Only a small area of ​​the field is shown on screen at a time, but there is a scanner to show the entire field. Although the game has a referee, he often loses attention, and these moments give you the opportunity to commit fouls, punches or side hits. One and two player options included. With only 8 teams available, and 7 players per side, Super Soccer Champ was one of the first sports games on the SNES.

game.name: Super Soccer
game.desc: It is one of those typical soccer games in which the orientation of the field is vertical, with our goal being up or down, so to score we have to go up or down, but the view is not from above as in classic games like Kick Off or Italia 90, but rather it uses a unique perspective, because at all times we see the goal in the distance, and using mode 7 as we get closer it will enlarge, as if the camera were in the goal below. For the rest, the basic rules of football are followed, being able to make a good number of different plays, passes or different types of shots. The game modes available are the exhibition, where we play individual matches, the tournament and an exciting penalty shootout.

game.name: Super Solitaire
game.desc:
Solitaire variations in the game include: Klondike, FreeCell, Golf, Cruel, Pyramid, Stonewall, Dozen't Matter, Aces Up, Florentino, Poker, Canfield and Scorpion. Classic background artwork for each game is included along with optional comic book graphics. Soft music is included with each variation of the game.
Players can choose to get hints or even skip to the next card through a special options screen.

game.path: ./Super Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (USA).zip
game.name: Super Star Wars : Return of the Jedi
game.desc:
Before each level, choose your character from the movie (Luke Skywalker, Han Solo, Princess Leia or Chewbacca), as each one has different abilities. Try to overcome levels inspired by scenes from the movie, wielding lightsabers, blasters or crossbows, etc., depending on the character you have chosen.
The gameplay consists of classic platforming action with some slightly different sequences. Race to Jabba the Hutt's palace on a speeder bike, fight your way through his henchmen before taking him down, control speeder bikes and the Millennium Falcon, and much more.
game.image: ./media/images/Super Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Super Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (USA).png

game.path: ./Super Star Wars - The Empire Strikes Back (USA).zip
game.name: Super Star Wars : The Empire Strikes Back
game.desc: The style of the game is the same as in the first and third parts, so it is a horizontally scrolling platform and action game in which we have to advance with the characters we control through the different scenarios while we defeat the different enemies that confront us and at the end of each phase, which usually contain several levels, we face an end-of-phase boss. As in the other two installments, simulation levels are also interspersed, and for the first time in the Super Nintendo trilogy there are levels aboard the Millennium Falcon.
game.image: ./media/images/Super Star Wars - The Empire Strikes Back (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Super Star Wars - The Empire Strikes Back (USA).png

game.name: Super Star Wars
game.desc: At the beginning of the game, we can only control Luke Skywalker, although in more advanced stages we will have the possibility to control Han Solo and Chewbacca. Likewise, in these early phases Luke will not have either the lightsaber or the powers of the force. When we finally find Obi-Wan Kenobi and he gives us the lightsaber, Luke will be able to fight with both the gun and the sword, and little by little he will learn the powers of the force, which will be very useful to us throughout the adventure. The objective of each level will be to reach the end of the phase safely and finish off the respective final boss that we have to face. Another detail that stands out about this title is the great variety of levels it has, which include the typical platform and action phases and a kind of flight simulator for some levels.

game.name: Super Street Fighter II
game.desc: Super Street Fighter II is a sequel to Street Fighter II Turbo and Street Fighter II Championship. The game features four new characters and stages, making a total of sixteen playable. It also has many multiplayer modes in addition to the single player mode. Among them is the return of the Elimination Bracket Battle, where players compete for the title of champion, and Point Battle, where the person with the most points wins. The latest modes include an eight-man double elimination tournament and a challenge mode, where players try to score maximum points against a CPU opponent or beat them as fast as possible, trying to break records.

game.name: Super Strike Eagle
game.desc: The game consists of piloting aircraft testing the player's Sidewinder missile and machine gun firing skills against several non-aligned nations that were historically notorious for harboring extremist leaders during the Cold War.

game.name: Super Tennis
game.desc: Tennis game for SNES. Select from 20 available players, each with their own playing style, and play in "singles" or "doubles" modes against the machine or a friend on all major surfaces (clay, grass and hard court). The circuit mode is the "chicha" of the game. Using a password save system, you will be able to play a selection of tournaments around the world and climb the world tennis rankings. Enjoy up to 4 major tournaments and many more minor tournaments. The world tennis circuit awaits you!

game.name: Super Troll Islands
game.desc: Arcade platform video game. The Evil Lord has condemned the Troll Islands to constant darkness by using the powers of Fire, Water, Earth and Air to block out all light. Now, it's up to you and four Magical Trolls to bring the light back to the Troll Islands and defeat the Overlord. Choose from any of the four Trolls and adventure through 10 gigantic levels that will test all your Troll skills: run, jump, swim and even fight! Look for twists of color that will give you extra energy and custard pies that you can use as weapons. The fate of the Troll Islands is in your hands.

game.name: Super Turrican 2
game.desc: Super Turrican is back and once again the forces of the USS Freedom must stop the evil machine from harming innocent civilizations. This requires the player to jump and fight through large levels filled with enemies. To get rid of all enemies, several different weapons can be used, most of which are already known to players from previous installments of the series: a laser, a scatter shot and a (improved) ricochet. There is also the possibility of going into "wheel mode" for a limited time to be invincible, place mines and fire rockets. The flamethrower is new to the series, as is the rope, which can be used to climb walls, hold onto platforms, or pick up out-of-reach objects. Just like in side-scrolling shooters, you can now pick up homing missiles as secondary weapons.

game.name: Super Turrican
game.desc: Action and adventure video game. The allies of freedom must re-enter their "turrican" assault suits to push back the forces of "The Machine." Freely explore the large levels discovering all their secrets, use wisely the three weapons that the suit has to get rid of your enemies and find the secret capsules to reach inaccessible areas of the map. Does any enemy resist you? Turn the suit into an energy wheel that will make you invincible and you can even place mines to wreak havoc around you!

game.name: Super Valis IV
game.desc: Side-scrolling action video game. Once upon a time, there was a prince named Gallagher. He took charge of a magic ring that gave him great powers. But he was too weak to control the power of the ring, and was possessed by it. The mad prince was sealed in a crystal, but many years later he managed to escape, wreaking havoc on the Dream World and conquering it. Yuko, the heroine of the three previous ¨Valis¨ games, is no longer a sacred Valis warrior, she has become a goddess. Lena, a young woman who wants to become a Valis warrior, must test Yuko to see if she is worthy of wielding the sword of Valis, and stop Gallagher's evil plans.

game.name: Super Widget
game.desc: Snes platform video game based on the cartoon series “Widget”. Planet Earth is in danger and is full of villains who want to destroy the environment for their own nefarious purposes! Far away in the Horsehead Nebula, a group of aliens known as World Watchers are assigned planets to protect. A purple alien, Widget, is a trainee assigned with the task of protecting Earth, and he is accompanied by his intelligent companion, Mega Brain. Explore various worlds with Widget as you travel to Earth, collecting coins and power-ups with which to transform into a wide variety of different creatures, each with their own different ranged attacks. The Earth needs you!

game.name: Suzuka 8 Hours
game.desc: Classic motorcycle racing video game, uses Super FX technology for rotating graphics. You have at your disposal 3 different cylinder capacities (250cc, 400cc and 750cc) with which to race on the different circuits. Each circuit has five different variations, each with a level of difficulty. Accelerate, control the direction in the curves and achieve the maximum speed of the motorcycle to achieve the fastest lap. Master all the circuits and be the fastest in the world!

game.name: SWAT Kats : The Radical Squadron
game.desc: Platform and action video game based on the animated series S.W.A.T. Kats. Megavillains have disturbed the peace in the city of Megakat. Help the Swat Kats patrol defend law and order! The Swat Kats are a trio of mechanics by day, but they are also secretly a group of superheroes who defend their home, MegaKat City, from creatures and evil villains. Control T-Bone and Razor, and lead them through 5 different worlds based on episodes of the series. As you progress through the game, you will be able to increase the levels of your weapons and earn new ones. Choose the level you want to start playing on and beat all the villains.

game.name: Syndicate
game.desc: In the future, the world is controlled by a handful of global corporations (syndicates). You are the marketing director of one of these companies, and your job is not diplomacy, but brute force and physical control. Rise through the ranks of the corporation until you become the owner, successfully completing missions and managing the money you get from the controlled territories. You have missions that range from infiltration and capture of objectives, to searching and directly destroying. Control a team of four agents through different parts of the city, shooting anything that gets in your way. Modify your agents to equip them with new tools and weapons that you earn by controlling districts or investing in research.

game.name: Syvalion
game.desc: Arcade shooter video game. It's a world full of mazes with enemies around every corner and time is running out. Use the dragon's fire breath to destroy the giant enemy mechs. Follow your path...and? Who knows what will happen? Syvalion is a story that develops depending on the course you take and the result is unpredictable. You have two game modes: first learn to play in the basic series, and then test all your skills in the real combat series. You have a multiple scenario system, each game will follow a different path!

game.name: T2 : The Arcade Game
game.desc: Like any good game of this style, our mission will be to aim and shoot at almost everything that moves on the screen, and I say almost everything because destroying certain elements will penalize us, such as killing members of the resistance in the first levels or killing innocent people. Naturally, throughout the game we will obtain more and better weapons that will help us in our mission to destroy the enemies, in addition to the fact that dangerous final bosses await us that require a certain strategy, as well as there are certain areas in which protecting some element is more important than destroying the enemies, such as the part in which you have to protect a car so that it is not destroyed by enemy shots.

game.name: Taz-Mania
game.desc: The objective of each level will be to eat the maximum amount of yellow chicks that we can in a set time, while we worry about avoiding the various obstacles that we can find on the road. These will be cars, which can run over us, or the posts on both sides of the road, which we can crash into. As we complete levels, the game will become increasingly more difficult, with the appearance of new enemies, such as a Tasmanian devil who tries to trap us to force us to marry her. If it reaches us, the game is over.rn

game.name: Tecmo Secret of the Stars
game.desc: Secret of the Stars uses an RPG turn-based battle system where actions in battle are selected through a menu and actions are presented at the end of the turn. The game switches between two parts throughout the game and certain areas are inaccessible without the right part.

game.name: Tecmo Super Baseball
game.desc: Tecmo Super Baseball is a professional baseball video game released in 1994. It features all 28 MLB teams that existed at the time. However, the only license the game has is the MLBPA license. This means that while the game features real players, there are no team names or logos. Teams wear uniforms without logos and are only named after their city.

game.name: Tecmo Super Bowl II : Special Edition
game.desc: Choose your favorite NFL team with its current roster of real players, then apply your football knowledge and gaming skills to lead your team through the regular season and playoffs, in the final game.

game.name: Tecmo Super Bowl III : Final Edition
game.desc: Each team has a playbook of eight passed plays and eight running plays, any of which can be changed and another put in place in the middle of a game. It also includes some of the most nuanced strategies in football, like attempting two-point conversions. It more closely resembles the realistic "TV-style" presentation of modern football games such as the Madden series. After a big offensive play, or a turnover or sack on defense, a box would appear on the screen with a small grayscale image of the player involved along with their current stats for the game.

game.name: Tecmo Super Bowl
game.desc: It's fun! It's competitive! It's real football! rnrnTecmo Super Bowl is, without a doubt, the best football game you will ever play. Use your favorite NFL team, real NFL players and your football skills to experience the ultimate football. Use your football knowledge and gaming skills to lead your favorite NFL team of real NFL players through the football season and win the Super Bowl.

game.name: Tecmo Super NBA Basketball
game.desc: Players can choose between the exhibition games, the 1992 All-Star Game, or the 1993 season. When playing the season, players can choose which teams they want to control; For example, a player can choose to play as two teams, and will play every game that the two teams play.

game.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles : Tournament Fighters
game.desc: The combats also take place one against one and with a predetermined time, but the style is completely different, despite sharing some common characteristics. The first point is that apart from the four turtles, most of the characters that we can handle are different, although some characters have a certain similarity, despite being different. For example, I see similarities between the character of April O'Neal and that of the ninja Aska. The game has three basic game modes. We have tournament mode, story mode and versus mode. The story mode and the tournament are very similar, but they have different objectives. While in the story mode we can only choose between the four turtles and we fight with a very simple plot thread, of course, the objective of the tournament is purely material. It is supposed to be an event organized by the television channel where April O'Neal works, so the tournament host will be the intrepid reporter. The prize for the winner will be glory and money. On the other hand, there is the versus mode, in which we will have battles against a friend until we get bored.

game.path: ./Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles IV - Turtles in Time (USA).zip
game.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles IV : Turtles in Time
game.desc: Like the arcade machine, in this version of "The Brain of the Beast" we can choose between the four turtles to face the different phases. In this way, we will advance with selected turtles, turtles if we play in two-player mode, through the different scenarios while we hit the enemies that approach us. As in any self-respecting beat'em up, at the end of each level we will have to face the final enemy of the phase, all of them taken directly from the cartoon series.
game.image: ./media/images/Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles IV - Turtles in Time (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles IV - Turtles in Time (USA).png

game.name: Terminator 2 : Judgment Day
game.desc: The game shows a wide variety of situations, and we will also not only have control of the charismatic Terminator, because in the first levels we will control a soldier from the future who must send the Terminator to the past, after reprogramming him (in the form of a puzzle-type level of connecting pipes). From that moment we can use the cyborg. In essence it is a side action game in which we must eliminate everything that moves on the screen to face an end-of-phase boss at the end of each level. and also present varied styles, such as that puzzle-type phase mentioned above or one in which, riding a motorcycle, we must destroy a truck that is chasing us.rn

game.name: Terranigma
game.desc: Terranigma is an action role-playing video game developed by Quintet in 1996 for the Super Nintendo. The story of Terranigma invites us to take on the role of a young man named Ark, who lives peacefully in Crysta, his town, and who will suddenly find himself with a heroic mission: to revive what for him is the surface world, which will turn out to be nothing less than the planet Earth, as we know it.

game.name: Tetris & Dr. Mario
game.desc: The two greatest puzzle games are now together in one exciting game package. TETRIS: The relentless block puzzler is back and improved for Super NES. Play alone, with a friend or challenge one of three computer opponents in this exciting and addictive game! DR. MARIO: The nasty viruses are back. Dr. Mario, vitamin pills in hand, is ready to take them out once again. In addition to the popular 2-player game, you can now challenge the computer in the Blue, Yellow or Red Virus costume. Combine Tetris and Dr. Mario and what do you get? An exciting contest for 2 players! Race against the clock to take out your opponent while playing Tetris and Dr. Mario!

game.name: Tetris 2
game.desc: As in the original game, our mission is to place the different pieces to form lines, but it has many differences, the first of which is that the pieces are no longer all tetromino-shaped and that now we do not have to make lines but rather grouping colored squares thanks to the blocks formed by colored squares that descend from above (some of which have the shape of an irregular totromino). The objective of each level is to eliminate the initial colored blocks at the bottom of the screen, which also shine so that we realize which ones they are. The idea seems to me to be a kind of mix of traditional Tetris with Columns. We have several game modes that include the main mode in which you have to overcome levels, a versus mode against a second player and a puzzle mode in which you have to eliminate the boxes at the bottom in a limited number of moves.

game.name: Tetris Attack
game.desc: The game consists of aligning a minimum of three blocks of the same type, both horizontally and vertically. For this we can move two blocks. When we get a line, the blocks that form it disappear, allowing those on top to fall, which can cause new lines. Furthermore, at the same time more blocks will appear at the top of the screen, causing the set of blocks to go up, and if they reach the top we will lose the game. It should also be noted that depending on the number of lines we make at a time or how long a line is, they will give us different types of rewards, such as no more blocks appearing at the bottom for a short time. Apart from all this, we must highlight the various game modes that we have, among which are the two-player mode, the endless mode, a story mode and some more.

game.name: The 7th Saga
game.desc: The player chooses one of seven playable characters, all of whom separately embark on a quest to locate seven magical runes. As the player progresses through the game from one city to the next, they will encounter the other six characters on multiple occasions. The player can team up with one of the other playable characters to fight as a team, and they can also fight other playable characters for runes.

game.name: The Addams Family : Pugsley's Scavenger Hunt
game.desc: Inspired by the crazy world of the Addams Family, this game puts you in the shoes of Pugsley, the son of Gomez and Morticia. Several family members were taken prisoner in the mansion and it's up to you to find them and free them. It is also possible to explore the parts in any order!

game.name: The Addams Family
game.desc: The Addams Family is a platform game. The story takes place towards the end of the Addams Family movie, when the family is evicted from their mansion by a jealous lawyer. As if that weren't enough, we learn that Morticia, Pugsley, Wednesday and the others have disappeared! So you play as Gómez, who must search for his family and defeat all his enemies until he reaches the last one: the lawyer!

game.name: The Adventures of Batman & Robin
game.desc: The Adventures of Batman and Robin is an action and platform game where you control the masked vigilante of Gotham in a series of missions in which he will encounter his greatest enemies. It's your turn to undo his plans by fighting his minions with your gadgets.

game.name: The Adventures of Dr. Franken
game.desc: The Adventures of Dr. Franken is a standard platformer where the player navigates platforms and avoids enemies. Touching too many enemies results in death. To defeat himself, Franky has the ability to defeat enemies. The objective of each level is to find a package that is hidden in it. To reach it Franky also has to solve the switch puzzle. There are 20 levels, including four bonus levels. The game is a standard 2D-Platformer and has enough levels, but it gets a little boring, but it gets harder every level you go.

game.name: The Adventures of Kid Kleets
game.desc: In the platform game also known in Europe as Soccer Kid, you must try to get the 1994 World Cup trophy that the aliens have stolen. You can eliminate enemies by throwing your ball. The adventure will take you through different countries, starting with England. The child must have 11 cards in each country in order to find the trophy pieces.

game.name: The Adventures of Mighty Max
game.desc:
The Adventures of Mighty Max is based on the television cartoon Mighty Max, which in turn is based on a series of toys. Max is a boy who has a magic hat that allows you to travel through different worlds and save people who get into trouble in other dimensions. But his archenemy, the demonic Skull Master, has recently blocked all the portals that Max used for inter-dimensional travel. However, the Skull Master has kept some of the portals to himself, keeping some of his destructive weapons there. It's time to destroy those weapons and stop Skull Master!
This is a platformer where you control Max himself or one of his two sideshots (which has no bearing on gameplay). You travel through several different worlds. Your goal is to find Skull Master's weapons, which are scattered around the level, and destroy them. The levels are timed, and there are also plenty of enemies that will bother you on your way to the goal.

game.path: ./Adventures of Rocky and Bullwinkle and Friends, The (USA).zip
game.name: The Adventures of Rocky and Bullwinkle and Friends
game.desc: The Adventures of Rocky and Bullwinkle and Friends is a platform game based on the cartoon universe of the same name. Boris and Natasha have taken valuables from the Frostbite Falls museum and our two heroes must stop it. In addition to the platform levels, several mini-games appear in the adventure, while other characters from the series make an appearance.
game.image: ./media/images/Adventures of Rocky and Bullwinkle and Friends, The (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Adventures of Rocky and Bullwinkle and Friends, The (USA).png

game.name: The Blues Brothers
game.desc: The biggest rock 'n' roll game is about to begin: THE BLUES BROTHERS! Travel alongside Jake and Elwood in this platform game with an explosive mix of adventure, comedy and music. Back by popular demand, The Blues Brother are prepared to win once again, with their usual optimistic rhythm they must recover the stolen instruments, but it will not be easy. You have to escape the prison, swim through the catacombs, and shoot across the rooftops of the big city before they can start the concert. Get ready to play some blues!

game.name: The Brainies
game.desc: The new puzzle game that comes ready to take away hours of your sleep. Brainies are round, fluffy monsters who live only to create universal chaos and disorder. Your only weapon is your brain: you can only neutralize them by placing them on their pillows to sleep. They will drive you crazy from the start, their antics will definitely give you a good headache. Squeeze your brain to overcome it. The Brainies are waiting for you.

game.name: The Chessmaster
game.desc: Chessmaster is one of the best chess simulators, a great option for chess players, since it was a genre that was not very popular on consoles.

game.name: The Combatribes
game.desc: The Combatribes have arrived in New York City, the center of all evil in the United States. A rumor has reached them about a mysterious organization known as Ground Zero... which, apparently, has control of the street gangs of America. Berserker, Bullova and Blitz will head to the most dangerous neighborhoods to confront several of these gangs, in a quest to obtain information that will guide them to the leader of Ground Zero.

game.name: The Death and Return of Superman
game.desc: Without warning, a ruthless being called Doomsday has begun to wreak havoc on the population. Its advance causes a trail of unprecedented destruction, leaving in its wake million-dollar damage and hundreds of dead and injured. Not even the combined power of the Justice League is enough to stop him; The team has been wiped out, and Superman rises as the only hero capable of stopping the monster's advance toward Metropolis.

game.name: The Duel : Test Drive II
game.desc: In this sequel to Test Drive, you can play against the timer or against the computer. Choose between a Ferrari F-40, a Porsche 959 or a Lamborghini Diablo, choose your opponent and... floor it, avoiding the traffic!

game.name: The Firemen
game.desc: We find an action game where we control a firefighter and his assistant Pete and Daniel. On Christmas Eve, a fire breaks out in the Metrotech skyscraper, a company dedicated to the manufacturing of chemical products. Due to the chemicals, what initially started as a small fire slowly spreads throughout the skyscraper. Unfortunately, the tower was not empty. Just that night, Metrotech will celebrate the typical Christmas party, so the employees have been trapped in the flames. Veteran Pete and young Daniel, along with the rest of the team, must put out the fire and rescue the employees. The operation must be done in a critical time, since the building is about to collapse due to the fire. Can our heroes save all the employees and put out the fire?

game.path: ./Flintstones, The - The Treasure of Sierra Madrock (USA).zip
game.name: The Flintstones : The Treasure of Sierra Madrock
game.desc:
We will have to travel through 5 different worlds in the purest style of the series, where we will control Pedro Flintstone and Pablo Marble through phases with various enemies.
The objective of the game is to reach a chest before the others, where we will find a treasure. To achieve this, our protagonists will have to overcome a challenge at the end of each world: a race by car, on foot, on skates, etc. We will advance through the scenarios by throwing a die from 1 to 3 each turn. On the way we will meet their wives, Betty and Wilma, who do not agree with this adventure, and therefore they will take us to the exit. There are also mini-game phases, in which we can participate by paying some coins that we will obtain in the levels, killing the enemies or we will simply collect them without having to do anything. These coins have another use, in each world there are several stores where we can buy items to recover. In the phases we can get stars, whose usefulness is to give us one life for every 100 that we collect.
game.image: ./media/images/Flintstones, The - The Treasure of Sierra Madrock (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Flintstones, The - The Treasure of Sierra Madrock (USA).png

game.name: The Flintstones
game.desc: In this game we will have to control the friendly Pedro Flintstone, who must advance through each of the scenarios, jumping from platform to platform and facing the various enemies that we will encounter. To deal with these enemies, Pedro is equipped with a club with which he can hit them, although we can also throw objects at the enemies, although ammunition is limited. To climb the platforms, in most cases you have to hold on to the projections, having to stand close to it.

game.path: ./Great Circus Mystery Starring Mickey & Minnie, The (USA).zip
game.name: The Great Circus Mystery Starring Mickey & Minnie
game.desc: Game starring Mickey and Minnie Mouse. They had planned to spend the day together at the circus, but when they arrive they find it abandoned. They will try to solve this mystery by looking for clues about the disappearance of the artists, among them are their friends, Donald Duck and Pluto.
game.image: ./media/images/Great Circus Mystery Starring Mickey & Minnie, The (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Great Circus Mystery Starring Mickey & Minnie, The (USA).png

game.name: The Great Waldo Search
game.desc: The Great Waldo Search is an observation game, based on the famous Where's Waldo cartoons, where the objective is to find Wally, the man with glasses, hat, striped sweater and his dog. To do this, move a magnifying glass across the screen and you will have to click where you think you have found Wally.

game.name: The Humans
game.desc: It is a puzzle-style game very similar to the mythical Lemmings. In each level we have a certain number of cavemen who must cooperate to achieve the objectives of each phase. At the beginning of each level we are told the minimum number of humans to complete the corresponding scenario. The missions in each phase usually consist of collecting a specific utensil, killing a certain number of dinosaurs, or taking at least one caveman to the end point of the level, which is marked in red. To do this we must use all the means at our disposal, taking into account that we can only control one at a time, but that we can switch from one to the other whenever we want. In each level there are up to a total of eight cavemen to use, except in some where they are reduced to three.

game.name: The Hunt for Red October
game.desc: Based on the Spanish-language film Red October, the Soviet Union has been secretly building a Typhoon-class submarine with nuclear strike capability. This war machine has been named Red October. During some tests, the captain, Marko Ramius, has hijacked the submarine along with his crew. They plan to defect to the United States. Naturally, such a weapon must not be allowed to fall into American hands, so orders are issued among Soviet forces to destroy Red October. You will control Red October during its escape. The Red October submarine can move in any direction. The A button fires torpedoes horizontally to the right and the B button fires missiles vertically, upward. Additionally, the Caterpillar (invisibility) unit can be activated for short periods of time. You can also activate an ECM blast, which will destroy all nearby offensive weapons. On the screen at all times there are health and fuel indicators.

game.name: The Ignition Factor
game.desc: The Ignition Factor is a 2D adventure where the player controls a firefighter (apparently "you") through emergency situations in different locations. Each level consists of several rooms, areas, or possibly building floors, where players can explore, extinguish fires, and save people. Most levels dictate a specific number of people that have to be saved within a certain time frame for the mission to be considered a success. Fire automatically spreads in an area, and the player can be damaged by touching a piece of fire on the screen. The player can also be damaged by falling through holes in the floor.

game.name: The Incredible Crash Dummies
game.desc: You're going to go crazy with this fun crash game. With avalanches of laughter on the ski slope, on the boulevard bouncing after a somersault or with the explosive humor of compressed air bags. The Dummies may be missing some screws... But they won't hesitate to break into pieces to make you laugh.

game.name: The Incredible Hulk
game.desc: Based on the adventures of the green giant Hulk. We travel through five levels, jumping over platforms and buildings, while we search for The Leader. At the end of each level we find a villain to defeat. When he is too weakened by the attacks of his enemies, he becomes Bruce Banner, without the strength of the Hulk and very vulnerable to the attacks of the enemies.

game.name: The Irem Skins Game
game.desc: Golf game with four different game modes. The four game modes are Skins, Match play, Stroke play and Tournament. In Skins mode players compete for prizes on each individual hole. In Match Play 2 golfers compete to see who can win the most 9 holes or 18 holes. Stroke play, this is the way in which the game is rated by the total number of strokes over the course of a game of golf. The golfer with the fewest strokes wins. In Tournament Mode players compete in one day (18 holes) or two days (36 holes) of golf. The score is calculated by the number of strokes a golfer has taken to finish a hole.

game.name: The Itchy & Scratchy Game
game.desc: The Itchy and Scratchy Game is a video game starring The Simpsons cartoon stars Itchy and Scratchy. The video game consists of passing the different levels killing enemies. Both characters carry a sledgehammer as their main weapon, although they can also use the different elements of the levels as secondary weapons. From time to time, Scratchy will appear on the screen attacking. Once Scratchy's life runs out, a level boss will appear in his place.

game.path: ./Jetsons, The - Invasion of the Planet Pirates (USA).zip
game.name: The Jetsons : Invasion of the Planet Pirates
game.desc: Based on the animated series The Jetsons, we will have to manage the famous animated character through various scenarios, which we have to go through with a certain degree of exploration to finally face the boss of the respective level. To combat the enemies we have a vacuum cleaner, which we can use to suck up blocks and then throw them at the enemies or to directly grab the enemies. In addition, we can also use the vacuum cleaner to hold on to the walls or the ceiling, which is useful to reach certain areas and even mandatory if we want to move forward.
game.image: ./media/images/Jetsons, The - Invasion of the Planet Pirates (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Jetsons, The - Invasion of the Planet Pirates (USA).png

game.name: The Jungle Book
game.desc:
Based on the famous animated film, Walt Disney's The Jungle Book is a platform game in which you control Mowgli, the boy who was raised by wild animals in the depths of the jungles. Their goal is to find the human village so they can join their kin once again.
Mowgli is an athletic individual, and can jump, run, swing on vines or climb them without any problem. Most of the animals you face, however, are inexplicably hostile, so you must defend yourself with a variety of thrown weapons, such as bananas and boomerangs.
To complete each level, Mowgli must collect a series of crystals within a time limit. A compass in the corner of the screen helps you by showing the direction where the nearest crystal is.

game.name: The Lawnmower Man
game.desc:
The Lawnmower Man, known in Japan as Virtual Wars, combines 2D side-by-side action with 3D sequences. Based on the movie of the same name, the game allows you to choose between Dr. Angelo and Carla Parkette, who must face Jobe, the main antagonist.
The 2D stages are reminiscent of Contra, where the protagonists advance through levels full of enemies while collecting items and data disks. By accumulating enough disks, you obtain the Virtual Suit, which protects against an enemy hit. The objective is to reach the exit point and activate it to advance.
After each 2D level, the game switches to a first-person perspective with automatic movement. In these 3D phases, the player must avoid columns and obstacles to minimize damage. The combination of both mechanics offers a unique experience, fusing classic action with immersive virtual reality sequences.

game.name: The Legend of the Mystical Ninja
game.desc: The Legend of the Mystical Ninja, released in 1991 for the Super Nintendo, is an action-platform game that follows the adventures of two heroes, Goemon and Ebisumaru, as they travel through a world inspired by feudal Japan and mythology. Players must face enemies, solve puzzles, and overcome levels full of traps and challenges. The game combines action and role-playing elements with a variety of special abilities, weapons and powers. With vibrant graphics and two-player cooperative gameplay, The Legend of the Mystical Ninja offers an entertaining, action-packed experience in a colorful and challenging environment.
game.genre: Platforms / Run and Jump with movement-Platforms

game.path: ./Legend of Zelda, The - A Link to the Past (USA).zip
game.name: The Legend of Zelda : A Link to the Past
game.desc: On a dark and stormy night, young Link embarks on an adventure that neither of them will forget. Princess Zelda has been kidnapped and an evil wizard wants to free Ganon, the king of darkness. Only Link can save Hyrule!
game.image: ./media/images/Legend of Zelda, The - A Link to the Past (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Legend of Zelda, The - A Link to the Past (USA).png

game.name: The Lion King
game.desc:
Do you think you want to be King? Be realistic. You're starting life as Simba the cub. To survive and become a powerful adult lion, you must perfect your savage attack, reckless roar, and all-four-legged fighting mastery. If you survive the challenge, you will become a strong and fierce adult lion.
So get ready to scrap with hyenas. Explosion through an elephant graveyard. Fight an in-your-face stampede of trampling wildebeests. And you better stop hanging out with slackers like Timon and Pumbaa, unless you want to be bothering bugs for the rest of your life!
