Are you sure you want to be king? Then it's time to break free in the deadliest fight in history. Defeat your evil uncle Scar. Take back the Pride Lands. And claim your rightful place in the Circle of Life.

game.name: The Lost Vikings
game.desc: In the game we control three Vikings who have different abilities. On the one hand we have Erik, who is the leader of the group and has the skills to jump and knock down walls with headbutts. The second Viking is Olaf, who carries a shield that allows him to stop enemies and their attacks and, if he puts the shield on his head, he can also glide for a few seconds like a feather and be used by Erik to jump over something. Last but not least is Baleog, who is armed with a bow and a sword. Both weapons can be used to kill enemies, and the bow can also activate switches that are out of reach. Using the skills of the three Vikings intelligently, we have to make our way through varied scenarios to reach the end of each level, which is indicated with a sign that says Exit. The number of players ranges from one to three.

game.name: The Magical Quest Starring Mickey Mouse
game.desc: The objective of each level will be to advance through each of the levels while avoiding enemies and traps along the way, with the sole purpose of reaching the end of the path, although naturally before being able to conclude the level we have to face a boss that requires a different strategy. For this, Mickey has some basic movements, which are jumping and grabbing things. With jumps we can kill enemies, although most require more than one jump to be killed. Others will be stunned with the first jump, and we can take advantage of those moments to grab them. The things we have holding can be used to throw at the bad guys, but if it is an enemy we have caught we have to hurry to do it, because after a while they regain consciousness and can hit us. One of the most original details of the game are Mickey's costumes, which are three in total and give him special abilities. The wizard costume allows him to breathe underwater, control a flying carpet, and shoot magic at enemies, although this empties the mouse's power bar. The firefighter costume allows you to shoot water, which can be used to attack enemies, put out fires, and form ice blocks, but this also empties the power bar. Lastly, the mountaineer costume lets you use a grappling hook to defeat bad guys or grab onto ledges.

game.name: The Mask
game.desc:
The mask is based on the movie with the same name. The story follows poor boy Stanley Ipkiss who finds a mysterious mask and is given mysterious powers.
Like in the movie, Stanley (aka The Mask) has some fun weapons, like the Guns, the Horn, the Hammer, and the ability to transform into a big Tornado. Fight through levels inspired by the movie, including your apartment, city streets, bank, park, jail and nightclub for the final showdown.

game.name: The Miracle Piano Teaching System
game.desc: The Miracle Piano Teaching System teaches piano beginners/intermediates using a combination of scripted lessons, dynamically created lessons, and piano-themed video games. The original version came with a custom piano keyboard. Later versions work with any MIDI keyboard.

game.name: The Pagemaster
game.desc: Richard Tyler went to the library and, without eating or drinking it, found himself involved in an incredible adventure. Join Richard in this battle through three super challenging worlds, with a total of thirteen levels, and defeat the platoon of strange fictional characters. Your skill will be tested in any of the worlds; the World of Terror, the World of Adventures or the World of Fantasy, in the attempt to conquer The Pagemaster! Please note that The Pagemaster is compatible with the Super Game Boy adapter for playing on the Super Nintendo.

game.name: The Peace Keepers
game.desc:
Through the damage and ignorance caused by the economic wars of 2011, a company rose like the Phoenix from the ashes of oblivion. This company appeared as the savior of the planet.
In 2015, the Deutchland Moldova Corporation purchased practically all of the most valuable land on the planet. Calling for revitalization, a man named Trip Iago designed a path that would return us to peace and prosperity.
Blending technology and medicine, TM Corporation found new ways to combine biology and nanotechnology. Within a few years, they practically owned the world.
But if power corrupts, absolute power corrupts much more than expected. Mr. Iago began to have a different vision of what HIS world should be. Through a project that created the first sentient artificial life form, DM gained power the likes of which the world had never seen.
Soon, DM focused his efforts on biogenetic research. Most of the research was carried out in secret, but the lives of a few people were touched by this experimentation. Before long, it became clear that DM's intentions couldn't be good at all.
With rumors of super beings circulating throughout what was left of the free world, the planet was getting closer and closer to depending on a decision. And few people wanted to make that decision...
Opposing DM required much more than courage. It required having a great sense of justice, and a strong motivation... some found their motivation in the damage DM had caused to their lives. While Echo and Flynn decided to seek justice for the deaths of their loved ones, Al wanted to put an end to the experiments, to avoid continuing to lose the people in his care. Prokop, on the other hand, sought to rescue his sister Amy, kidnapped by DM's people. Thus, these brave men would cross their destinies, supporting each other to achieve their goals...

game.name: The Pirates of Dark Water
game.desc: Based on a cartoon series of the same name, The Pirates of Dark Water is a side-scrolling fighting game similar to Final Fight or Streets of Rage. The player chooses a character, between Prince Ren and his two companions Tula and Ioz, who differ in strength and agility, but who use the same basic attacks. There are two attack buttons, one for quick attacks and combos and one for a single heavy attack. Other controls include: blocking attacks, grabbing and throwing opponents, and a special attack that hits multiple enemies consuming life energy at the same time. Most levels also require you to avoid obstacles such as chasms, falling stones, or spikes sticking out of the ground.

game.name: The Ren & Stimpy Show : Buckeroo$!
game.desc: Stimpy invents the Gametron 5000 Moneymaker, which is the world's first video game machine that rewards the player with money. Ren, who is always on the lookout to get rich, eagerly comes to play with the video game system in the quest to make lots of money.rnrnIn the game, you control Ren & Stimpy through several side-scrolling levels that are based on different episodes of the cartoon show. The episodes the levels are based on are Space Madness, Out West, and Robin Hoek.

game.name: The Ren & Stimpy Show : Fire Dogs
game.desc: Based on the Nickelodeon cartoon, Fire Dogs was one of the episodes of the first season of the game. You start as Stimpy the kitten who has to search through the different levels of a fire house, finding these objects to advance: a helmet, hose, pair of socks, rope, trampoline, uniform and a beaver! They all have to be placed on a fire truck before time runs out. You can jump, climb ladders and fire bars, and grab objects while avoiding or putting out fires with water and avoiding a fast firefighter who paints you like a Dalmatian to avoid being ejected.

game.name: The Ren & Stimpy Show : Time Warp
game.desc: In The Ren & Stimpy Show: Time Warp the player takes command of the comic duo on a quest through time to stop the beloved Stimpy hero, Muddy Mudskipper, from changing history and ruining space and time.rnrnThe game is a side-scrolling platform game where the player takes command of a spaceship through time portals between stages. There are five stages to play: the backyard, the Big City, the Untamed World, a zoo and a haunted house using various crazy weapons like beaver saws and watermelon bows to defeat the enemies and there are also items to help them in their quest such as rubber nipples which are used to climb walls.

game.name: The Ren & Stimpy Show : Veediots!
game.desc: Veediots! Allows the player to experience four classic episodes of the Ren & Stimpy Show. One is the episode, "He Boy Who Cried Rat", where the player takes control of Ren, who is dressed as a mouse, in which he has to reach the end of a house, avoiding obstacles and enemies, as well as Stimpy. Towards the end of this stage, the player must travel through Stimpy's mouth to complete the stage while avoiding various pitfalls and obstacles. The second episode is "In the Army" where the player once again takes control of Ren as they travel through an army base, beating up enemies, including soldiers, avoiding various bugs and using various objects scattered throughout the stage to advance. The third episode is "Stimpy's Invention", where the player takes control of Stimpy as they must escape from an insane laboratory by avoiding traps and enemies and collect items to complete the "Happy Helmet" and use it on Ren in order to complete the stage. The final stage is "Marooned" where the player takes control of Stimpy and is swallowed by a giant alien and must avoid several enemies as he falls down the giant alien's throat. Once Stimpy lands in the stomach, the player must reach the end of the level, attacking enemies and avoiding acid pits to reach the end of the stage.

game.name: The Rocketeer
game.desc: Based on the original comic series by Dave Stevens and the Walt Disney Company film. Take part in several action sequences that mimic the same sequences in the film, such as racing a plane, a shootout in a warehouse, and hand-to-hand combat on top of a flying blimp.

game.name: The Shadow
game.desc: The Shadow was once a vicious criminal captured by a mystic and taught the powers of the mind. He became the enemy of evil. Now, donning his sweeping cape and costume, The Shadow faces his most dangerous enemy yet; The last descendant of the great Genghis Khan. Join the fight and with your help, The Shadow will emerge victorious. The Shadow was a canceled SNES game published by Ocean. It is based on the film of the same name. It is currently available for download.

game.name: The Simpsons : Bart's Nightmare
game.desc: One night, while doing his homework, Bart fell asleep. The window was open and before he knew it, the wind had blown away all his work. "...Or was it a dream? That doesn't matter!" Bart thought, and jumped out of the window to recover the lost pages (brave, because his bedroom is on the second floor). "It may be a dream..." Every time he jumped on one of the pages, he found himself facing doors that took him on a crazy adventure. "Not bad, but I have to focus on getting my work together...or there will be consequences!"

game.name: The Smurfs Travel the World
game.desc: It has just gotten dark in the Smurfs' village. Two elusive shadows stealthily make their way to the Big Smurf's laboratory; It seems that two snooping Smurfs are investigating the Magic Crystal. They say, this wonderful talisman allows you to travel the world... Fascinated, Smurf and Smurfette approach the glowing crystal. They touch it and... Cataplum! The glass breaks and, then, a lightning bolt propels our friends to remote places...Help our Smurfs reverse the process, to return to the village. Collect each crystal shard; some will be easy to find, but others will require a careful search. Will you be able to guide them in their difficult mission?

game.name: The Smurfs
game.desc: Gargamel has captured three Smurfs. Smurfs to your rescue! Smurf in the mountains riding a sleigh, explore the mine labyrinths, ride on the back of a stork, but watch out for nasty enemies like flies, Grumpy Smurf, Cracoucas, Azrael and... Gargamel!

game.name: The Sporting News Baseball
game.desc: The Sporting News, the most influential sports magazine in the United States, offers a true diamond to baseball fans. Feel the stadium vibrate as the season begins with your teammates. The Major League Baseball Players Association license gives authenticity to the game. The incredibly realistic player attributes and simultaneous 4-player action make this game a real home run. Choose a closed field or an open one. Or take a trip back in time and play on a dream course from the Shoeless Joe era.

game.path: ./Super Aquatic Games Starring the Aquabats, The (USA).zip
game.name: The Super Aquatic Games Starring the Aquabats
game.desc: James Pond and four special agents of the F.I.5.H. They participate in "Aquatic Games" to maintain their physical fitness during breaks from their missions. The game contains eight sporting events: 100 meter speed races, ball game, long jump, triple jump, freestyle jump from bouncy castle, frog jump among others. You can play the trials individually or play a full championship with up to 4 players alternately.
game.image: ./media/images/Super Aquatic Games Starring the Aquabats, The (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Super Aquatic Games Starring the Aquabats, The (USA).png

game.name: The Terminator
game.desc: Like the other games, we will control Kyle Reese and also start the game in the future. However, the development is a little more reminiscent of Contra-type action games. Specifically, it particularly reminds me of Midnight Resistance, partly because of the type of graphics. It is a side-scrolling shooter in which we will have to advance, killing everything that crosses our path. In the first levels we will limit ourselves to killing terminators and powerful war machines, but in the present we will also have to face the worst criminals in the city and even police officers. Naturally, the dangerous end-of-phase bosses will not be missing from the event, which will be quite complicated.

game.name: The Tick
game.desc: The game is quite original in the sense that typical levels of a conventional beat'em up like Streets of Rage alternate with other levels that are more platform-based and skill-based. The beat'em up levels follow the footsteps of a classic game of the genre, with deep scenarios in which we will have to eliminate enemies to continue advancing. On the other hand, we also have those levels of platforms. In them the graphic aspect does not change, but they will no longer be scenarios with depth, but rather they try to go on elevated surfaces such as roofs or ropes on which we will balance while we dodge projectiles and jump from one platform to another avoiding falling. If we fall, we will normally end up on the ground where we will have to fight some character, always being a parody of a well-known comic character. Something that differentiates this game from others of the style is the lack of bosses at the end of each level.

game.name: The Twisted Tales of Spike McFang
game.desc: The main action will take place in the different dungeons that are present in the adventure, although there will also be times when we take a well-deserved rest in different cities, where we can also buy different objects such as weapons and the odd item. In the dungeons we have to guide our protagonist through their interior, exploring the rooms that form them, solving some puzzles and defeating the enemies that we encounter, to finally face the boss of the corresponding dungeon. To perform this task, the protagonist is capable of performing a wide variety of movements, among which we find moving forward, jumping, attacking with a spinning attack or throwing the hat to perform ranged attacks, in addition to using spell cards such as invisibility or performing elemental attacks.

game.name: The Untouchables
game.desc: Al Capone and his gang are taking to the city streets. Only you, Eliot Ness and the Untouchables can stop Capone before he takes control of all of Chicago. Shoot all the gangsters you find on the streets, train stations or in warehouses. Stop the corruption and don't forget to reload your weapon!

game.name: The Wizard of Oz
game.desc: ¨The Wizard of Oz¨ is a re-telling of L. Frank Baum's classic story, strongly influenced by MGM's 1939 music. To a lesser extent, individual levels adapt locations from the 1993 DEC "Wizard of Oz" animated series, using contexts from the series, such as Time Town. The game is a platform game that encourages exploration. The action is divided into four worlds. In each of the first three worlds, the Scarecrow, Tin Man, and Lion can be found and controlled by the player. After gaining a companion, characters can be changed on the fly, with each companion having significantly different attacks and abilities. Several of the levels require the use of a combination of all of these skills to fully explore. The game also includes a variety of mini-games that gives the player the opportunity to play as Toto the dog as well. All levels can be revisited once completed. Doing so will allow you to search for items and the entrances to the Emerald City, which are necessary to enter the final zone.

game.name: Theme Park
game.desc:
Dominating the exciting world of an amusement park owner is your goal in this strategy game from Bullfrog. The first task is to prepare your attractions within the available land, planning routes and queues and preferably leaving room for larger attractions once they are available, and including some lakes and trees that enhance the interest of the park. Attractions range from Spinning Cups to Haunted Houses to the biggest, most elaborate roller coasters you can design, and water rides that weave around other rides.
Shops should also be included, so visitors can purchase food, drinks and souvenirs - the clever player will combine salt, sugar and caffeine to maximize consumer interest. Employees have to be hired so that everything runs smoothly, and they will only work for what they consider to be good pay.

game.name: Thomas the Tank Engine & Friends
game.desc: Thomas the Tank Engine and Friends, is a Children's Variety game, developed by Software Creations and published by THQ, which was released in 1993.

game.name: Thunder Spirits
game.desc:
A conversion of the Thunder Force AC arcade game, a modified version of Thunder Force III made specifically for arcades with improved graphics and with all vertical missions replaced with side-scrolling missions. Thunder Spirits puts you behind the controls of a lone space fighter on its mission to destroy the enemy forces of the Orn Empire by clearing 8 enemy-infested missions set in various remote space locations.
The game gives you a health bar and the ability to swap weapons you collect, which can be obtained by collecting power-ups and activating them whenever you prefer.

game.name: Time Slip
game.desc: The gameplay is similar to Contra III: The Alien Wars, albeit with simpler moves and nine lives, but it does not continue (unlike most games in this genre). The game mechanic also features a TGS bar, or "power bar", which must be filled with special time crystals before emptying; Otherwise, the player will lose a life every time the bar empties. The TGS bar is a time-traveling part of the device, and must be filled frequently. The bar empties slowly and by being injured by an enemy, so players must literally "run for their lives" and collect as many crystals as they can. After scoring a set number of points, players receive additional lives.

game.name: Time Trax
game.desc: Past Present Future rnEverything can change in the blink of an eye rnDr. Mordicai Sahmbi is the head of Trax and the mastermind behind a plot to control the world in our time by sending criminals from the year 2193. Sahmbi synthesized TXP the chemical needed to send people in time. Sahmbi has a secret laboratory under the Smithsonian Institution. rnSepp Dietrich is the main suspect in 12 political murders. He is very unstable and must return to 2193. rnYour main objective in this mission is to find these two men and return them for punishment in 2193.

game.name: Timecop
game.desc: Our mission in each level is to control the protagonist (a digitized Jean-Claude Van Damme dressed as a police officer), who we must advance through the specific scenario, fighting using martial arts (that is, kicking and punching), and also using a pistol and other weapons with limited ammunition. In some levels we also have to control a vehicle, and we have a time limit to finish the phases.

game.name: Timon & Pumbaa's Jungle Games
game.desc: Play different arcade games with The Lion King characters Timon and Pumbaa:nnHippo Hop - Help Timon cross the river while collecting larvae from Pumbaa's grill. Be sure to avoid the hyenas! Jungle Pinball - A silly pinball game featuring hyenas, elephants, gophers and more! Sling Shooter - Shoot berries at various targets by appearing. Bug Drop - A game similar to Tetris. Play against the computer or a friend. Burper - Collect worms while avoiding/destroying undesirables with Pumbaa's powerful burps.

game.name: Tin Star
game.desc: Instead of levels, the game is divided into days, each of which in turn features four different tests known as scenes. The first scene is the training, in which our main objective will be to accumulate as much money as possible by shooting at the jugs that are on the stage. After this scene comes the one known as Action, in which we will have to travel through various places, our mission being of course to shoot and kill the enemies that come to us, and there can be both first and third person scenes. The third scene is the confrontation against a specific boss, known in English as Showdown. In these confrontations we have to shoot the bullet drum icon of a revolver when it appears on the screen and then shoot the opponent as quickly as possible. The last scene of the day will be a bonus phase in which you will have to shoot a series of stars near a woman who is spinning on a round table without accidentally hitting the woman.

game.name: Tinhead
game.desc: Once there was peace in the galaxy. Then the evil Grim Squidge stole all the stars, threatening to throw the Galaxy into a horrible Cosmic Void. Who will save the stars before it's too late? Tinhead, Defender of the Edge of the Galaxy of course! Steer, swipe, jump, fly and make your way through wacky worlds and super-complicated challenging levels as you guide Tinhead to free the stars. Take on pesky Krystals, relentless Saw-Sirs, and hordes of mega-tough bosses. Grab radical power-ups and crazy vehicles like batteries, Hyper-Hoppers, and rocket packs to help Tinhead through each strange, monster-filled world. 4 tin worlds with 24 super challenging levels. You have the power of 3-way shooting to take down the bad guys plus dozens of power-ups and hidden bonus areas.

game.name: Tintin : Prisoners of the Sun
game.desc: We are faced with a game in which we are presented with a good number of quite varied situations, although the platform style is never completely abandoned, sprinkled with a pleasant touch of adventure in which our task will be to reach a certain place, overcome some type of obstacle, talk to a particular character or rescue someone, having to do all this before time runs out, which the truth is that it progresses quite quickly. For the rest, Tintin has the same abilities as in the first part, that is, walking, running, jumping and picking up objects, along with some more that depend on the moment, such as swimming or climbing. It must also be said that this second installment of the adventures of Tintin is more varied than the first part, but equally difficult.

game.name: Tintin in Tibet
game.desc: The main virtue of this platform lies in its variety, which includes the most diverse situations and actions, but in all of them skill, intelligence and speed of action prevail, and that is that platforming and puzzle solving are perfectly combined, and we also have a fairly limited time to complete each of the levels. It is the typical game of repeating each scene until we know the path to follow or the action to take at each moment, so despite being a difficult game, with perseverance you can complete each of the levels. Tintin's abilities include walking, jumping, crouching, as well as picking up objects or hiding, but he has many other possible actions that vary depending on the phase we are in. The game also has a certain adventurous air typical of the popular character's comics that, among other things, allows us to talk to some characters.

game.name: Tiny Toon Adventures : Buster Busts Loose!
game.desc: In the game we will control Buster Bunny and we will be able to perform three basic skills, which are jumping, jumping with a kick and running. The latter is especially useful for avoiding some obstacles, as it will allow us to run along the walls until the momentum runs out. At the end of each phase, a roulette wheel will await us that will choose the bonus phase that we will play. There are five different ones and they are all very fun, which are Bingo, Squash, Maze, Seesaw and Comathon Hampton.

game.name: Tiny Toon Adventures : Wacky Sports Challenge
game.desc: The game is made up of a high level of sports tests that require great precision, but none of them are similar to those that appeared in the Mega Drive game. Those included here, which are much more numerous, include tests as diverse as throwing balls at targets with Montana Max's face, reaching the greatest distance possible without falling off a cliff using a slingshot or lifting weights. We do not have game modes, but rather it is a competition in which different tests will take place, but what is allowed is for up to four friends to play simultaneously.

game.name: TKO Super Championship Boxing
game.desc: TKO Super Championship Boxing. This is a boxing game where you can select any of the 8 fighters. The objective of the game is to win against your 7 opponents and be able to compete in the Championship.

game.name: TNN Bass Tournament of Champions
game.desc: The goal of the game is to catch the most bass possible so that the player can advance through the tournaments and eventually win the championship. The player has from sunrise to sunset for the fish, thus giving him the time necessary to develop strategies related to participating in a virtual fishing derby. Changes in the season and weather will attempt to impede the player's progress as they attempt to win the championship.

game.name: Todd McFarlane's Spawn : The Video Game
game.desc: In the game we control the famous comic book character, who must make his way through each level, eliminating enemies with his various movements and using his jumping skills and other powers to overcome obstacles, of course a boss waiting for us at the end of each phase and which has certain patterns that must be learned.

game.name: Tom and Jerry
game.desc: The eternal rivalry between cats and mice is evident in the characters of Tom and Jerry. This game unleashes their rivalry.

game.path: ./Tommy Moe's Winter Extreme - Skiing and Snowboarding (USA).zip
game.name: Tommy Moe's Winter Extreme : Skiing and Snowboarding
game.desc: Competition mode allows the player to have three chances to successfully complete challenges. Otherwise, he or she gets the "play over" screen advising the player to start over. Freestyle mode plays like a video game racing game, training mode allows the player to use any course, and competition mode is like the Winter Olympics. The controls can be modified and the player can use skis or snowboards. The game is named after American alpine skier Tommy Moe and is co-supported with Val-d'Isère; Which hosted the men's alpine skiing event during the 1992 Winter Olympics in Albertville, France.
game.image: ./media/images/Tommy Moe's Winter Extreme - Skiing and Snowboarding (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Tommy Moe's Winter Extreme - Skiing and Snowboarding (USA).png

game.name: Tony Meola's Sidekicks Soccer
game.desc: The teams in the game include several national teams and some non-club licensed teams from Europe, Japan and America. Players can play with teams from different parts of the United States, including Miami, Los Angeles, Sacramento.

game.name: Top Gear 2
game.desc: Top Gear 2 is a car racing game on Super NES. The player must win in 16 different championships, each with 4 circuits, some of which come directly from reality such as the Ayers Rock Monza circuit. Being among the first in these championships is synonymous with unlocked money to upgrade and repair your vehicles. A password system keeps your progress in memory.

game.name: Top Gear 3000
game.desc: The game has two distinct modes of play, with the Championship being the most expansive. Cars are limited by the range of their fuel, and the condition of their frame; Players earn fuel by driving on the red recharge strips, and repair the structural integrity of their car by driving on the blue repair strips.

game.name: Top Gear
game.desc: It is a game designed for two players, because the screen is divided into two. One section of the screen is the main player's point of view, while the other is the point of view of our opponent or a second player. As is usual in the genre, we will see the cars from behind and our objective, of course, is to try to win the races. Among the options we have are the choice of name for the players, the choice of difficulty level, choice of car, whether we want automatic or manual transmission and our country of origin, although there are not a large number of countries available either. Once we have chosen our preferences we can start with the tournament. During the races you have to pay attention to the fuel levels and stop when necessary to replenish the fuel. If we run out of fuel before reaching the finish line we will be disqualified. We also have control over three nitros that we can use whenever we want, and what they do is give us more speed for a short period of time.

game.name: Total Carnage
game.desc: In reality, the game looks like a mix between Smash T.V. and a Mercs-style top-down action arcade, although with automatic scrolling. From Smash T.V. It takes the basic mechanics, in which we must kill all the enemies that come at us in waves, being able to rotate our character 360º to shoot them. Additionally, there are many areas that are static screens, resembling Smash TV even more, and even some final bosses look like modified versions of the bosses from that game. But there are other areas in which the scroll moves automatically and we must destroy what appears along the way, although here we are not going to get rid of the waves of enemies that come from everywhere.

game.name: Toy Story
game.desc: The first thing that catches your attention, beyond its impressive visual finish, is the variety of phases that the cartridge presents. Although most of the phases are platform-based, a couple of driving levels are also included (one of them exclusive to Mega Drive, although I don't know if it is also on the PC) and even a first-person one similar to a Doom, although if it is action, it is only a search. The basic movements that the protagonist has are walking, jumping and using the rope that winds him up as a weapon, and we can also use it to hold on to hooks to reach inaccessible areas. Our main enemies will be toy helicopters or airplanes, but sometimes even toys that are supposed to be friends will want to kill us, like in the level where Woody accidentally throws Buzz out of the window and the other toys want justice. In other phases there will also be confrontations against Buzz Lightyear, such as in the race against him or a couple of confrontations with different strategies.

game.name: Toys : Let the Toy Wars begin!
game.desc: Toys is based on the film of the same name starring Robin Williams, Joan Cusack and LL Cool J. You play Williams' character Leslie Zevo, a girl at heart and toy maker who fights against her uncle, Lieutenant General Leland (played in the film and portrayed in the game by Michael Gambon) and his insane war toys that double as weapons of mass destruction, with their own assortment of toys. You play to recover the factory that your uncle has deformed when he inherited it from his brother when he died. There are four stages in the entire game, each with its own assortment of enemies, such as grenade balloons and Elvis dolls, but you also have your own weapons such as race cars, wind-up ducks, bowling balls, water balloons and even cakes.

game.name: Troddlers
game.desc: In single player mode we control the protagonist of the game Hokus, whom we have to control to help the creatures that give the game its name, the troddlers, to reach the exit point, always within a set time. Troddlers can walk along walls, and to help them reach the exit we have to create blocks that communicate with that point. In each level we have to rescue a specific number of troddlers, but the missions are not limited only to this, we can also receive other tasks such as destroying zombie troddlers or collecting gems. The main difference between this game and Lemmings is that this time we control a foreign character, or two if we play doubles.

game.name: Troy Aikman NFL Football
game.desc:
Players can play exhibition games, season games, playoff games, make their own plays to use on the field, and even make payments to each player's salaries. Each season's schedule can be customized (to the player's exact specifications) or the player can use the 1993 NFL season schedule. There is limited speech from the referee and announcer.
Players can play or coach an exhibition game or an entire season (including the Super Bowl). Games can be saved, which avoids the frustration of having to play 16-19 games in a single session.

game.path: ./True Golf Classics - Pebble Beach Golf Links (USA).zip
game.name: True Golf Classics : Pebble Beach Golf Links
game.desc:
Players take on the challenge of one of the most beautiful and famous golf courses in the world: Pebble Beach. These eighteen holes require precision, finesse, and sometimes even brute force. The famous beachside course is full of bunkers, as well as wide, green cliff-side fairways.
The game takes a classic approach - players control a selected golfer from a third-person perspective. Swing control is displayed as a power meter and the precision with which players must start and stop accordingly. A topographic grid allows the player to know the slope and elevation of the putting surface in three dimensions.
Since there are no other courses to play, this game is an homage to the difficult Pebble Beach Golf Links course design.
game.image: ./media/images/True Golf Classics - Pebble Beach Golf Links (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/True Golf Classics - Pebble Beach Golf Links (USA).png

game.name: True Golf Classics : Waialae Country Club
game.desc: Players can choose a golfer, assign them a cart, choose a set of golf clubs, and adjust the game's statistics to their personal preferences.

game.name: True Golf Classics : Wicked 18
game.desc: The object is to guide the golf ball through nearly impossible obstacles (lava, statues, extremely steep hills and mountains, ever-present water hazards, huge sand traps, floating chunks of land, gorges, cement) as the player attempts to score as low as possible in order to win the day. Using the cart, it is possible to scan the situation before hitting the ball with an analyzer. The bunkers are extremely treacherous, there is lava as well as water hazards, and 'out of bounds' can be in the middle of the hole. The "out of bounds" area could be a platformer-style pit, a large area of ​​sand, or simply an unplayable rift. The game offers stroke play, match play or tournament play.

game.name: True Lies
game.desc: We control the secret agent Harry Tasker (played by Chuache in the film) in different scenarios in which he has to carry out a specific mission. Harry's partner, Albert "Gib" Gibson, will intervene from time to time to update us on the mission, inform us how much we need to complete it, or to tell us what we need to do next. Each level has a unique and non-repeated scenario, which has a labyrinthine design in which we must carry out a specific task, whether it is finding a computer, destroying weapons or stopping a train, things that we must do in different levels. To achieve this, in addition to searching for the objectives, we must kill the different enemies that come our way using the weapons we have at our disposal. The normal thing is that when we reach the end of a level we have to face a boss

game.name: Tuff E Nuff
game.desc: After a great war destroys most of the land, Tuff E Nuff sees four of the toughest people on earth band together to fight, earning the right to try to depose the powerful ruler. The gameplay is standard beat 'em up style action, featuring most of the conventions of the genre. Characters have a variety of kicks, punches and throws, and each fight on its own basis. The 90 second time limit can be turned on or off. Fights are best of three, with points awarded for each hit and for overall victory.

game.name: Turbo Toons
game.desc: The player has to race Hanna-Barbera characters like Yogi Bear, Mr. Cat, Blueberry Dog, along with other classic characters around a simple race track while trying to finish in first place. The levels vary between a forest level to an arctic type level.

game.name: Turn and Burn : No-Fly Zone
game.desc: As is usual in many other flight simulators, we will see everything from inside the plane's cabin, before starting each mission the plane must take off from an aircraft carrier and must land on it once it is finished. Normally the missions will be of the type of destroying a certain number of enemy planes or destroying an enemy base, which are often found on islands scattered across the ocean. We have four types of basic shots. The main one is the machine gun, but we have three types of missiles available that vary in speed and precision, the most precise of all being the remote-controlled one, but also the rarest. Furthermore, at all times you must keep in mind that ammunition is not infinite and that at more advanced levels you have to be careful with fuel, which also runs out. The fuel can be refilled in the air if a larger plane is attached to us, but to reload the weapons we have no choice but to land on the aircraft carrier.

game.name: U.N. Squadron
game.desc: Side-scrolling shoot-em-up video game with airplanes. The UN needs help, take command of one of the three available stealth fighters, each with different abilities in terms of damage repair, weapons and flying ability, and fight against mercenaries that have controlled the entire country. Destroy the enemy bases of "project 4" and conduct an air strike for freedom, shoot everything that moves on the screen and lead the allied forces to victory!

game.name: Ultima : Runes of Virtue II
game.desc: Third-person top-view role-playing and adventure video game. Enter the world of Britannia and rescue the kidnapped mayors. Choose one of the protagonists like Shamino the ranger or Mariah to face the dangers that come your way. Visit dungeons, islands, castles, etc. and solve the puzzles you find to continue advancing. Prepare your sword, your bow and your magical amulet and bring peace to Britannia.

game.name: Ultima : The Black Gate
game.desc: Role-playing and adventure video game with third-person view. The Avatar is once again summoned to the land of Britannia, and this time he has to investigate some strange kidnappings that are happening in the city of Trinsic. Meanwhile, a new philosophical doctrine is spreading across Britannia... Wield your sword and fight enemies to get to the bottom of all this mystery!

game.name: Ultima : The False Prophet
game.desc: Third-person top-view role-playing and adventure video game. The Avatar has been summoned to save Britannia from the Gargoyles, a strange race of beings who have taken control of the Eight Sanctuaries of Virtue. When you try to stop them you discover that they are fighting against ancient forces that you could not even imagine. Help the race of gargoyles by learning their culture, language and vocabulary to defeat the new enemy you have in common. Explore Britannia, a gigantic world full of monsters and puzzles, with your companions Iolo, Shamino and Dupre.

game.name: Ultimate Fighter
game.desc: Side-scrolling beat'em up fighting game. When Rick's training school is invaded by a demon named Dargon, Rick and his team decide to take matters personally. Recover the artifacts stolen by Dargon, play as Rick or one of the other fighters to test your martial arts skills in "story" mode or "tournament" mode with up to 8 opponents. Prove that you are the best to enter the fighting tournament and recover the lost items.

game.name: Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3
game.desc: Classic one-on-one fighting game. The popular fighting series returns with old adversaries and new combatants fighting to see who is the most powerful. This installment of the saga has 23 unique fighters, and two final bosses, as well as new combos, fatalities and the cruelest deaths you can imagine, like tearing out your opponent's spine, anyone? Stunning motion capture graphics and brutal sound make the game surprisingly realistic. Enjoy the story mode, 2 on 2 tournaments, tournaments with up to 8 fighters, etc. Fight for your life!

game.name: Ultraman
game.desc: Gigantic and horrible aliens are invading Earth. They are destroying our cities and leaving a trail of chaos around the planet. There is a hero powerful enough to eradicate these creatures...Ultraman!!! Do you have what it takes to eliminate the evil aliens once and for all? Use special weapons along with Ultraman's most powerful martial arts to defeat and destroy once and for all the monsters that threaten our survival.

game.name: Uncharted Waters 2 : New Horizons
game.desc: In the first Uncharted Waters game, it was the 15th century and the New World was discovered. Now in New Horizons, it is the early 16th century and the era of maritime exploration and trade is underway. Players choose from any of six adventurers (scenarios), each with their own distinctive but intertwined plot, to embark on a quest of sailing, seamanship, and exploration. The six characters are: Joao Franco is the son of Duke Leon Franco, the hero of the first Uncharted Waters game and an influential man in Portugal. His father wants to make him a strong man and decides to send him to the sea. Young Joao is tasked with learning the skills of the sailor (he is the only character who starts at level one) and embarking on a quest of discovery; reaching the extreme east and finally searching for the secret of Atlantis.

game.name: Uncharted Waters
game.desc: Navigation and trading simulation game. Board your ship and sail the seven seas. You control young Leon Fanco, who wants to restore his family's good name and make a name for himself as a sailor by gaining fame, fortune and the love of a young lady named Christiana. Explore distant lands, make treaties with the most stubborn merchants and use the profits to upgrade your ship and face pirates of the sea and the mysterious dangers of the deep. Win allies for Portugal and the king will reward you!

game.name: Uniracers
game.desc: The video game is a 2D with pre-rendered graphics of speed + platforms. We take control of a unicycle, and whose objective is to reach the finish line as quickly as possible. Accelerate at dizzying speed, do somersaults, spins, jump off ramps while doing tricks with the unicycle. The more amazing the tricks are, the faster you will go! Compete against the clock, against friends head-to-head, or in custom tournaments. Become the universal champion in one of the fastest races on SNES.

game.name: Universal Soldier
game.desc: Universal Soldier was in development by a company called Carolco and was published by Accolade. The game was actually a sequel to Manfred Trentz's game Turrican, but the sprite character was changed so it could be renamed as a tie-in to the movie. There is a rom of what appears to be the full version of this game. Enemies and gameplay closely match Turrican, as you would expect. It is unknown why this game was cancelled. The Genesis and Game Boy versions of this game were released, and Turrican 2 was released on several computer platforms. Nintendo Power commented in the October 1992 issue that it was similar to Contra, but complained about poor controls. The game was originally developed using the original C64 source code and Amiga graphics as a base. Late in development, Accolade also acquired the rights to produce a spin-off of Jean-Claude Van Damme's Universal Soldier game and decided to rename the game Universal Soldier. Turrican's sprite was transformed into a marine and several other substitutions were made. Among other changes, the eyeballs were turned into mini tanks, and instead of a large mechanical/steel dragon in the first stage, the player now faces a large representation of Dolph Lundgren's character in the film. The three filming sets, cut out of the port, were replaced by the developers with three original sets (a Vietnam jungle, a fortress, and a motel/car scrapyard) that should theoretically tie the game to the atmosphere of the film. The rest of the original Turrican II stages are still present and remain mostly intact in the overall layout, although some of them appear in a different order, along with the three new levels spread differently across them.

game.name: Urban Strike
game.desc: Urban Strike is the third in EA's helicopter action game series. An evil genius named H. R. Malone has formed a cult and has managed to gather millions of followers. Malone is using his influence and wealth to build a super weapon to overthrow the government. Only you can stop this once again, you will take control of various types of helicopters and even enter interior areas armed with your pistol and rocket launcher to put an end to Malone's madness.

game.name: Utopia : The Creation of a Nation
game.desc: Create a nation, you have a whole world in your hands. Colonize one of ten available planets, each with its unique terrain and resources. Explore, build and trade. Expand civilization wherever you go, but beware of dangerous attacks from other alien civilizations, create highly sophisticated weapons to defend yourself and achieve the survival of humanity.

game.name: Vegas Stakes
game.desc: Vegas Stakes, all the risk and action of a live casino! Stay at your favorite hotel, meet friends in the lobby and come play at our casino. Blackjack, slots, roulette, poker, etc. all games of promise and fortune to the bravest player. With 5 casinos to explore and the possibility of playing with three friends. Place your bets!

game.name: Venom & Spider-Man : Separation Anxiety
game.desc: Venom has violently separated from his living suit, spawning five deadly alien Symbiotes. They plan to link them with their soldiers, creating a very dangerous army. In a fierce battle that you can enjoy in company, Venom joins forces with his archenemy, Spider-Man, to face this new threat. But you won't be alone, you can count on the help of allies as impressive as Ghost Rider and Daredevil.

game.name: Virtual Bart
game.desc: The protagonist of this story, Bart, decides to try a virtual reality machine at the school science fair. Our adventure begins when the machine acts as a roulette wheel, randomly taking Bart to different situations: as a pig in Krusty's slaughterhouse, sliding down a water slide, riding a motorcycle in an apocalyptic version of Springfield, as a dinosaur fighting cavemen... Can you return Bart to the city of Springfield?

game.name: Virtual Soccer
game.desc: Football full of action and emotion from start to finish. Super shots, offsides, penalties, substitutions, cheering fans, it has it all. Virtual Soccer is a fan's dream come true. It is designed not only as a simple game but for you to experience all aspects of this spectacular sport.

game.name: Vortex
game.desc: Pilot gigantic combat robots to save the universe. Attack with lasers, rockets, cannons, heat-seeking missiles and smart bombs. Explore desert worlds, volcanic worlds or caverns full of enemies and huge final bosses intent on reducing you to rubble!

game.name: War 2410
game.desc: "War 2410" is a turn-based strategy game. In 2003, geneticists tried to create the perfect soldier. Something went wrong and three new life forms turned against their creators: the savage Orcs, the cybernetic androids, called Cromes, and the genetically enhanced human soldiers called M.A.R.S. Take control of a secret force, use mecha, tanks, troops or planes and restore order!

game.name: War 3010 : The Revolution
game.desc: "War 3010" is a turn-based strategy game in which players move spaceships on a route board. An alien race called the Kyllen has enslaved humanity. On the planet Joyec, the rebels managed to take Kyllen by surprise and seize one of his battle fleets. Your role now is to direct their efforts to try to take down Kyllen. Explore the planets in search of technology, move your units and attack with the different types of ships and destroyers that you have at your disposal. Kyllen must fall!

game.name: Wario's Woods
game.desc: Wario's Woods is a game derived from Tetris in relation to falling blocks, although in this case what falls instead of blocks are forest creatures and bombs. rnThe forests in Toad's kingdom are in danger, Wario has brought an entire army of monsters and only Toad can free the forest from this terrible plague. Think quickly about your strategies and combine the falling monsters to win!

game.name: Warlock
game.desc: Using the powerful spells and potions entrusted to you by your druid ancestors, fight gargoyles, immortals, fire-breathing dragons and...if you survive, the all-powerful Warlock! Combining strategy, intuition and sorcery, you must be the first to find six ancient rune stones and thus save creation! Are you afraid?

game.name: WarpSpeed
game.desc: WarpSpeed ​​is a first-person space game for the Snes. The space mutants are determined to take control of the galaxy. Get on your ship and travel through space to stop this threat. Navigate through asteroid fields, destroy all the mines you find, and take space technology from the enemy to destroy them!

game.name: Waterworld
game.desc: In the future, the Earth's temperature rises and melts the polar caps, it is under a watery tomb. Years later, the survivors of this catastrophe live on ships or artificial islands called atolls. Everyone in this new world is searching for a mythical place called the Dry Land, of which people believe there is a map on a girl's back. rnTake control of a vagabond called "The Marnier", sailing his boat through the endless sea, diving underwater for gold and fighting with a knife in hand against the "Smokers"

game.name: Wayne Gretzky and the NHLPA All-Stars
game.desc: All the action of professional hockey comes to the Super Nintendo with WAYNE GRETZKY AND THE ALL-STARS from NHLPA. Play exhibition, season or playoff mode controlling great stars of this sport such as Messier, Bure, Jagr, Lemieux and Lindros. Choose arcade mode or realistic simulation and enjoy hardcore hockey action without losing your teeth!

game.name: Wayne's World
game.desc: Action game based on the movie of the same name. It's Friday, 10:30 and as usual, Wayne and Garth are hosting their TV show. Everything happens normally until Wayne tells how he and Garth were suddenly sucked into a video game and Garth was kidnapped by the mysterious Zantar. There the player takes control of Wayne to embark on a quest and save his good friend Garth. Jump, fight and fight your way through the different levels using Wayne's guitar as a sonic weapon!

game.name: WCW Super Brawl Wrestling
game.desc: World championship wrestling video game. Enter the ring and face Vader, Ric Flair, Ricky "the Dragon", Johnny B. Badd, Ron Simmons or Sting. Choose individual mode or compete with or against a friend to prove who is the king. Vibrate with Tony Schiavone's comments during each fight. Get in the ring and become the WCW Champion!

game.name: WeaponLord
game.desc: Snes fighting video game. Enter a medieval, barbaric and bloody world. Choose from seven savage warriors, armed and dangerous. Fight to win the "DemonLord" tournament and emerge victorious. Jump, block with your sword, stab it at your enemy, and perform special combos that finish off your enemy. Sharpen your weapon and fight to the end!

game.name: We're Back! : A Dinosaur's Story
game.desc: Platform and action video game from the movie "Rex, a dinosaur in New York." The evil professor "screw eyes" has kidnapped Rex's best friends, Louie and Cecilia. Only Rex has the courage to save them! Chase the evil professor through the time machine that he has invented, entering different eras. Jump, explore, avoid clever traps, defeat enemies in your path and find hidden bonus items. Rescue Rex's friends!

game.name: Wheel of Fortune : Deluxe Edition
game.desc: Wheel of Fortune: Deluxe Edition is an updated sequel to its predecessor that features 4,000 different puzzles and standard Wheel of Fortune features such as the bonus round. In this popular wheel of fortune game, you will guess the letters on the panel until you can guess the phrase. You can compete against 2 machine-controlled players or take on two friends.

game.name: Wheel of Fortune
game.desc: Do you think you can solve puzzles faster than the computer? Up to three players can get in on the action in this famous "Wheel of Fortune" game. The setup will make you feel like you are on the set of the series, as the theatrical song plays and the camera flies from the audience to the player. With top-class sound effects and the 4,000 best puzzles people have ever heard, this game will attract you.

game.path: ./Where in the World Is Carmen Sandiego (USA).zip
game.name: Where in the World is Carmen Sandiego?
game.desc:
Conversion of a 1985 classic, Where in the World is Carmen Sandiego? puts you in the role of a detective in charge of capturing different international criminals, while you travel the world looking for witnesses and collecting clues. In the process, you will learn a lot of interesting facts and train your deductive thinking.
This title does not base its strength on graphics or sound, but on a wide variety of research and data association possibilities; You have a record that will help you review your clues and make decisions that guide your search. To complement the adventure, you will be able to see pleasant images that represent the place where you are, and occasional animations that tell you how close you are to finding the criminal on duty.
game.image: ./media/images/Where in the World Is Carmen Sandiego (USA).png
game.thumbnail: ./media/box3d/Where in the World Is Carmen Sandiego (USA).png

game.name: Where in Time is Carmen Sandiego?
game.desc: Carmen Sandiego and her gang are on the loose once again, and your job is to capture them! The player plays as a secret agent for the Acme Detective Agency, having to use the investigation books to decipher the clues that will help him find Carmen and her gang. But this time you not only have to find where it is, but also "when", traveling in time to various places. You'll have to gather clues and interrogate witnesses to track Carmen's villains through history, arrest them, and ultimately stop Carmen herself.

game.name: Whirlo
game.desc: A platform title starring Valkyrie's lizard friend, Xandra. In the game you control Xandra as she leaves her enchanted forest in order to get help for her family. This will eventually lead him to meet our beloved Valkyrie and mark the beginning of his adventures. Xandra has all the abilities of a standard platforming character, allowing her to jump around and navigate the many obstacles found in the game. He is also armed with a pitchfork that he can use to impale his enemies and also adhere to some surfaces. Collecting coins allows you to acquire extra lives, but there are no added weapons or spells like in the Valkyrie games.

game.name: Whizz
game.desc: Whiz is one of the few 3D platformers that uses an isometric point of view. You play as a rabbit dressed as a wizard pursued by his archenemy Ratty through several worlds. There are four different types of doors, each of which requires a particular material to pass through (such as rock, ice or bricks). Jump to avoid obstacles and attack with your spin attack to get rid of your enemies.

game.name: Wild Guns
game.desc: In this game you control Annie who recruits a bounty hunter named Clint to avenge the death of her family. Help them in this Wild West game to dodge and shoot by overcoming the different levels, either defeating humans or robots that cross their path.

game.name: Wild Snake
game.desc: WildSnake is a TETRIS-style puzzle game in which the player must manage the snakes that fall on the screen, they fall and slide until they reach the bottom. A snake will destroy any other snake of the same color and pattern that it touches with its head along the way. The game features a selection of backgrounds including desert, forest, water or grass. Additionally, there are 7 game grids such as the standard grid (a tall rectangle), X-shaped, hourglass-shaped, etc.

game.name: Williams Arcade's Greatest Hits
game.desc: Williams Arcade's Greatest Hits for SNES is a compilation of classic games, including Defender, Defender II, Joust, Robotron and Sinistar.

game.name: Wing Commander : The Secret Missions
game.desc:
"Wing Commander: Secret Missions" was an expansion campaign for "WC1", adding new missions, new ships and new story, and increased difficulty. This game was released for the SNES as a separate cartridge.
The Tiger Claw, on maneuvers in the Goddard system, receives a distress call from the Goddard colony. When it arrives, however, there is nothing left but ruins and corpses, a quarter of a million settlers have been murdered. The Confederacy realizes that this is the work of a new Kilrathi weapon, the "Graviton weapon", which is capable of increasing the power of gravity by more than a hundred times. Clever work by the Claw's crew and pilots allows them to capture a Kilrathi mail ship, which reveals that this weapon is mounted on an entirely new class of ship; the CNC codename of the Sivar-class battleship, the Kilrathi war god. Bluehair leads the attack against Sivar and destroys it in the Vigrid system; for unexplained reasons, the weapons ships are never seen again.

game.name: Wing Commander
game.desc: The player takes the role of an unnamed pilot aboard the TCS Tiger's Claw, a Bengal-class carrier. The player names and Callsign the pilot whose nickname given by the Origin staff is Bluehair, quickly rises through winged command and (assuming he performs excellently) will eventually lead an attack against the Kilrathi starbase located in the Venice system; but if not, the missions will become increasingly defensive to the point that the Tiger Claw is forced to abandon the Vega sector.

game.name: Wings 2 : Aces High
game.desc: The game takes place in the year 1917, as leader of a squadron of British warplanes, the player must bomb German buildings. Five different pilots are given this difficult task; Earning status points to improve your combat performance. If any of these pilots fail to complete their designated mission but survive actual combat, the end result will be a dishonorable discharge from the military. If he dies in the line of duty, then the player gets a cutscene where he is seen in the graveyard.

game.name: Winter Gold
game.desc:
Winter Gold is a winter sports game with events like bobsled, ski jumping and snowboarding, all in a 3D graphics environment.
Single-player and multiplayer options are available; You can play with up to eight people in competition mode.

game.name: Winter Olympic Games : Lillehammer '94
game.desc:
This is the official license from the 1994 Winter Olympics tournament in Lillehammer, Norway. You can practice in any case before the tournament. The game offers two modes: Full Olympics and Mini Olympics, which vary in the number of events.
It includes 5 different types of sports: biathlon, alpine skiing (downhill, slalom, giant slalom and Super-G), ski jumping (90 m, 120 m), bobsleigh (2/4 men's bob, 1/2 men's luge) and Skating (elimination, pursuit, time trial). Events use 3D views

game.name: Wizardry V : Heart of the Maelstrom
game.desc:
Despite the defeat of Trebor, Werdna and L'kbreth, the dark times return once again, as a threat looms over the kingdom of Llylgamyn. Once again, a group of adventurers must venture out to defeat evil.
"Wizardry V: Heart of the Maelstrom" returns to the gameplay concept of the first three installments of the series, abandoning the unusual premise of its predecessor. As with the initial games, gameplay involves exploring a vast dungeon-like maze with a custom party created and equipped in the game's only city. This installment offers larger mazes, new spells and character classes, and an expanded fighting system and interaction with creatures. It is also the first game in the series that allows, but does not require, the import of characters from a previous installment.

game.name: Wolfchild
game.desc: The plot revolves around biotechnology researcher Kal Morrow and his son Saul. When the former is kidnapped by the evil Chimera organization, Saul uses one of his father's inventions to become a wolf-human hybrid (similar to a werewolf) who may be able to defeat the Chimera.

game.name: Wolfenstein 3-D
game.desc: Wolfenstein 3D (commonly abbreviated as Wolf3D) is a first-person shooter video game that popularized the genre for PC. The player is William "B.J." Blazkowicz, an American spy trying to escape from the Nazi fortress in which he is imprisoned. This fortress is full of armed guards and dogs trained for attack. The building has a large number of secret rooms containing treasure, food rations and first aid kits, as well as different types of weapons and ammunition, all of which will help the player achieve their objective.

game.name: Wolverine : Adamantium Rage
game.desc:
¨Wolverine: Adamantium Rage¨ is a side-scrolling, platforming beatem up. Wolverine, also known as Logan, is desperately searching for clues about his past and identity. Using the X-Men mansion's computers, Wolverine soon receives coordinates somewhere in Canada and is told to come alone. As you complete missions and progress through levels you come across clues that inevitably lead you to the next level.
The main character has a large selection of combat moves, and also has great agility and the ability to climb walls using his claws. Bonus pick-ups are provided on level maps. Many of them are hidden deep, inviting the player to use Wolverine's agility and skills to explore every corner. These levels include a secret laboratory, a ninja training camp, a hallucinogenic world, and others.

game.name: Wordtris
game.desc: Wordtris is a branch of Tetris where the object of the game is to build words of three letters or more using tiles that fall from the top of the playing area. Words can be constructed horizontally or vertically, and several words can overlap each other. If the player manages to build the magic word at the top of the screen, the pot will be cleared of all chips and the player will receive a large bonus.

game.name: World Class Rugby
game.desc: Rugby's sixteen best teams compete for the World Cup, a definitive test of their skills. 3D perspective, sound effects and atmosphere take you right into the heart of the action. You are on the battlefield jumping for the ball at the starting line and experiencing the triumphant feeling of scoring. Single Game, World Cup and League for 3 to 8 teams. One or two player option. Option to change team names, player names, skills and physical attributes.

game.name: World Cup USA 94
game.desc: World Cup USA '94 is a soccer video game that was developed by U.S. Gold (Olympic Gold, among others) in 1994. It is licensed by FIFA as an official product of the 1994 Soccer World Cup in the United States. The game places special emphasis on aspects such as the number of options to configure the match, the teams to choose from (thirty-two national teams), the competitions to play, etc., rather than on the graphics section. The matches are played from a "bird's eye view" perspective, and the controls are reduced to the following possibilities: movement and effect of the ball (with the control pad), long pass, shot on goal, short pass, stealing the ball and tackling. The idea of ​​the creators was to achieve a fun and dynamic game, rather than a complex football match simulator.

game.name: World Heroes 2
game.desc: A new World Heroes tournament has begun; The fighters from the previous event have returned and with six new competitors: Captain Kidd, Ryoko Izumo, Mudman, Erick, Shura, Johnny Maximum. This time, a new villain appears named Dio, Geegus's boss.

game.name: World Heroes
game.desc: Eight historical figures have been summoned from different eras by Dr. Brown's time machine to fight in a tournament called WORLD HEROES. The fighters: Hanzo Hattori, Fuuma Kotaro, Kim Dragon, Janne D'Arc, Julius Carn, Muscle Power, Brocken and Rasputin. The winner will face the artificial villain Geegus.

game.name: World League Soccer
game.desc: Soccer game very different from the rest, seen from top to bottom, the controls involve catching the ball under your foot, giving you time to prepare passes. Running with the ball is difficult at first because it doesn't stick to your foot the way it did in contemporary soccer games. Complex movements such as head kicks, back heels, and long-range passes through the ball can be completed with practice.

game.name: World Masters Golf
game.desc: World Masters Golf is a golf simulation game, it was released in Europe. It has four fields and several game modes, tournament, match and practice. You will be able to play with created golfers and you will have the option to create your own (choice of appearance, name and club). Basic information such as wind speed, distance to the flag, number of shots required to make par on a hole, and number of shots already taken are displayed during play. All this seen from a 3D view.

game.name: World Soccer 94 : Road to Glory
game.desc: The last soccer game has arrived. Striker is so spectacular you'll have to play it to believe it. The game includes an enviable list of features and options: team strategies, different formations, new FIFA rules, manual or automatic goalkeepers, variable wind and field conditions, yellow and red cards, 6-player futsal option, substitutions, extra time and penalties, unique 3D perspective, statistics for each match, and a wide variety of different competitions, from cup to single match to 64-team league. The Edit Team option allows you to change the name of the club and the players and, using the Design Kit, even change the design of the shirt and the color of the skin and hair of the players.

game.name: Worms
game.desc: Worms is the first in a series of video games in the turn-based military strategy genre. In these games, two or more players compete against each other, controlling one or more worms for a certain time, with the aim of eliminating the opponent's worms. The player has an incredible variety of weapons, from guns, boxing gloves, bazookas, to sheep with explosives. A wild fight to enjoy especially in the company of friends.

game.name: WWF Raw
game.desc:
"WWF Raw" is a professional wrestling game featuring up to twelve superstars from the World Wrestling Federation: Bret "Hit Man" Hart, Bam Bam Bigelow, 1-2-3 Kid, Diesel, Doink, Lex Luger, Luna Vachon, Owen Hart, Razor Ramon, Shawn Michaels, Undertaker and Yokozuna.
In this game, player-controlled wrestlers attempt to knock opponents to the mat by reducing their power meter until they can no longer fight. There are a number of moves to perform, including rope maneuvers and "illegal" acts, such as hitting your opponent with a metal folding chair.
This game supports up to four simultaneous players, and has the following modes: One on One, Tag Team, Bedlam, Survivor Series, Royal Rumble, Raw Endurance Match and Rematch.

game.name: WWF Royal Rumble
game.desc: Take control of one of the twelve stars of the World Wrestling Federation in a "nothing off limits" game - in other words, do whatever you want, from shock holds, piledrivers, and even chair shots, until your opponent is knocked out. You can even go outside the ring if you want. Several game modes are available, including one-on-one, team-based (two-on-two), and three-on-three team. You can play as the following WWF wrestlers: Bret Hart, Razor Ramon, Randy Savage, Shawn Michaels, Undertaker, Tatanka, Mr. Perfecto, Crush, Ric Flair, Yokozuna, Ted Dibiase, and Lex Luger.

game.name: WWF Super WrestleMania
game.desc: "WWF Super WrestleMania" is a wrestling game that uses the rules and wrestlers of the World Wrestling Federation. The game introduces a distinctive "tug of war" style, which involves two fighters attacking each other until one of them has the Upper Hand. The player has to repeatedly tap a button to execute this move. All wrestlers share the same set of typical WWF moves such as scoop slams, suplexes, hip tosses, dropkicks, clotheslines, and elbow drops. The game modes are one-on-one, team combat, and Survivor Series matches (four-on-four).

game.name: WWF WrestleMania : The Arcade Game
game.desc:
"WWF WrestleMania: The Arcade Game" combines the personality and action of WWF television show characters with a "Mortal Kombat" style fighting game. This title features digitized graphics of 8 WWF Superstars: Doink, Razor Ramon, Bret "Hit Man" Hart, Shawn Michaels, Undertaker, Yokozuna, Bam Bam Bigelow, and Lex Luger.
Although presented as a wrestling title, this game is structured as a one-on-one fighting game that features signature WWF special moves.

game.name: X Zone
game.desc: Compond In fact, the computer has accessed the nation's nuclear weapons countdown systems for a retaliatory strike. Since nuclear war could balance life on the planet, the player must enter the X-Termination zone of the compound and fight through the defenses towards the mainframe computer.

game.name: Xardion
game.desc: Xardion tells the story of 3 warring planets that are home to 3 alien races. Their fight is interrupted by the threat of invasion by a much more powerful alien race. The 3 planets find that they are able to put aside their differences long enough to fight their shared threat. It is an action platform video game where the player controls robots with different abilities to defeat the enemy and achieve objectives. Despite possessing the typical action platformer qualities at the time it was made (jump, duck, shoot, etc.), Xardion made use of some novel elements. Additionally, the game had a role-playing element where experience points could be accumulated by defeating enemies and patrons, and each level increased the player's maximum health and special skill points.

game.name: X-Kaliber 2097
game.desc: The game takes place in the year 2097 A.D. at NEO N.Y. The city is run down and controlled by a warlord named Raptor. Raptor has unleashed an army of ruthless, mutant Morphs on the city to impose his order. Only two special forces agents, Slash and Alix, do not submit to Raptor's will. Raptor decides to come up with a plan to kidnap Alix, so Slash, and more importantly his magical X-Kaliber sword, will come to him in an attempt to try to rescue her.

game.name: X-Men : Mutant Apocalypse
game.desc: Due to an increase in anti-mutant activity in Genosha, Professor Xavier uses Cerebro to explore the island nation and discovers Apocalypse's presence there. The Genosha government is apparently using Apocalypse to control its mutant population. However, Xavier suspects that Apocalypse will follow his own plans and sends five X-Men, Cyclops, Wolverine, Psylocke, Beast and Gambit, to investigate.

game.name: Yoshi's Cookie
game.desc: Yoshi's Cookie is a fast-paced puzzle game that everyone can enjoy as it is easy to play but difficult to complete. To play, move randomly placed cookies into rows and columns of cookies with similar patterns. When you successfully assemble a row or column of the same cookies, the line will disappear and you can start on a new row or column. The "Yoshi" cookie is very special in both the 1-player and 2-player game. Since the Yoshi cookie is the key to both games, you must use it wisely.

game.name: Yoshi's Safari
game.desc: Bowser is up to his old tricks and is threatening to invade and conquer the land of jewelry so you must help Mario and rescue Yoshi King Fret and his son Prince Pine from the evil Bowser and his minions before it's too late! In the amazing Yoshi's Safari you must ride Yoshi and blow up hell from all the bad guys who are quickly approaching and attacking you! Save yourselves before you save the kingdom from certain condemnation!

game.name: Young Merlin
game.desc: After trying to rescue a drowning young woman, the hero of Young Merlin finds himself pulled into a fantasy world threatened by the evil King Sombra. Naturally, it is your job to save this world and also rescue the aforementioned woman who has been kidnapped by the Shadow King. This is done with the typical action adventure: you have to fight enemies using spells that are collected during the progress of the game, as well as solve puzzles and use various items. What sets Young Merlin apart from other action adventures is the fact that there is no text in the entire game; instead, icons are used to represent conversations; Additionally, the game uses passwords, rather than a battery, to record players' progress.

game.name: Ys III : Wanderers from Ys
game.desc: Adol Christin's old friend Dogi wishes to return to his hometown of Redmont after learning of the strange riots occurring there. Always looking for an adventure, Adol joins him and soon discovers the cause of this new evil.

game.name: Zero the Kamikaze Squirrel
game.desc: The story begins halfway through Aero the Acro-bat 2. Zero receives a note from his girlfriend Amy telling him that the evil lumberjack Jaques Le Sheets is destroying his homeland in order to use trees to print money. Zero, despite the protests of his boss Edgar Ektor (who tells him that there is nothing more important than his mission with him, especially referring to plan B against Aero), decides to return home and stop him.

game.name: Zombies Ate My Neighbors
game.desc: In the game you are a male or female protagonist (Zeke or Julia), fighting vampires, mummies, zombies, etc. in more than 50 levels (not including secrets) and saving everyone you meet. There is a defined number of neighbors that are saved on each level. When they are free, the "Exit" door opens and you go up to the next level. Levels vary from the mall and grocery store to beaches and soccer fields. Using different weapons like bazooka or water gun you have to kill the bosses like huge babies, dragons or ants at the end of the levels. You can play the game with two players in cooperation.

game.name: Zool : Ninja of the “Nth” Dimension
game.desc: The game is a pure platform game, relying on smooth and fast gameplay. Its protagonist is Zool, a gremlin "ninja from the ninth dimension" who forces himself to land on earth; In order to earn the ninja ranking, you have to pass seven lands, hitting a boss at the end of each of them. The game contains a number of embedded mini-games, including several arcade games, a space-scrolling shooter and a game accessible only by having Zool play a certain tune on an in-game piano or search for certain invisible warp points.

game.name: Zoop
game.desc:
Fast-paced action-puzzle game where the player eliminates colored shapes that are approaching their alter ego, another colored shape, before reaching the top, ala Tetris.
To eliminate the other shapes, you must aim your piece and 'shoot'. If the shape is the same color as the piece, the shape is removed, as well as all shapes of the same color behind it, until the piece hits a piece of a different color. If the shape is a different color, or is hit by collecting a line of similar shapes, your piece swaps colors with the shape.
